CRUD+ Rules Design Pattern
nodes.rationale: Extends standard CRUD with Reorder (display_order), Enable/Disable (publishing toggle), Delete/Restore (soft delete). Rationale: administrators need to control visibility and ordering of content without destructive operations or losing audit history.

nodes.label: Soft Deletion Pattern (is_deleted/is_active)
nodes.rationale: Deletes set boolean is_deleted=true or is_active=false instead of dropping rows. Rationale: enables instant restoration via Recycle Bin and preserves audit trail and foreign-key integrity.

nodes.label: Display Order Logic
nodes.rationale: Admins can set display_order index for static libraries; dynamic sections like 'Continue Learning' intentionally ignore display_order and sort by last_accessed_at/created_at. Rationale: separation of editorial control from personalized learning feeds.

nodes.label: SQL Injection Prevention (Table Whitelist)
nodes.rationale: Table names are whitelisted in postgres-helpers.js tableMap; getTableName() throws on unknown collection. Rationale: parameterized queries are insufficient when collection names are dynamic; a whitelist prevents injection at the schema-lookup layer.

nodes.label: Role-Based Access Control (admin Middleware)
nodes.rationale: Two-layer middleware: protect verifies JWT and attaches req.user; admin checks req.user.role === 'admin' and returns 403 otherwise. Self-deletion is blocked at API level to prevent admin lockout.

nodes.label: Input Validation with createSchema()
nodes.rationale: Custom createSchema().field() builder with type/length constraints; validateBody middleware applies schemas to POST/PUT routes. Rationale: declarative, composable validation reusable across admin endpoints.

nodes.label: Route Path Mismatches
nodes.rationale: adminNavConfig.js declares /admin/faq but App.jsx mounts FaqManager at /admin/faqs; similarly /admin/user-activity vs /admin/activity-log. Rationale: path mismatches cause 404 on nav clicks; alignment to actual App.jsx routes is required.

nodes.label: Recycle Bin Pattern
nodes.rationale: All soft-deleted items are queryable via /trash endpoints; per-type listing and permanent deletion supported. Rationale: gives admins a single UI to review and recover mistakenly deleted content.

nodes.label: Trstprep V2.0 System
nodes.rationale: Three-tier architecture: React frontend, Express.js backend, PostgreSQL/Supabase database.

nodes.label: Frontend Layer
nodes.rationale: React + Vite + TailwindCSS with React Router for client-side routing and dataService for API/cache.

nodes.label: Backend Layer
nodes.rationale: Express.js on Node.js with multi-layer middleware (Helmet, CORS, rate limit, CSRF, JWT, admin, validation) and dbHelpers PostgreSQL ORM.

nodes.label: Database Layer
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL on Supabase Cloud hosting 30+ tables with indexes for fast queries.

nodes.label: React
nodes.rationale: Frontend UI library with component-tree structure (Layout, Page, Shared components).

nodes.label: React Router
nodes.rationale: Client-side routing handling public, protected, test interface, and auth routes.

nodes.label: Vite
nodes.rationale: Build tool for React app enabling fast dev server and modern bundling.

nodes.label: TailwindCSS
nodes.rationale: Utility-first CSS framework paired with Vite+React stack.

nodes.label: Express.js
nodes.rationale: Node.js server framework handling route handlers and middleware pipeline.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL
nodes.rationale: Relational database with 30+ tables, JSONB columns for options/rankings, and FK constraints.

nodes.label: Supabase
nodes.rationale: Cloud PostgreSQL hosting platform providing managed database and auth infrastructure.

nodes.label: Axios
nodes.rationale: HTTP client used by frontend dataService with interceptors for Auth and CSRF tokens.

nodes.label: JWT Authentication
nodes.rationale: Token-based auth stored in httpOnly cookies with 7-day expiry; middleware 'protect' verifies Bearer token and attaches user to req.

nodes.label: Helmet
nodes.rationale: Security headers middleware enforcing CSP, XSS Filter, HSTS, and Frame Guard.

nodes.label: CORS
nodes.rationale: Origin validation middleware to restrict cross-origin requests.

nodes.label: Rate Limiting
nodes.rationale: DDoS protection throttling at 1000 req/15min with admin bypass.

nodes.label: CSRF Protection
nodes.rationale: Token-based CSRF protection that is database-backed and validated before admin handlers execute.

nodes.label: bcrypt
nodes.rationale: Password hashing library with strength validation for secure credential storage.

nodes.label: Input Validation
nodes.rationale: Schema validation middleware that prevents SQL injection and malformed payloads.

nodes.label: dataService.js
nodes.rationale: Frontend API client wrapping Axios with TTL-based cache (30s default, 5min long), auto refresh, retry logic, and loading states.

nodes.label: errorHandler.js
nodes.rationale: Centralized error middleware logging to console and database, returning standardized JSON responses.

nodes.label: dbHelpers
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL ORM layer used by Express handlers for typed queries.

nodes.label: Axios Interceptor
nodes.rationale: Intercepts every request to attach auth/CSRF tokens automatically.

nodes.label: users (PostgreSQL table)
nodes.rationale: Core identity table: id (SERIAL PK), name, email (UNIQUE), password (HASH), role, isProUser (BOOLEAN), enrolled_series (INTEGER[]).

nodes.label: enrollments (PostgreSQL table)
nodes.rationale: Joins users to test_series with user_id and series_id FKs; tracks isPaid and amount for billing.

nodes.label: test_series (PostgreSQL table)
nodes.rationale: Top-level test bundle: id, name, description, isPro, price; aggregates many tests.

nodes.label: tests (PostgreSQL table)
nodes.rationale: Individual exam: id, title, seriesId (FK to test_series), duration (mins), totalMarks, isPro.

nodes.label: questions (PostgreSQL table)
nodes.rationale: Question bank: id, question (TEXT), testId (FK), options (JSONB), correctAnswer (INT), explanation (TEXT).

nodes.label: study_materials (PostgreSQL table)
nodes.rationale: Subject container: id, title, slug (UNIQUE), description; holds aggregated counts of chapters/videos/pdfs/topic tests.

nodes.label: chapters (PostgreSQL table)
nodes.rationale: Topic group under a study material: id, studyMaterialId (FK), title, orderIndex.

nodes.label: subject_videos (PostgreSQL table)
nodes.rationale: Video content: id, studyMaterialId (FK), chapterId (FK), videoUrl.

nodes.label: subject_pdfs (PostgreSQL table)
nodes.rationale: PDF content: id, studyMaterialId (FK), pdfUrl, pages.

nodes.label: exam_categories (PostgreSQL table)
nodes.rationale: Top-level exam taxonomy: id, categoryId, label, icon.

nodes.label: exam_info (PostgreSQL table)
nodes.rationale: Exam metadata: id, categoryId (FK), title, fullName.

nodes.label: test_categories (PostgreSQL table)
nodes.rationale: Hierarchical self-referencing tags: id, name, parentId (FK to test_categories), level (INT).

nodes.label: results (PostgreSQL table)
nodes.rationale: Test attempt outcome: id, userId/testId/seriesId FKs, score, accuracy.

nodes.label: leaderboards (PostgreSQL table)
nodes.rationale: Aggregated rankings: id, testId/seriesId FKs, rankings (JSONB).

nodes.label: attempts (PostgreSQL table)
nodes.rationale: Tracks an in-flight or completed test attempt by a user; only referenced by label in this doc.

nodes.label: Layout Component
nodes.rationale: Shell layout component (wraps Header/Footer/Sidebar) for non-admin pages.

nodes.label: AdminLayout Component
nodes.rationale: Shell layout for /admin/* routes with admin navigation.

nodes.label: Header Component
nodes.rationale: Top navigation bar shared across pages.

nodes.rationale: Route guard wrapper that redirects unauthenticated/unauthorized users.

nodes.label: AdminDashboard Component
nodes.rationale: Admin overview screen with stats widgets.

nodes.rationale: Admin interface for managing the question bank.

nodes.label: RecycleBin Component
nodes.rationale: Lists soft-deleted items retrieved via getTrashItems().

nodes.label: Soft Delete Pattern
nodes.rationale: Uses isActive BOOLEAN flag; soft delete sets isActive=false, recycle bin lists, restore sets isActive=true, deleteById() hard-deletes.

nodes.label: TTL-based Cache
nodes.rationale: Default 30s TTL, long TTL 5min; 3 retry attempts; exponential backoff 100ms base. Invalidated on mutation, admin update, manual refresh, TTL expiry, or auth change.

nodes.label: Pro Content Access Pattern
nodes.rationale: User request -> backend checks isProUser flag -> either grants pro content access or returns upgrade required.

nodes.label: State Management Flow
nodes.rationale: Linear flow: Global State -> Auth Context -> Cache Layer -> Local Storage for persistent app state.

nodes.label: /api/tests routes
nodes.rationale: Test endpoints: GET list/detail/by-series, POST start, PUT submit.

nodes.label: /api/admin routes
nodes.rationale: Admin-only endpoints: stats, analytics, activity-logs, users CRUD, content management (test-series, tests, questions, study-materials, chapters, subject-videos, subject-pdfs, topic-tests).

nodes.label: Test Interface State Machine
nodes.rationale: Auth-protected flow: Instructions -> Test Interface -> Results -> Review, parameterized by /:seriesId/:testId.

nodes.label: Content Creation Workflow
nodes.rationale: Admin -> Create Form -> Validate -> insertOne() to DB -> Cache Update.

nodes.rationale: Helper that queries dbHelpers.find() across chapters, subjectVideos, subjectPdfs, topicTests (plus direct tests) to compute real-time aggregates of {topics, videos, pdf, tests}.

nodes.rationale: Data access layer used by study.js; find() for table lookups, pool.query() for raw SQL aggregates (direct tests count).

Holds question_html/options_array and correct_option fields; correct_option is stripped from client responses.

nodes.rationale: Fields: id (PK), user_id FK, test_id FK, status, score DECIMAL, responses/answers JSONB, time_spent/timeSpent INTEGER, started_at/submitted_at TIMESTAMP, correct/wrong/isCompleted. Records each test attempt.

nodes.rationale: Fields: id (PK), user_id FK, series_id FK, enrolled_at TIMESTAMP, is_active BOOLEAN. Tracks which users are enrolled in which test series. Legacy enrolledSeries array on user also checked for backward compatibility.

nodes.label: leaderboards (PostgreSQL table)
nodes.rationale: Fields: id (PK), test_id FK, rankings JSONB, isPublished BOOLEAN, totalParticipants INTEGER. Stores per-test rankings.

nodes.label: live_tests (PostgreSQL table)
nodes.rationale: Fields: id (PK), test_id FK, startTime TIMESTAMP, endTime TIMESTAMP, status VARCHAR, participants INTEGER. Scheduled live test events.

nodes.label: users (PostgreSQL table)
nodes.rationale: Referenced as parent of attempts/results/enrollments. Has hasProPass BOOLEAN flag and legacy enrolledSeries VARCHAR[] array.

nodes.label: ProtectedRoute (React component)
nodes.rationale: React Router wrapper enforcing authentication for test instructions, interface, result, and review routes.

nodes.label: Auto-submit on timer expiry
nodes.rationale: When timeLeft/timeRemaining reaches 0 the TestInterface triggers autoSubmit. Trade-off: prevents indefinite time abuse while requiring robust local state preservation to avoid data loss on slow network.

nodes.label: Server-side grading / answer stripping
nodes.rationale: Backend strips correct_option/correctAnswer from /api/tests/:id questions payload and computes score on submit. Score = (correct × marksPerQuestion) − (wrong × negativeMarks); floored at 0. Rationale: prevents client-side answer leakage; client cannot tamper with grading.

nodes.label: CSRF token validation
nodes.rationale: csrf_tokens table is whitelisted in postgres-helpers.js. Token validation on attempts and submissions. Defends against cross-site request forgery on test endpoints.

nodes.label: Auto-enrollment flow
nodes.rationale: Logged-in non-enrolled user clicks 'Enroll Now' → POST /api/users/enroll/:seriesId auto-enrolls and returns updated user object with enrolledSeries array. Reduces friction in test series access.

nodes.label: Pro Pass subscription gate
nodes.rationale: If test.isPro && !user.hasProPass, return 403 with 'PRO subscription required'. Pro users unlock all PRO tests; regular users see paywall ('Unlock with Pro Pass' / 'Enroll Now').

nodes.label: Submission fail-safes (network outage, retry, route blocking)
nodes.rationale: Three named fail-safes: (1) Local state holds during network outage; (2) 10-second submit retry loop; (3) Route blocking on browser back. Combined: prevents attempt loss and re-entry mid-test.

nodes.label: Hardcoded demo data with exposed answers
nodes.rationale: PracticeQuestions.jsx lines 47-57 contain fallback demo questions with exposed correctOption values. Documented as a known security vulnerability. Migration plan referenced: Hardcoded Data Migration Plan.html. Resolution: move to server-validated dataset; answers must never ship to the client in cleartext.

nodes.label: Submission Payload (JSON contract)
nodes.rationale: Structure: { attemptId, answers:[{questionId, selected}], timeSpent }. Response payload: { attemptId, testId, seriesId, testTitle, score (≥0), totalMarks, totalQuestions, correct, wrong, unattempted, accuracy, timeSpent, rank, percentile, totalParticipants }.

nodes.label: Timer State (client)
nodes.rationale: Variables: timeLeft/timeRemaining (seconds, integer), setInterval decrement, isPaused flag, warnings (5min, 1min). Drives autoSubmit when 0.

nodes.label: Score Calculation Algorithm
nodes.rationale: marksPerQuestion = totalMarks / totalQuestions (default 2). score = (correct × marksPerQuestion) − (wrong × negativeMarking). accuracy = correct / (correct+wrong) × 100. Final score clamped to ≥0 via Math.max(0, score).

nodes.rationale: Flexible learning graph combining Notion + LMS + Testbook. Everything is a node: Exam, Year, Tier, Subject, Chapter, Topic, Test, Quiz, AI path. ONE TABLE handles ALL.

nodes.label: nodes Table (Core Schema)
nodes.rationale: Core engine table: BIGSERIAL id, public_id UUID, type TEXT, title, slug, parent_id BIGINT (self-ref ON DELETE CASCADE), meta JSONB default '{}', is_active, timestamps. UNIQUE(parent_id, slug).

nodes.label: Node Performance Indexes
nodes.rationale: Critical indexes: idx_nodes_parent, idx_nodes_type, idx_nodes_slug, idx_nodes_parent_slug, idx_nodes_public_id for hierarchical lookups.

nodes.label: Hybrid ID Architecture
nodes.rationale: Internal BIGSERIAL id for joins/foreign keys/performance. External public_id UUID for APIs/frontend/security. Human slug for URLs. Rejected integer-only for external and UUID as primary key.

nodes.label: Hierarchy Model (Exam Tree)
nodes.rationale: Exam > Session > Stage > Category > Subcategory > Test. Stored as self-referencing tree via parent_id. Example: SSC CGL > 2026 > Tier 1 > Quant > Algebra > Mock Test 1.

nodes.label: createNode Function
nodes.rationale: Async node insert: takes {type, title, slug, parentId, meta}, INSERT INTO nodes ... RETURNING *.

nodes.label: resolvePath Function
nodes.rationale: Walks down slug array to find target node. Uses (slug = $1 AND parent_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $2) for NULL-safe parent matching.

nodes.label: Recursive Tree CTE
nodes.rationale: WITH RECURSIVE tree: starts at id, UNION ALL joins children via parent_id. Returns entire subtree.

nodes.label: Catch-all URL Route
nodes.rationale: router.get('/*') splits path into slugs, calls resolvePath, returns 404 or {id, type, title, slug, meta}. Supports arbitrary depth like /ssc-cgl/2026/tier-1/quant/algebra/mock-1.

nodes.label: Node Types (Extensible Enum)
nodes.rationale: exam, session, stage, category, subcategory, subject, chapter, topic, test, quiz, ai_path, revision_plan. New types added without schema change.

nodes.label: Meta System (JSONB)
nodes.rationale: JSONB field on nodes for arbitrary attributes (difficulty, tags, duration, questions, ai_generated). Eliminates schema migrations for new properties.

nodes.label: Redis Caching Strategy
nodes.rationale: Cache keys: node:<slug>, node:<path>, tree:<node_id>. Claims 90% faster navigation and reduces recursive DB calls.

nodes.label: Slug Per Parent Uniqueness
nodes.rationale: UNIQUE(parent_id, slug) constraint. Allows ssc-cgl/2025 and ssc-cgl/2026 (different parents) but forbids two children with same slug under same parent. Rejected numeric suffix patterns like ssc-cgl-2.

nodes.label: Node Engine V1 (Structure)
nodes.rationale: Static graph: nodes, hierarchy, slugs, structure only. Foundation layer.

nodes.label: Node Engine V2 (Intelligence Layer)
nodes.rationale: Dynamic intelligence graph. Adds ai_meta JSONB to nodes (difficulty_score, mastery_score, attempt_count, correct_rate, avg_time, discrimination_index, forgetting_curve, recommendation_weight) and user_node_skill table.

nodes.label: Node Engine V3 (AI Tutor)
nodes.rationale: Conversation + Teaching AI. Per-node AI Tutor Instance, ai_tutor_memory table, Socratic teaching, mistake analyzer, adaptive teaching mode.

nodes.label: Node Engine V4 (Autonomous Education System)
nodes.rationale: Autonomous Teacher + Curriculum Builder + Examiner + Analyst. Adds curriculum_nodes, ai_generated_questions, exam_simulations tables. Modules: Curriculum Engine, Content Generator, Exam Simulator, Prediction Engine, Learning Optimizer. Self-improving feedback loop.

nodes.label: Node Engine V5 (AGI Education System)
nodes.rationale: Autonomous Education AGI. Adds education_world_state, agi_generated_exams, micro_skills tables. Modules: World Model Engine, Exam Generation AGI, Curriculum Evolution AGI, Student Population Simulator, Self-Reflection Engine, AGI Decision Engine.

nodes.label: Node Engine V6 (Multi-Agent Education Civilization)
nodes.rationale: Multi-agent civilization: Student Agents (skill vectors, learning strategies), Teacher Agents (teaching styles, effectiveness), Knowledge Economy (skills=currency, demand=value, mastery=wealth), Exam Events. Meta Governor controls balance.

nodes.label: ai_meta JSONB Structure
nodes.rationale: Per-node AI fields: difficulty_score, mastery_score, attempt_count, correct_rate, avg_time, discrimination_index, last_attempted_at, forgetting_curve {strength, decay}, recommendation_weight.

nodes.label: user_node_skill Table
nodes.rationale: Per-user per-node mastery tracking: mastery_score FLOAT 0-1, confidence_score FLOAT, attempt_count, correct_count, last_attempted_at. UNIQUE(user_id, node_id).

nodes.label: ai_tutor_memory Table
nodes.rationale: Per-user per-node tutor memory: conversation JSONB, last_context, knowledge_gaps, emotional_state, updated_at. UNIQUE(user_id, node_id).

nodes.label: curriculum_nodes Table
nodes.rationale: AI-generated curriculum: exam_id reference, topic, weightage, importance_score, predicted_questions, source ('ai_generated'|'manual'), meta JSONB.

nodes.label: ai_generated_questions Table
nodes.rationale: AI-created questions: node_id, question, options JSONB, answer, difficulty, prediction_score, explanation, source.

nodes.label: exam_simulations Table
nodes.rationale: Predicted exam outcomes: user_id, exam_id, score_predicted, rank_predicted, weak_topics JSONB, strong_topics JSONB.

nodes.label: education_world_state Table
nodes.rationale: V5 global state: global_skill_graph JSONB, difficulty_landscape, exam_evolution, student_distribution, system_insights, updated_at.

nodes.label: agi_generated_exams Table
nodes.rationale: Exams created by AGI: exam_name, pattern JSONB, questions JSONB, difficulty_curve, predicted_success_rate.

nodes.label: micro_skills Table
nodes.rationale: Evolved skills catalog: name, parent_skill, difficulty, emergence_score (novelty/importance).

nodes.label: calculateMastery Function
nodes.rationale: accuracy = correct/total; mastery = min(1, accuracy * speedPenalty). Used by tutor and recommendation engines.

nodes.label: updateDifficulty Function
nodes.rationale: node.ai_meta.difficulty_score = 1 - correctRate. Harder when fewer correct.

nodes.label: getRecommendationScore Function
nodes.rationale: priority = (1-mastery)*0.5 + difficulty*0.3 + freshness*0.2. Surfaces weak/forgotten/high-impact topics.

nodes.label: askTutor Function
nodes.rationale: Core AI tutor entry: load node, memory, userSkill; build prompt; call LLM; persist conversation to memory.

nodes.label: buildTutorPrompt Function
nodes.rationale: Builds Socratic prompt with topic, type, mastery, weak areas, last 5 conversation turns, and rules: diagnose before teach, then example, then practice.

nodes.label: generateCurriculum Function
nodes.rationale: Aggregates past papers, analyzes topic frequency, maps to {topic, weightage, importance_score, predicted_questions}.

nodes.label: generateLearningPath Function
nodes.rationale: Scores all child nodes via getRecommendationScore and sorts descending; output is adaptive path.

nodes.label: generateAdaptiveTest Function
nodes.rationale: Builds test from user's weakNodes; weights question pools by (1 - mastery).

nodes.label: predictRank Function
nodes.rationale: percentile = userScore/maxScore; rank = totalCandidates * (1 - percentile). Estimates rank from predicted score.

nodes.label: simulateExam Function
nodes.rationale: Combines weakAreas + calculateExpectedScore + estimateRank; returns {score, rank, weak_topics}.

nodes.label: updateSystemFromResults Function
nodes.rationale: Feedback loop core: updates node difficulty, question quality, curriculum weights based on student performance.

nodes.label: AGI_decide Function
nodes.rationale: V5 core brain: analyzes world state, decides whether to update curriculum, generate new exam pattern, increase difficulty, introduce new skills, retrain tutor models.

nodes.label: analyzeMistake Function
nodes.rationale: Classifies wrong answer into {error_type: conceptual|calculation|careless, concept_gap, severity, suggestion}.

nodes.label: AI Tutor Engine
nodes.rationale: Teaching brain: Socratic Teaching Model, step-by-step explanations, misconception detection, adaptive hints. Composed of askTutor + buildTutorPrompt + analyzeMistake.

nodes.label: Curriculum Engine (Syllabus Brain)
nodes.rationale: Exam pattern analyzer, topic frequency extractor, weightage calculator, dynamic syllabus builder. Composed of generateCurriculum + curriculum_nodes.

nodes.label: Question Generator (Content Brain)
nodes.rationale: Exam-style question creation, difficulty calibration, trap generation, explanation generator. Backed by ai_generated_questions + generateAIQuestion.

nodes.label: Exam Simulation Engine (Reality Brain)
nodes.rationale: Full mock exams, time pressure simulation, rank prediction, score forecasting. Composed of simulateExam + predictRank + exam_simulations.

nodes.label: Learning Optimizer (Adaptive Brain)
nodes.rationale: Weakness detection, skill graph updates, adaptive learning path, revision scheduling.

nodes.label: Recommendation Engine
nodes.rationale: Identifies weak topics, forgotten topics, high-impact topics via getRecommendationScore + getTimeDecay.

nodes.label: Spaced Repetition Engine
nodes.rationale: Forgetting curve logic: triggers revision when retention decays below threshold.

nodes.label: Mistake Analyzer
nodes.rationale: Every wrong answer becomes structured data: error_type, concept_gap, severity, suggestion. Drives personalized lesson generation.

nodes.label: World Model Engine (Education Simulator)
nodes.rationale: V5 module: models student population distribution, full-system skill graph, difficulty landscape, exam ecosystem, knowledge dependencies. Enables future exam prediction (e.g. 'what SSC will ask in 2027').

nodes.label: Exam Generation AGI (Exam Authority Engine)
nodes.rationale: V5 module: creates entire exams from scratch, defines marking schemes, designs difficulty curves, generates paper patterns, evolves exams over time. Simulated, not authoritative.

nodes.label: Curriculum Evolution AGI
nodes.rationale: V5 module: removes outdated topics, adds emerging patterns, reweights importance dynamically, creates new micro-skills.

nodes.label: Student Population Simulator
nodes.rationale: V5 module: simulates millions of learners, predicts rank distribution, identifies bottlenecks, detects learning collapse points.

nodes.label: Self-Reflection Engine
nodes.rationale: V5 module: analyzes system performance, detects inefficiencies, rewrites own teaching logic, improves curriculum and exams.

nodes.label: AGI Decision Engine
nodes.rationale: Autonomous control center: decides when to teach, when to test, when to revise, when to increase difficulty, when to simulate exam. Driven by AGI_decide function.

nodes.label: Meta Governor
nodes.rationale: V6 AGI control layer: controls curriculum evolution, difficulty scaling, agent spawning, system balance.

nodes.label: Knowledge Economy
nodes.rationale: V6 conceptual layer: skills are currency, demand is value system, mastery is wealth.

nodes.label: Socratic Teaching Method
nodes.rationale: Teaching style: don't give full answer; diagnose misunderstanding first, then teach concept, then similar example, then practice question.

nodes.label: Forgetting Curve Model
nodes.rationale: Per-node forgetting strength + decay parameters. Drives shouldRevise threshold and recommendation freshness component.

nodes.label: Self-Improving Feedback Loop
nodes.rationale: Student Activity -> Performance Analyzer -> Learning Optimizer -> Curriculum Regenerator -> Question Regeneration -> AI Tutor Adaptation -> back to student. What makes V4 'autonomous'.

nodes.label: Education World Model
nodes.rationale: V5 meta-architecture: models Students, Knowledge, Exams, Institutions, Difficulty Space, Global Performance Distribution.

nodes.label: Multi-Layer Tutor System
nodes.rationale: Five-level per-node tutor: Explain, Diagnose, Train, Test, Revise.

nodes.label: AI Orchestration Engine
nodes.rationale: V4 brain layer: Intent Router, Context Builder, Memory Retriever, Tool Selector. Coordinates Tutor/Curriculum/QA/Exam/Memory subsystems.

nodes.label: Supabase RLS Permissive Policy Issue
nodes.rationale: Original trigger: overly permissive RLS policies using WITH CHECK (true) and USING (true) on discussion_replies, doubt_replies, doubts, question_discussions. Effectively bypassed INSERT security.

nodes.label: Card Ordering Behavior Report (HTML Document)
nodes.rationale: Comprehensive analysis of how cards are ordered across all pages in Trstprep V2.0. Merged from Design Documents + Repository Analysis.

nodes.label: Card Ordering System
nodes.rationale: Tech Stack: React 18+ with Vite, TailwindCSS, Node.js + Express Backend, PostgreSQL Database, JWT Authentication. 7+ Frontend Pages, 6 Admin Managers, 8+ DB Tables with Order, 20+ API Endpoints.

nodes.label: AUTO-ORDER Pattern
nodes.rationale: Automatically reorders based on activity/usage data. Examples: Popular Test Series, Top Performers, Leaderboards.

nodes.label: FIXED Pattern
nodes.rationale: Stays in same place regardless of activity. Hardcoded order in component. Examples: Quick Access Grid, Category Tabs, Features Section.

nodes.label: SEMI-DYNAMIC Pattern
nodes.rationale: Fixed structure with dynamic content inside. Examples: Sub-Category Tabs, Subject Performance.

nodes.label: USER-CONTROLLED Pattern
nodes.rationale: User can manually change order via filters/sorting. Examples: Test Series Grid, Attempted Tests.

nodes.label: 4-Layer Ordering Architecture
nodes.rationale: The Card Ordering System uses a 4-layer architecture for flexible content positioning: Visibility Control, Prominence Control, Sequence Control, Fallback Sorting.

nodes.label: Layer 1: Visibility Control
nodes.rationale: Fields: is_visible, is_active, visibility_status. Determines IF content should appear.

nodes.label: Layer 2: Prominence Control
nodes.rationale: Fields: is_pinned, is_featured, priority_weight. Determines HOW PROMINENTLY content appears.

nodes.label: Layer 3: Sequence Control
nodes.rationale: Fields: display_order, sort_mode, section_group. Determines POSITION in list.

nodes.label: Layer 4: Fallback Sorting
nodes.rationale: Fields: created_at, popularity_score, alphabetical. Used when explicit order not set.

nodes.label: Master Sorting Rule (SQL ORDER BY)
nodes.rationale: ORDER BY is_active DESC, is_visible DESC, is_pinned DESC, is_featured DESC, priority_weight DESC, display_order ASC NULLS LAST, created_at DESC. Universal Ordering Query Pattern.

nodes.label: Platform Hierarchy Map
nodes.rationale: Exam Category (SSC, Railways, Banking) -> Exam Sub-Category -> Exam Instance -> Test Series (Tests, Questions) / Study Materials (Chapters, Videos).

nodes.label: Problem: Inconsistent Field Names (CRITICAL)
nodes.rationale: Different tables use different field names: order vs sortOrder vs orderIndex causing developer confusion and bugs.

nodes.label: Problem: Hardcoded Arrays (CRITICAL)
nodes.rationale: Quick Access items hardcoded in Dashboard.jsx and Home.jsx - requires code change to reorder, same order for all users.

nodes.label: Problem: No Bulk Reorder (MEDIUM)
nodes.rationale: Must move items one at a time - time-consuming for admins managing large content libraries.

nodes.label: Problem: No Audit Trail (MEDIUM)
nodes.rationale: Order changes not logged - can't track who changed what and when.

nodes.label: Problem: No User Personalization (MINOR)
nodes.rationale: Users can't customize their view - limited UX flexibility.

nodes.label: Dashboard Page (Dashboard.jsx)
nodes.rationale: apps/frontend/src/pages/dashboard/Dashboard.jsx. Main dashboard shows personalized content after user login. Cards primarily activity-based with some fixed sections.

nodes.label: Exams Page (Exams.jsx)
nodes.rationale: apps/frontend/src/pages/exams/Exams.jsx. Lists exam categories and individual exams. All content is API-driven with some static configurations.

nodes.label: Test Series Page (TestSeries.jsx)
nodes.rationale: apps/frontend/src/pages/tests/TestSeries.jsx. Main test series listing page with multiple sections. Extensive filtering and sorting options. Uses isPinned and order fields.

nodes.label: Test Details Page (TestDetails.jsx)
nodes.rationale: apps/frontend/src/pages/tests/TestDetails.jsx. Shows tests within a specific test series. Two-level navigation (Mock Tests vs PYP).

nodes.label: Home Page (Home.jsx)
nodes.rationale: apps/frontend/src/pages/public/Home.jsx. Landing page with different content for logged-in vs non-logged-in users.

nodes.label: Study Material Page (StudyMaterial.jsx)
nodes.rationale: apps/frontend/src/pages/study/StudyMaterial.jsx. Shows study subjects organized in groups with expandable sections.

nodes.label: DB Table: test_series
nodes.rationale: Order field: order. Additional Fields: is_pinned, users.

nodes.label: DB Table: exam_categories
nodes.rationale: Order field: order. Additional Fields: is_active.

nodes.label: DB Table: exam_sub_categories
nodes.rationale: Order field: order. Additional Fields: parent_category_id.

nodes.label: Admin API: /api/admin/test-series
nodes.rationale: GET (list), POST (create, auto-assigns next order), PUT (update, includes order reordering logic), DELETE (soft delete). File: apps/backend/src/api/routes/admin.js

nodes.label: Admin API: /api/admin/exam-categories
nodes.rationale: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE endpoints. Includes order field.

nodes.label: Admin API: /api/admin/study-materials
nodes.rationale: GET, POST, PUT (includes reordering logic), DELETE endpoints.

nodes.label: Migration Roadmap (5 Phases)
nodes.rationale: Phase 1: Database Schema Updates. Phase 2: Data Backfill. Phase 3: Backend API Implementation. Phase 4: Frontend Updates. Phase 5: Testing & Rollout.

nodes.label: Quick Access Grid (FIXED card)
nodes.rationale: 8-item grid of navigation shortcuts (Live Tests, Quizzes, PYQ, Practice, Analysis, Videos, Attempted, Materials). Always stays in same order - hardcoded array definition in Dashboard.jsx.

nodes.label: Popular Test Series Sort Logic
nodes.rationale: Sort with pinning support: 1) Pinned items first, 2) Among pinned use order field, 3) Non-pinned sorted by users (popularity).

nodes.label: Test Pages Flow Map (Architecture Documentation)
nodes.rationale: Single-page HTML architecture diagram for the Trstprep V2.0 test subsystem covering 14 pages, REST endpoints, PostgreSQL schema, state model and scoring algorithm.

nodes.label: tests.js REST router (GET/POST/PUT endpoints)
nodes.rationale: Backend route module exposing the eight test-related endpoints listed in the API panel.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL on Supabase (40+ tables)
nodes.rationale: Persistence layer for the entire application; test subsystem uses a subset of tables.

nodes.label: test_series table (id PK, title, description, examId FK, isPro, price, totalTests)
nodes.rationale: Series-level metadata and pricing, parent of tests.

nodes.label: tests table (id PK, seriesId FK, title, duration, totalMarks, questions, negativeMarking, isPro, isLive)
nodes.rationale: Concrete test instance including duration, marking scheme and pro/live flags.

nodes.label: questions table (id PK, testId FK, questionText, options JSONB, correctAnswer, explanation, subject, difficulty)
nodes.rationale: Stores MCQ payload with answer key and explanation, returned to client with correctAnswer sanitized.

nodes.label: attempts table (id PK, userId FK, testId FK, seriesId FK, score, correct, wrong, answers JSONB, timeSpent, isCompleted)
nodes.rationale: Persists each test submission with all derived metrics.

nodes.label: leaderboards table (id PK, testId FK, rankings JSONB, isPublished, totalParticipants)
nodes.rationale: Materialized ranking per test, published flag controls visibility.

nodes.label: live_tests table (id PK, testId FK, startTime, endTime, status, participants)
nodes.rationale: Schedules live test windows with participant counters.

nodes.label: Test Interface State (Timer / Answer / Attempt)
nodes.rationale: Three state buckets driving the taking UI: countdown/pause/warnings, answers[]/markedForReview[]/currentQuestion, attemptId/startTime/isSubmitted.

nodes.label: Score Calculation Algorithm (Correct*marks - Wrong*negative, accuracy, rank, percentile)
nodes.rationale: Backend formula in tests.js submit handler. Defaults to 2 marks per question and 0 negative marking when not specified.

nodes.label: Test Interface Step Flow (Auth, Pro, Load, Timer, Submit, Store)
nodes.rationale: Six internal steps from authentication check through Pro gating, question loading (answer sanitization), timer init, submission and persistence.

nodes.label: Glassmorphism UI Style (dark theme, violet/cyan accents, animated orbs)
nodes.rationale: Visual design language used across cards: backdrop-filter blur, gradient-test (violet->indigo), badgePulse and float keyframes.

nodes.label: Node Engine Architecture (V1 to V6)
nodes.rationale: Captures evolution from a simple node-based structure to a full autonomous AI education ecosystem across six versions.

nodes.label: V1 - Core Node Engine
nodes.rationale: Foundational layer where every entity (exam, year, tier, subject, chapter, topic, test, quiz, AI path) is a single unified node in one table.

nodes.label: V2 - Intelligence Layer
nodes.rationale: Adds performance signals and adaptive difficulty on top of V1 static nodes: AI meta, user skill tracking, recommendation, spaced repetition, adaptive tests.

nodes.label: V3 - AI Tutor Engine
nodes.rationale: Shifts from recommendation to conversational Socratic teaching with mistake-driven learning and persistent tutor memory.

nodes.label: V4 - Autonomous Education System
nodes.rationale: Proactive full-syllabus generation, AI-authored questions, dynamic exam creation, and self-improving feedback loop.

nodes.label: V5 - AGI Education System
nodes.rationale: Whole-exam generation, simulated exam authorities, world model of education state, and self-reflective improvement.

nodes.label: V6 - Education Civilization
nodes.rationale: Multi-agent ecosystem with competing AI teachers, student/teacher agents, knowledge economy with tokens, and a meta governor.

nodes.label: nodes (unified hierarchy table)
nodes.rationale: Single Postgres table holding all entity types via a `type` column (exam/session/stage/category/test/topic/ai_path/revision_plan) with parent_id self-reference and JSONB meta/ai_meta/tutor_strategy.

nodes.label: user_node_skill
nodes.rationale: Per-user per-node mastery and confidence scores, attempt counts, weak/strong points JSONB, used by V2 recommendation and spaced repetition.

nodes.label: ai_tutor_memory
nodes.rationale: Persists conversation history, knowledge gaps, emotional/confidence state, and mistake patterns for the V3 AI tutor.

nodes.label: curriculum_nodes
nodes.rationale: V4 stores per-topic weightage, importance, predicted question count and confidence per exam.

nodes.label: ai_generated_questions
nodes.rationale: Stores LLM-authored questions with difficulty, prediction score, quality score, concept_tested, common_mistakes and verified flag.

nodes.label: exam_simulations
nodes.rationale: Persists predicted score, rank, percentile, weak/strong topic JSONB and a generated study_plan per simulation run.

nodes.label: education_world_state
nodes.rationale: V5 global model: skill graph, difficulty landscape, exam evolution, student distribution and a generation counter.

nodes.label: agi_generated_exams
nodes.rationale: V5 stores whole exams produced by the AGI: pattern, questions, difficulty curve, predicted success rate and rank distribution.

nodes.label: micro_skills
nodes.rationale: Tracks micro-skills with emergence_score, trend (emerging/stable/declining) and prerequisite list for V5/V6 evolution.

nodes.label: student_agents
nodes.rationale: V6 student agent: skill_vector, short/long term memory, strategy (aggressive/steady/balanced), total_xp, level, learning_style.

nodes.label: teacher_agents
nodes.rationale: V6 teacher agent: teaching style (socratic/direct/discovery), effectiveness, specializations, adaptability and improvement history.

nodes.label: skill_economy
nodes.rationale: V6 market dynamics per skill: demand, supply, value, trend (rising/stable/falling) and price_history.

nodes.label: student_wealth
nodes.rationale: Holds knowledge_tokens, skill_portfolio, trade_history and achievements for each student.

nodes.label: exam_events
nodes.rationale: Global competition events: mock_exam/competition/challenge with timing, rewards, leaderboard and status.

nodes.label: createNode
nodes.rationale: V1 service that validates the type against an allowlist and inserts a row into the `nodes` table.

nodes.label: resolvePath
nodes.rationale: V1 service that walks an array of slugs to find a node by parent-chain, used by the catch-all route handler.

nodes.label: getNodeWithCache
nodes.rationale: Redis-backed cache wrapper around resolvePath, key `node:slug1/slug2/...`, TTL 1 hour.

nodes.label: calculateMastery
nodes.rationale: V2 mastery = accuracy * timeFactor, capped at 1; the cornerstone of user_node_skill updates.

nodes.label: updateMastery
nodes.rationale: UPSERT into user_node_skill after every attempt, recomputing mastery from cumulative correct/total.

nodes.label: updateNodeDifficulty
nodes.rationale: V2 derives aggregate difficulty as 1 - correct_rate over attempts and writes it into nodes.ai_meta.

nodes.label: generateLearningPath
nodes.rationale: V2 partitions descendant nodes into weak/moderate/strong by score and returns priority/secondary/reinforcement lists.

nodes.label: shouldRevise / getRevisionSchedule
nodes.rationale: Spaced-repetition decision: daysSince > 1/(mastery+0.1), urgency = same denominator.

nodes.label: generateAdaptiveTest
nodes.rationale: V2 builds an adaptive test by distributing questions inversely proportional to mastery across weak nodes.

nodes.label: askTutor
nodes.rationale: V3 orchestrator: gathers node + memory + userSkill, builds a prompt, calls an LLM, parses and saves the exchange.

nodes.label: buildTutorPrompt
nodes.rationale: Composes a Socratic, JSON-formatted prompt that injects the last 5 exchanges, knowledge gaps and teaching strategy.

nodes.label: determineNextLayer (DIAGNOSE..ASSESS)
nodes.rationale: V3 state machine over five tutoring layers: diagnose -> explain -> guide -> practice -> assess -> next_topic.

nodes.label: analyzeMistake
nodes.rationale: V3 classifies errors as conceptual/calculation/careless/misunderstood and returns severity + suggestion.

nodes.label: getTeachingBehavior
nodes.rationale: V3 maps student level (beginner/intermediate/advanced) to explanation depth, hint frequency, example count and encouragement.

nodes.label: generateCurriculum / analyzeFrequency
nodes.rationale: V4 mines past papers to produce weighted curriculum_nodes entries (frequency, relevance, predicted count).

nodes.label: predictQuestions
nodes.rationale: V4 blends historical frequency (40%), recent trend (30%) and importance (30%) to rank topic-level predictions.

nodes.label: generateAIQuestion
nodes.rationale: V4 LLM prompt that emits a JSON question and persists it to ai_generated_questions with concepts and common mistakes.

nodes.label: simulateExam / calculateExpectedScore
nodes.rationale: V4 score formula: sum of topic-level mastery*question_count minus negative marking on assumed 25% wrong.

nodes.label: updateSystemFromResults (self-improving loop)
nodes.rationale: V4 fans out to updateNodeDifficulty, updateQuestionQuality, adjustCurriculumWeights, updateUserSkill after each run.

nodes.label: AGIDecide
nodes.rationale: V5 central brain: returns boolean/intent decisions (update curriculum, retrain tutor, spawn skills) from world-state insights.

nodes.label: simulatePopulation / estimateRank
nodes.rationale: V5 generates 10k synthetic students, scores them, and converts a user score into a percentile-based rank.

nodes.label: selfReflect
nodes.rationale: V5 detects low_mastery/high_dropout/question_quality inefficiencies and applies generated improvements.

nodes.label: civilizationCycle
nodes.rationale: V6 main loop: interactions, learning, exams, performance analysis, economy update, agent evolution, sleep.

nodes.label: tradeSkill
nodes.rationale: V6 knowledge-economy transaction: deducts tokens from buyer, pays 10% creator fee, grants access, updates skill economy.

nodes.label: MetaGovernor
nodes.rationale: V6 system-level controller: evolves curriculum, scales difficulty by global mastery, spawns teachers on demand, balances economy.

nodes.label: Everything is a Node
nodes.rationale: Design principle: a single `nodes` table with `type` discriminates every entity, enabling unlimited hierarchy depth, no schema migrations, and AI-ready meta.

nodes.label: Hybrid IDs (BIGSERIAL + UUID public_id)
nodes.rationale: Integer id for joins, UUID for external APIs to avoid enumeration and support batched migration.

nodes.label: JSONB Flexibility (meta / ai_meta / tutor_strategy)
nodes.rationale: Per-version JSONB columns let new features (intelligence, tutoring) extend nodes without altering the schema.

nodes.label: Catch-all route + slug path resolver
nodes.rationale: Single Express route `/*` splits the URL, runs resolvePath, and returns the node + its children.

nodes.label: Redis caching of resolved paths
nodes.rationale: 1-hour TTL cache keyed by joined slug path drives the >90% cache-hit target and <50ms path resolution SLA.

nodes.label: Recursive CTE for tree and path traversal
nodes.rationale: Postgres WITH RECURSIVE unions for descendants and ancestors of a node, supporting unlimited depth without N+1 queries.

nodes.label: Socratic multi-layer tutor state machine
nodes.rationale: Diagnose -> Explain -> Guide -> Practice -> Assess transitions on success/failure, never giving the full answer up front.

nodes.label: Closed feedback loop (results -> model updates)
nodes.rationale: After every exam, mastery/difficulty/curriculum weights and question quality are recomputed - core to V4 self-improvement and V5 self-reflection.

nodes.label: Knowledge Economy (tokens, supply/demand)
nodes.rationale: V6 models skills as tradeable assets: knowledge_tokens, demand/supply/value, 10% creator fee on each trade.

nodes.label: Multi-agent student/teacher ecosystem

nodes.label: Entity Relationship Flowmap
nodes.rationale: Visual HTML representation of the Topic-Centric Knowledge Graph and platform hierarchy for Trstprep V2.0; uses PostgreSQL/Supabase as the backing store.

nodes.label: Exam (Central Hub Entity)
nodes.rationale: Central hub entity of the Trstprep platform; examples include SSC CGL, RRB NTPC. Acts as parent for all test series, quizzes, and study materials.

nodes.label: Test Series Bundle
nodes.rationale: Bundle of tests organized into stages/tiers; examples include SSC CGL Mock Test Series 2026 (Tier I & Tier II). Hierarchy is defined via dynamic JSONB sections.

nodes.label: Test
nodes.rationale: Individual test in a series (mock, PYP, sectional, or chapter test). Composed of questions, solutions, and analytics.

nodes.label: Quiz
nodes.rationale: Quick practice assessment. Can be exam-scoped (Daily GK Quiz) or topic-scoped (Topic Quizzes, Current Affairs). FK to exams is nullable to support topic-only quizzes.

nodes.label: Study Material
nodes.rationale: Learning resource; includes Notes & PDFs, Video Lessons, Syllabus & Pattern. material_type is an ENUM field.

nodes.label: Question
nodes.rationale: Atomic question unit; tagged with [Subject, Chapter, Topic]. difficulty is an ENUM. Mapped to tests via the test_questions junction table.

nodes.label: Subject
nodes.rationale: Mid-level taxonomy entity; children are Chapters, parent is Exam.

nodes.label: Chapter
nodes.rationale: Granular taxonomy entity; children are Topics, parent is Subject.

nodes.label: Topic
nodes.rationale: Lowest common denominator of the Topic-Centric Knowledge Graph; links Questions, Quizzes, and Study Materials. Every Question is tagged with [Subject, Chapter, Topic].

nodes.label: Topic-Centric Knowledge Graph
nodes.rationale: Architectural decision: although Exam is the parent entity, learning is Topic-Centric. Topics are the lowest common denominator linking content across quizzes, questions, and study materials.

nodes.label: Central Hub Design (Exam as Hub)
nodes.rationale: Visualization/architecture pattern: the Exam sits as the central entity with branches radiating to Test Series, Quizzes, and Study Materials via connection lines.

nodes.label: Dynamic JSONB Sections
nodes.rationale: Data structure decision: test_series.sections is JSONB to allow flexible hierarchy (e.g., Tier I, PYP, Sectional) without schema migrations.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL on Supabase
nodes.rationale: Database technology choice: PostgreSQL hosted on Supabase supports JSONB columns needed for dynamic test-series sections.

nodes.label: test_questions Junction Table
nodes.rationale: Junction table that maps tests to questions in a M:N relationship. test_questions.test_id FK -> tests.id; questions can be reused across tests.

nodes.label: Key API Endpoints
nodes.rationale: Endpoints: GET /api/exams, GET /api/exams/:slug/test-series, GET /api/test-series/:id/tests, GET /api/exams/:slug/quizzes, GET /api/exams/:slug/materials.

nodes.label: One-to-Many (1:N) Relationship
nodes.rationale: Dominant relationship cardinality in the data model. Used for Exam->Test Series, Test Series->Test, Exam->Quiz, Exam->Study Material, Exam->Subject, Subject->Chapter, Chapter->Topic, Topic->Quiz/Question/Study Material.

nodes.label: Many-to-Many (M:N) Relationship
nodes.rationale: Test <-> Question is M:N, resolved through the test_questions junction table so a single question can belong to multiple tests.

nodes.label: Exam > Subject > Chapter > Topic Taxonomy
nodes.rationale: Hierarchical taxonomy forming the backbone of the topic-centric knowledge graph; each level is a 1:N parent of the next.

nodes.label: Category: Auth (CSRF, subscriptions, users)
nodes.rationale: Schema category grouping auth-related tables: csrf_tokens, subscription_features, subscription_plans, subscriptions, users.

nodes.label: Category: Attempts (testing workflow)

nodes.label: Category: Tests (test definitions)

nodes.label: Category: Exams (exam info)
nodes.rationale: Exam metadata: exams, exam_categories, exam_sub_categories, exam_info, exam_static_content, exam_updates, exam_yearly_data, stages.

nodes.label: Category: Community (discussions & doubts)

nodes.label: Category: Quizzes (daily quizzes)
nodes.rationale: Daily quiz tables: daily_quizzes, daily_quiz_questions, daily_quiz_attempts, quizzes.

nodes.label: Category: System (app config, content)
nodes.rationale: App-level config tables: app_settings, assets, banners, faqs, media, navigation_menu, notifications, page_content, testimonials.

nodes.label: Category: User Data (personalized)
nodes.rationale: Per-user state: bookmarks, revision_queue, study_streaks, user_recommendations, user_topic_stats, wrong_questions.

nodes.rationale: UI/platform configuration: platform_stats, quick_access, tag_configs, ui_tag_configs.

nodes.label: Intelligent Content Tagging (P1)

nodes.label: Semantic Search (P1)

nodes.label: Predictive Analytics Dashboard (P2)

nodes.label: Automated Content Quality Scoring (P2)

nodes.label: Smart FAQ Generation (P2)

nodes.label: Adaptive Learning Path Generation (P3)
nodes.rationale: Creates personalized study plans with dynamic difficulty adjustment and prerequisite recommendations.

nodes.label: Voice-to-Question Conversion (P3)
nodes.rationale: Transcribes audio via whisper-1, then converts transcript into a structured MCQ question via gpt-3.5-turbo.

nodes.label: Automated Content Moderation (P3)
nodes.rationale: Detects inappropriate content, validates answer correctness, checks for plagiarism, and flags biased language.

nodes.label: OpenRouter API
nodes.rationale: External unified LLM gateway at https://openrouter.ai/api/v1; OpenAI SDK used with custom baseURL to access multiple model providers.

nodes.label: openai/gpt-4
nodes.rationale: Primary model for question generation and content quality scoring; $0.01/1K input, $0.03/1K output.

nodes.label: openai/gpt-3.5-turbo
nodes.rationale: Lower-cost model for content tagging, FAQ generation, and voice-to-question conversion; $0.001/1K input, $0.002/1K output.

nodes.label: anthropic/claude-3-sonnet
nodes.rationale: Alternative provider model specified for question generation; $0.003/1K input, $0.015/1K output.

nodes.label: openai/text-embedding-ada-002
nodes.rationale: 1536-dim embedding model used for semantic search; $0.0001/1K tokens.

nodes.label: openai/whisper-1
nodes.rationale: Speech-to-text model used to transcribe audio before question conversion.

nodes.label: ai_api_usage Table
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL audit/cost table tracking user_id, model, endpoint, input/output_tokens, cost, and timestamp for every AI call.

nodes.label: study_materials Table (with embedding vector(1536))
nodes.rationale: Stores learning resources; augmented with 1536-dim pgvector embedding column and ivfflat cosine index.

nodes.label: test_attempts Table
nodes.rationale: Stores user test attempts (created_at, score, user_id) used as source data for churn and engagement prediction.

nodes.label: Rate Limiting Pattern
nodes.rationale: Two-layer rate limiting: per-user DB check inside handlers (10/hr) plus express-rate-limit middleware (50/hr) keyed by user id.

nodes.label: AI Input Sanitization Pattern
nodes.rationale: validateAIInput strips HTML, caps length at 10000 chars, and blocks prompt-injection patterns before forwarding to LLM.

nodes.label: AI Output Schema Validation Pattern
nodes.rationale: validateAIOutput enforces a schema and checks for harmful content before returning LLM responses to clients.

nodes.label: pgvector Cosine Similarity Search
nodes.rationale: Uses PostgreSQL pgvector extension with ivfflat (lists=100) cosine-ops indexes for fast nearest-neighbor search.

nodes.label: Structured JSON Prompt Pattern
nodes.rationale: All AI features use temperature-controlled prompts with explicit JSON response_format and an expert system role to enforce structured outputs.

nodes.label: Per-Request Cost Tracking Pattern
nodes.rationale: calculateCost multiplies prompt/completion tokens by per-model rates; results persisted in ai_api_usage for ROI and alerting.

nodes.label: AI API Audit Logging
nodes.rationale: Every AI call persists user, model, endpoint, token, and cost rows to ai_api_usage with indexed lookups by user and time.

nodes.label: Human Review Before Save Pattern
nodes.rationale: AI-generated questions are previewed, edited, and bulk-imported by the admin rather than auto-saved.

nodes.label: Decision: OpenRouter Multi-Provider Abstraction
nodes.rationale: Use OpenRouter via the OpenAI SDK so the same code path can route to gpt-4, gpt-3.5-turbo, claude-3-sonnet, whisper-1, and ada-002.

nodes.label: Decision: pgvector over Dedicated Vector DB

nodes.label: admin.js Router
nodes.rationale: Main Express Router aggregating all admin-facing API endpoints. Mounts split sub-modules and inline CRUD for ~30 resource types under /api/admin.

nodes.label: Defense-in-Depth Middleware Stack
nodes.rationale: 5-layer security pipeline: origin restriction -> API key validation -> JWT auth -> admin role check -> audit logging. Pattern enforces layered security in fixed order.

nodes.label: normalizeFields Middleware (camelCase->snake_case)
nodes.rationale: Applied to POST/PUT/PATCH to convert request fields from camelCase to snake_case before validation, ensuring consistent DB column naming.

nodes.label: Input Validation Schemas (testSeriesSchema, testSchema, questionSchema, userUpdateSchema, categorySchema)
nodes.rationale: Chainable createSchema() instances define required fields, types, enums (mcq/msq/numerical/descriptive, easy/medium/hard), and bounds. Used with validateBody for Issue #29, #31.

nodes.label: CSV/Spreadsheet Parser (parseCsvLine, parseQuestionsCsv, parseQuestionsSpreadsheet, parseJson)
nodes.rationale: Hand-rolled RFC4180-ish CSV parser with quote-escape handling, plus XLSX parsing via xlsx-js-style and JSON fallback. Supports bulk upload of tests/questions.

nodes.label: Bulk Row Payload Mappers (mapBulkRowToQuestionPayload, mapBulkRowToTestPayload)
nodes.rationale: Normalize header variants (option1/option_1/a), apply config fallbacks, slugify titles, parse booleans from yes/true/1 strings, split comma lists for tags/languages.

nodes.label: Asset URL Map Builder (buildAssetUrlMap, attachTestBannerUrls, normalizeAssetRecord, inferAssetCategory)
nodes.rationale: Resolve bannerAssetId/promotionBannerAssetId references to public URLs by joining assets table; infers category (image/video/pdf/document) from mime type.

nodes.label: fetchQuestionsWithRelations (single-query SQL JOIN)
nodes.rationale: FIX Q-02: Single SQL with LEFT JOIN on assets and subjects returns question + imageUrl + subjectName in one query, avoiding N+1 lookups.

nodes.label: Cascade Orphan Flagging Pattern
nodes.rationale: Soft-delete cascades set _orphaned=true, _deletedSeriesId/_deletedTestId/_orphanedExamCategoryId, orphanedAt timestamps so dependent rows can be cleaned up later. Also cleans test_category_series junction.

nodes.label: Stage Resolution Logic (stageIds[] vs deprecated tier)
nodes.rationale: Unifies stage linking: prefer stageIds[] array, fall back to legacy tier string -> stage name match. Logs deprecation warning when tier is used. Stage deletion blocks if any test references it via stageId/tier/stageIds array.

nodes.label: Bulk Test Upload Endpoint (POST /tests/bulk)
nodes.rationale: Accepts CSV/XLSX/JSON file or JSON array, maps each row to test payload, validates testCategoryId against DB, skips bad rows with reasons, then chunked insertMany in CHUNK_SIZE=500 batches to avoid PG parameter limits (FIX BUG-029).

nodes.label: CSV Export Streaming (tests/export, questions/export)
nodes.rationale: Streams CSV with BOM for Excel UTF-8 support, batches 1000 rows, joins test_questions junction to flatten test_id references for question export.

nodes.label: update_study_material_counts SQL Procedure
nodes.rationale: Database function called after any chapter/video/pdf/topicTest mutation to recompute material aggregates server-side.

nodes.label: sanitizeUser (SEC-12 PII Sanitization)
nodes.rationale: Strips password, emailVerificationToken, resetPasswordToken etc. from any user object before sending to client. Applied to /users, /enrollments, /users/:id/pro-pass, /users/:id/role responses.

nodes.label: Privilege Escalation Guard (PUT /users/:id/role)
nodes.rationale: Blocks self-demotion, requires super_admin for promoting/demoting between admin and user roles, logs blocked attempts to audit_logs with action='privilege_escalation_attempt'.

nodes.label: Session Management Endpoints
nodes.rationale: Admin view of all user_sessions, revoke sessions, update session limit. Uses invalidateSession service which emits WebSocket event. Joins users for name/email/role context.

nodes.label: Enrollments Aggregator (GET /enrollments)
nodes.rationale: Builds per-user enrollment record by merging enrollments, testSeries, studyMaterials, exams, subscriptionPlans; computes passLabel/passBadge (Pro Yearly/Monthly/Free) from plan.period. Skips users with no enrollments.

nodes.label: Paginated Results Endpoint (FIX B10)
nodes.rationale: Uses SQL LIMIT/OFFSET + COUNT(*) for attempts, with LEFT JOIN users for name/email. Capped at 500/page. Maps snake_case and camelCase column variants to single output.

nodes.label: Unified Asset Management (/assets, /media aliases)
nodes.rationale: Single listAssets/handleAssetUpload logic exposed at both /assets and /media for backward compat. Supports category/type/search filters, pagination, soft delete with file cleanup via deleteStoredAssetFile.

nodes.label: Hierarchical Test Categories (self-referential parentId)
nodes.rationale: testCategories form a tree via parentId; level computed as parent.level+1; GET /path traverses ancestors for breadcrumbs; junction table test_category_series maps many-to-many with testSeries. delete recursively soft-deletes descendants.

nodes.label: Stage Aggregates (Stage.getAggregatesForStage)
nodes.rationale: Combines testCategories, tests, testSeries to compute categoryCount/seriesCount/testCount for each stage; resolves linked exams via coerceIdArray + idEquals.

nodes.label: Exams CRUD (POST/PUT/DELETE /exams)
nodes.rationale: Unified subcategory-as-exam model. Validates parentCategoryId/examId uniqueness, looks up category to enrich response with parentCategoryName/Icon.

nodes.label: Exam Seasons (year-wise exam sessions)
nodes.rationale: Year-tagged season records (notificationDate, applicationStartDate, examDate, resultDate, vacancyTotal, status) per exam.

nodes.label: SQL-Aggregated Analytics (FIX H2, B11)
nodes.rationale: Replaces in-memory aggregations with SQL GROUP BY/COUNT/AVG on users/attempts. Computes daily users/tests, top tests, user growth rate vs previous period, avg completion rate, avg score.

nodes.label: Deep Analytics (Funnel, Cohort, Engagement)
nodes.rationale: Funnel: registered->enrolled->attempted->completed->pro with conversion rates. Cohort: monthly user retention CTE. Engagement: composite score = testsCompleted*10 + avgScore*0.5 + bookmarks*2 + enrollments*5 bucketed into low/slightly/moderately/engaged/highly_engaged.

nodes.label: Real-Time Dashboard (active-users, test-activity, revenue, system-health, live-feed)
nodes.rationale: Live activity rollups (5min/30min/1hr windows), hourly 24-bucket series, completion rate, avg score, top enrolled series. Revenue assumed as proUsers*999 INR (proPassPrice).

nodes.label: System Health Endpoint (DB+Redis+CPU+Memory+Disk)
nodes.rationale: Combined health check: SELECT 1 latency, redis getRedisStatus, os.cpus/loadavg/totalmem/freemem, execSync of wmic (win32) or df -k for disk usage. Two routes: /system-health and /health (alias).

nodes.label: Database Backup System (pg_dump + SQL fallback)
nodes.rationale: Strategy 1: pg_dump -F c binary dump (preferred). Strategy 2 fallback: hand-built SQL INSERT statements for 35 tables when pg_dump unavailable. Restore via pg_restore or psql -f. Files written to ./backups dir.

nodes.label: Curriculum Hierarchy CRUD (subjects/units/chapters/topics/subtopics)
nodes.rationale: Generated routes for 5 entity types via curriculumCrudRoutes array. Each GET uses optimized SQL with explicit column projection (public_id as id, snake->camel) avoiding 10MB+ payloads. /chapters uses hard delete (dbHelpers.deleteById), others soft delete.

nodes.label: Curriculum Orphan Detection (ISSUE CU-03)
nodes.rationale: Detects units/chapters/topics/subtopics whose parent FK points to a missing record, with descriptive orphanedReason strings.

nodes.label: RBAC Role System (super_admin, admin, content_manager, support, viewer)
nodes.rationale: Default 5 roles with permission arrays. System roles (isSystem=true) cannot be modified or deleted. /permissions lists resource:action matrix (users/tests/questions/content/media/analytics/settings/roles/audit_logs).

nodes.label: Audit Log System (audit_logs table + auditMiddleware)
nodes.rationale: GET /audit-logs with filter+paginated SQL (action/tableName/userId/startDate/endDate), /stats endpoint, /export/csv (limited to 10000 rows). /:id must be registered after /stats and /export/csv to avoid route shadowing.

nodes.label: Email Templates (with defaults fallback)
nodes.rationale: 5 default templates (welcome_email, test_result, password_reset, subscription_confirmation, exam_reminder) returned when email_templates table query fails. /test endpoint logs instead of actually sending.

nodes.label: Test SMTP Email Endpoint
nodes.rationale: Validates SMTP config (host/port/username/password/fromEmail), creates nodemailer transporter, calls verify() then sendMail. Fallback returns 'looks valid' if nodemailer not installed.

nodes.label: Questions Bulk Reorder (POST /questions/bulk-reorder)
nodes.rationale: Validates question IDs against test_questions junction when testId provided, then UPDATE questions SET question_number, order_index for all in parallel via Promise.all.

nodes.label: Question Conversion (Practice <-> Test) (FIX PQ-01)
nodes.rationale: Toggles is_practice flag. When converting to test, requires testId and INSERTs into test_questions junction. When to practice, DELETEs from junction. Bulk version via single UPDATE WHERE id IN (...).

nodes.label: Unified Chapter Resources View
nodes.rationale: GET /chapters/:id/resources returns chapter + videos + pdfs + notes (filtered by keywords 'note'/'handout'/'lecture note') + topic tests + related quizzes in single payload with counts.

nodes.label: Tests Bulk Reassign (POST /tests/bulk-reassign)
nodes.rationale: Validates target testSeries/stage/testCategory exist, then per-test updateById with new seriesId/stageId/testCategoryId/category/subCategory.

nodes.label: Stage-Category Linking (PUT /stages/:id/categories)
nodes.rationale: Operations: add/remove/replace categoryIds[] on a stage with dedup via Set.

nodes.label: Test Series Bulk Operations (POST /test-series/bulk-operation)
nodes.rationale: Operations: bulk-update, bulk-delete, bulk-toggle-active, bulk-toggle-pro, bulk-add-stages, bulk-remove-stages. Iterates seriesIds array calling updateById/softDelete.

nodes.label: Profile.jsx (React Page Component)
nodes.rationale: Main React page component for the user Profile dashboard, 2060 lines, integrates profile view, settings, exam enrolment and Pro Pass subscription UI.

nodes.label: Profile Component (root)

nodes.label: SettingsContent Component

nodes.label: ToggleSwitch Reusable Component
nodes.rationale: Reusable iOS-style switch used by notification and privacy toggles.

nodes.label: SectionLabel Reusable Component
nodes.rationale: Section heading row with optional right-aligned element (e.g., PRO badge).

nodes.label: Cell Reusable Component
nodes.rationale: Generic list-row component (icon, label, sub, right slot, danger flag) used throughout settings lists.

nodes.label: CompactFeatureCard Reusable Component
nodes.rationale: Feature card with optional 'coming soon' overlay and Pro/New badge.

nodes.label: useAuth Context Hook
nodes.rationale: Imported from shared/providers/AuthContext; provides user, refreshUser, logout.

nodes.label: useTheme Context Hook
nodes.rationale: Imported from shared/context/ThemeContext; provides isDarkMode, toggleDarkMode.

nodes.label: useProPass Custom Hook
nodes.rationale: Custom hook returning subscription state (isActive, isAdmin, isExpired, remainingDays, formattedExpiry, isExpiringWithin, statusText, isProUser).

nodes.label: useCustomPopup Hook
nodes.rationale: Provides showAlert and showConfirm modal helpers used for destructive confirmations and errors.

nodes.label: userStats state shape
nodes.rationale: Aggregated stats { testsAttempted, avgAccuracy, rank, timeSpent, streak, improvement } sourced from analytics API or fall back to user.* fields.

nodes.label: editForm state shape
nodes.rationale: Editable profile fields { name, phone, dateOfBirth, location, education, bio }.

nodes.label: personalInfo state shape
nodes.rationale: Read-only view of personal details { fullName, email, phone, dateOfBirth, location, education }.

nodes.label: privacy state shape
nodes.rationale: Privacy settings { profileVisibility: public|friends|private, showProgress, showOnLeaderboard, allowMessages }.

nodes.label: notifications state shape
nodes.rationale: Notification preferences { email, push, sms, testReminders, promotional, weeklyReport }.

nodes.label: statesAndCities lookup
nodes.rationale: Hard-coded India state→cities→pincode map (Maharashtra, Delhi, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Gujarat, Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal).

nodes.label: cropperState state shape
nodes.rationale: Image cropper modal state { isOpen, src (dataURL), type: 'avatar'|'banner' }.

nodes.label: enrolledExams computed state
nodes.rationale: Map of enrolled exams aggregating series count, testsDone, totalTests keyed by exam id.

nodes.label: enrolledTestSeries state
nodes.rationale: List of test series with derived done, tests, completed flags.

nodes.label: attemptRows state
nodes.rationale: Raw user attempts used by getSeriesAttemptCount to count unique test attempts per series.

nodes.label: sessions state shape
nodes.rationale: Active sessions list { id, sessionId, device, browser, os, ip, location, lastActive }.

nodes.label: Tab-based UI navigation
nodes.rationale: Top-level tabs (personal, exams, features, pro, settings) with nested settings sub-tabs (security, notifications, privacy, appearance) plus nested billing Pro state UI.

nodes.label: Optimistic UI with rollback on API failure
nodes.rationale: Notification and privacy toggles update local state immediately then revert (setNotifications(notifications)/setPrivacy(previousPrivacy)) on API error.

nodes.label: localStorage UI persistence
nodes.rationale: Persists trstprep_profileTab, trstprep_navMode, trstprep_language between sessions; nav mode change triggers full window.location.reload().

nodes.label: React Portal Modals
nodes.rationale: Sessions, Photo Options, Unenroll Confirm and Location modals rendered via react-dom createPortal to document.body to escape overflow containers.

nodes.label: Image cropping flow for avatar/banner
nodes.rationale: FileReader → base64 → ImageCropperModal with aspect 1 (round) for avatar and 3 (rect) for banner, then upload via userAPI.updateProfile.

nodes.label: User data JSON export
nodes.rationale: Parallel fetch of profile/attempts/analytics, build JSON Blob, trigger client download via temporary anchor click; URL.revokeObjectURL cleanup.

nodes.label: Promise.all parallel data loading
nodes.rationale: Fetches analytics, exams, enrolled series and attempts in parallel with .catch fallbacks for resilience.

nodes.label: Mouse-drag horizontal tab scroll
nodes.rationale: Custom mouse handlers compute walk distance to scroll the tab strip and prevent click events after a drag.

nodes.label: Pro Pass subscription state model
nodes.rationale: Four mutually exclusive states: isAdmin / isActive / isExpired / free — each renders a distinct status card with renewal/upgrade CTAs.

nodes.label: Profile completion percentage
nodes.rationale: Counts 9 fields (fullName, email, phone, dateOfBirth, location, education, avatar, banner, bio) and renders progress bar.

nodes.label: Password validation rules
nodes.rationale: Requires current password, new password ≥ 8 chars and confirm-match; on success logs the user out and redirects to /login.

nodes.label: 5MB image upload limit
nodes.rationale: Both avatar and cover uploads enforce 5MB max via file.size > 5*1024*1024 check.

nodes.label: Indian phone number validation
nodes.rationale: Regex /^[6-9]\d{9}$/ enforces 10-digit Indian mobile number starting with 6-9.

nodes.label: Session revoke flow
nodes.rationale: userAPI.revokeSession(sessionId) with optimistic removal by id or sessionId, plus confirmation dialog.

nodes.label: Exam/Series unenrollment flow
nodes.rationale: showUnenrollConfirm carries { type: 'exam'|'series', item }; after confirm calls userAPI.unenrollFromSeries and optimistically removes from local state.

nodes.label: userAPI service methods
nodes.rationale: Consumed methods: updateProfile, deleteAccount, getProfile, getAttempts, getAnalytics, getSessions, revokeSession, getEnrolledSeries, unenrollFromSeries.

nodes.label: authAPI.changePassword
nodes.rationale: Used in handlePasswordSave; on success forces logout and navigates to /login.

nodes.label: ImageCropperModal shared component
nodes.rationale: Reusable cropping UI accepting isOpen, imageSrc, onClose, onCropComplete, aspect, cropShape ('round'/'rect'), title.

nodes.label: shared/lib/dataService module
nodes.rationale: Source of getUserAnalytics, getTestSeries, userAPI, getExams, authAPI used throughout.

nodes.label: user object (auth context)
nodes.rationale: Shape: id, name, email, phone, dateOfBirth, location, education, bio, avatar, banner, hasProPass, attemptedTests, notificationPreferences, privacy, isActive, testsTaken, accuracy, bestRank, hoursSpent, streak, improvement, createdAt.

nodes.label: Architectural rationale: monolithic page with embedded sub-components
nodes.rationale: Despite 2060 lines, the file co-locates Profile, SettingsContent and small UI primitives (ToggleSwitch, SectionLabel, Cell, CompactFeatureCard) to keep related state, refs and modals in a single closure — trading modularity for fewer prop-drilling and re-render concerns.

nodes.label: QuestionsManager React Component

nodes.label: QUESTION_CATEGORIES (4-tab config)
nodes.rationale: Configuration of 4 question category tabs: mock-tests, pyp (Previous Year Papers), practice (Practice & Quiz), audit (Incomplete drafts) each with icon, gradient, color tokens

nodes.label: QUESTION_CAT_TO_TEST_CAT_MAP
nodes.rationale: Maps frontend question category IDs (mock-tests, pyp, practice) to backend test category names (Mock Tests, PYPs, Practice) used in tests table

nodes.label: QUESTION_CATEGORY_ALIASES
nodes.rationale: Provides multiple alias strings for each question category to enable fuzzy matching of DB category values

nodes.label: normalizeQuestion() data normalizer
nodes.rationale: Coerces backend field names (snake_case) and locale variants (text.en) to canonical camelCase question shape with defaults

nodes.label: coerceArray() utility
nodes.rationale: Defensive parser: converts strings, PostgreSQL array literals, JSON arrays, or scalar values into JS array form

nodes.label: flattenCategories() tree walker
nodes.rationale: Recursively flattens hierarchical category tree into a flat list with resolved parentId

nodes.label: buildTestCategoryRefs()
nodes.rationale: Builds a Set of normalized reference values for a question category, including aliases, mapped DB names, and descendant categories via BFS traversal

nodes.label: buildCategorySelectionRefs()
nodes.rationale: Builds reference set for a selected sub-category and recursively adds all its descendants to support hierarchical filtering

nodes.label: valueMatchesRefs() matcher
nodes.rationale: Generic helper that checks if any value in a list matches a reference Set via exact or normalized key

nodes.label: Hierarchical drill-down navigation
nodes.rationale: Four-level navigation: audit -> test-series -> tests -> questions driven by drillLevel state. Replaces flat table view with progressive disclosure

nodes.label: TEST_CAT_TO_QUESTION_CAT (reverse map)
