nodes.label: normalizeKey() string normalizer
nodes.rationale: Lowercases, trims, replaces non-alphanumerics with dashes, strips leading/trailing dashes for fuzzy ID matching

nodes.label: Soft delete with undo toast
nodes.rationale: handleDelete uses withUndo() to call deleteQuestion, surface toast with undo, and re-add on undo via /restore endpoint

nodes.label: Incomplete question audit
nodes.rationale: Detects questions missing text/options/correct-answer or in draft status, displayed under 'audit' tab with diagnostic badges

nodes.label: Deep link via ?testId query param
nodes.rationale: useEffect on searchParams auto-selects test, series, exam, stage, and category tabs to match incoming testId deep link

nodes.label: Question pagination (BUG-011 fix)
nodes.rationale: Slides filteredTestQuestions into 20-item pages with first/prev/page-numbers/next/last navigation buttons

nodes.label: Bulk question operations
nodes.rationale: Promise.all-based parallel bulk update for status change, delete, and move-to-test across selectedQuestions Set

nodes.label: CSV bulk import
nodes.rationale: FormData upload via adminAPI.bulkUploadQuestions with testId/testSeriesId/section context appended from drill-down state

nodes.label: CSV question export
nodes.rationale: Blob download via /api/admin/questions/export with selectedTestId and activeCategory query params, triggers client-side CSV download link

nodes.label: Trash view and restore
nodes.rationale: loadTrashedQuestions fetches /api/admin/trash filtered to collection='questions'; handleRestoreQuestion PUTs to /restore and refreshes active questions

nodes.label: QUESTION_TYPES enum
nodes.rationale: Defines supported question kinds: mcq, msq (multi-select), numeric, descriptive with display labels

nodes.label: DIFFICULTY_LEVELS enum
nodes.rationale: Three-level difficulty scale (easy/medium/hard) with Tailwind color tokens for badges

nodes.label: STATUS_OPTIONS enum
nodes.rationale: Question lifecycle states: active, draft, disabled with semantic color tokens

nodes.label: DEFAULT_FORM_DATA initial form state
nodes.rationale: Canonical empty form shape with mcq type, mock-tests category, 4 empty options, draft status; merged on edit and reset

nodes.label: Zod form validation via questionSchema
nodes.rationale: handleSubmit calls validateForm(questionSchema, data) and aborts on first error; pulled from shared/validationSchemas

nodes.label: Keyboard shortcut hook integration
nodes.rationale: useKeyboardShortcuts wires onSave (form submit), onNew (open form), onClose to QuestionsManager lifecycle

nodes.label: Parallel data fetch with Promise.allSettled
nodes.rationale: Fetches 11 resources (questions, subjects, chapters, topics, passages, series, tests, categories, stages, sections, tags) in parallel and aggregates per-source errors into toast

nodes.label: Selected path breadcrumb display
nodes.rationale: Renders exam category > exam > series > stage > active category > test subcategory as visual breadcrumb with ChevronRight separators

nodes.label: Section count seeding
nodes.rationale: sectionCounts Map is seeded with DB-defined test sections (so empty sections appear in filter UI) then incremented by question occurrences

nodes.label: Active category scoped stats
nodes.rationale: categoryStats memo computes total/active/draft/mcq counts only for questions matching activeTestCategoryRefs or tests in that category

nodes.label: QuestionForm component (imported)
nodes.rationale: Imported sibling component that renders the create/edit question modal; receives formData, sets, and lookups (subjects/chapters/topics/passages) as props

nodes.label: BulkImportModal component (imported)
nodes.rationale: Imported CSV upload dialog with testTitle/section context; onImport callback wires to handleBulkImport FormData uploader

nodes.label: BulkActionsBar component (imported)
nodes.rationale: Imported action bar rendered when questions are multi-selected (note: imported but bulk actions appear implemented inline in render)

nodes.label: postgres-helpers.js
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL helper module providing connection pooling, schema initialization, CRUD, public_id generation, soft delete, and FK reconciliation for the TestPrep backend.

nodes.label: PostgresHelpers class
nodes.rationale: Main class wrapping a pg Pool with CRUD helpers (find, findById, findOne, findByPublicId, insertOne, updateById, deleteById, softDelete), schema init, and FK reconciliation.

nodes.label: pg.Pool
nodes.rationale: node-postgres Pool configured with DATABASE_URL, SSL rejectUnauthorized, connectionTimeoutMillis=10000, idleTimeoutMillis=30000, query_timeout=30000, max=20.

nodes.label: ENTITY_PREFIXES registry
nodes.rationale: Frozen map from entity name to public_id prefix (e.g., users->usr_, tests->tst_, subjects->subj_ to avoid collision with subscriptions->subs_).

nodes.label: PUBLIC_ID_PATTERNS regex registry
nodes.rationale: Frozen map of regex patterns validating prefixed UUID format per entity type (e.g., /^usr_[0-9a-f]{8}-...UUID...$/i).

nodes.label: JSONB_COLUMNS registry
nodes.rationale: Frozen map of JSONB columns per table (e.g., tests.languages, attempts.answers, users.notification_preferences) that must be stringified before insert/update.

nodes.label: TIMESTAMP_COLUMNS registry
nodes.rationale: Frozen map of timestamp columns per table where empty strings must be converted to NULL (tests.coming_soon_date, users.pro_expiry, live_tests.start/end_time, pro_passes).

nodes.label: RELATIONSHIP_DEFINITIONS
nodes.rationale: Frozen array of FK definitions (table, column, foreignTable, foreignColumn, constraintName, onDelete, indexName) used by ensureForeignKey to reconcile schema relationships.

nodes.label: parsePositiveInt helper
nodes.rationale: Parses env values to a finite positive int or returns a fallback; used for PG pool timeout/max configuration.

nodes.label: quoteIdentifier
nodes.rationale: Wraps SQL identifiers in double quotes and escapes embedded quotes to prevent SQL identifier injection in dynamic DDL/DML.

nodes.label: prepareDbValues
nodes.rationale: Transforms a row by stringifying JSONB columns (via JSONB_COLUMNS) and converting empty timestamp strings to NULL (via TIMESTAMP_COLUMNS) prior to insert/update.

nodes.label: stringifyJsonbValue
nodes.rationale: JSON.stringify objects/arrays (except Date) for PostgreSQL JSONB; returns other values unchanged.

nodes.label: ensureTestSectionsSchema migration
nodes.rationale: Idempotent migration that creates test_sections table, adds tests.section_id, test_questions.section_id, and attempts.section_scores/section_times JSONB columns.

nodes.label: singleton-promise pattern
nodes.rationale: Module-level Promise cache ensures ensureTestSectionsSchema runs at most once; on error the cache is cleared to allow retry.

nodes.label: tableMap (collection -> table)
nodes.rationale: Maps camelCase JS collection names to snake_case PostgreSQL table names (e.g., testSeries->test_series, studyMaterials->study_materials, videos/pdfs->study_materials).

nodes.label: columnExistsCache
nodes.rationale: In-memory Map caching information_schema.columns lookups keyed by `${tableName}.${columnName}` to avoid repeated catalog queries.

nodes.label: UUID + GENERATED public_id pattern
nodes.rationale: public_id is a GENERATED ALWAYS AS ('prefix_' || public_id_uuid::text) STORED column; inserts only need to set public_id_uuid (UUID) and the prefixed string is computed.

nodes.label: USE_PUBLIC_ID kill switch
nodes.rationale: shouldUsePublicId returns false only if USE_PUBLIC_ID env is 'false', enabling instant rollback from prefixed public_ids to integer ids without DB migration.

nodes.label: Soft delete pattern (Migration 008)
nodes.rationale: softDelete sets isActive=false, is_deleted=true, deleted_by=userId, deleted_at=now via updateById; falls back to hard delete on failure.

nodes.label: Trash/restore pattern
nodes.rationale: getTrashItems/restoreFromTrash/deleteFromTrash/emptyTrash iterate a fixed collection list scanning for isActive=false records.

nodes.label: ensureForeignKey reconciler
nodes.rationale: Verifies both columns exist, inspects existing FK via information_schema, optionally drops mismatched FKs (dropIfMismatch), counts orphans, and adds FK with onDelete/onUpdate and supporting index.

nodes.label: reconcileRelationships
nodes.rationale: Iterates RELATIONSHIP_DEFINITIONS calling ensureForeignKey, returning the count of newly added FKs.

nodes.label: initTables (auto-migration)
nodes.rationale: Numbered (0-10) idempotent schema initialization using CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS and ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS wrapped in DO $$ ... $$ blocks; also creates study group tables, CSRF tokens, and GIN indexes.

nodes.label: withTransaction
nodes.rationale: Acquires a client, runs BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK around the callback, and releases the client in finally.

nodes.label: toCamel / toSnake converters
nodes.rationale: Case conversion between JS camelCase object keys and SQL snake_case columns; toCamel additionally mirrors id into _id for legacy callers.

nodes.label: Mongo-like query operators
nodes.rationale: find/deleteMany support $gt, $lt, $gte, $lte, $in operators; null is rendered as IS NULL; non-numeric UUID-shaped id values are skipped to avoid bad casts.

nodes.label: resolveInternalId
nodes.rationale: Resolves a public_id (prefixed UUID) or numeric id string to the internal integer id used by FK columns.

nodes.label: resolveForeignKeys
nodes.rationale: Before insert/update, walks RELATIONSHIP_DEFINITIONS for the table and replaces any string FK value matching a public_id pattern with the resolved internal integer id.

nodes.label: ensureGinIndex
nodes.rationale: Creates GIN indexes (CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ... USING GIN) for JSONB/array columns to optimize containment and membership queries.

nodes.label: SSL configuration (CRIT-01)
nodes.rationale: Pool SSL is {rejectUnauthorized: !isDev} unless PG_SSL_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED='false' explicitly opts out; production requires cert validation.

nodes.label: testConnection
nodes.rationale: Runs SELECT NOW() with optional exponential backoff (sleep(baseDelayMs * attempt)) for maxAttempts retries.

nodes.label: Curriculum hierarchy
nodes.rationale: subjects (self-referential parent_id) -> subject_parts -> units -> chapters -> topics -> subtopics; each level has stage_ids INTEGER[] for stage filtering.

nodes.label: Question versioning
nodes.rationale: question_versions stores historical versions; attempt_question_snapshots freezes question content per attempt; question_attempts.question_version_id FK provides analytics tie-in.

nodes.label: Study group collaboration
nodes.rationale: study_groups, study_group_members, group_messages (with self-referential reply_to), group_posts, group_post_comments, group_post_likes schema for collaborative learning.

nodes.label: Audit and security logging
nodes.rationale: audit_logs (admin actions with old_values/new_values), activity_logs, attempt_events (anti-cheat), login_attempts (brute force), user_sessions, csrf_tokens.

nodes.label: is_practice flag (PQ-01/PQ-02 fix)
nodes.rationale: Added explicit is_practice BOOLEAN column to questions, backfilled from category='practice' or NULL test_id, replacing fragile null-testId detection.

nodes.label: parseNumericId util (imported)
nodes.rationale: Imported from ../../shared/utils/db-utils.js; converts id-like strings to integers or returns null.

nodes.label: CurriculumBuilder (React Component)
nodes.rationale: Default-exported top-level React component that manages tiered curriculum hierarchy (Subject -> Unit -> Chapter -> Topic -> Subtopic) for the admin panel.

nodes.label: Toast (Notification Component)
nodes.rationale: Internal presentational component for transient success/error/info notifications; auto-dismisses after 4 seconds via setTimeout.

nodes.label: HIERARCHY_TABS (Tab Config Constant)
nodes.rationale: Static array configuring the six sub-tabs (subjects, units, chapters, topics, subtopics, hierarchy) shown in the curriculum builder.

nodes.label: CHAPTER_CONTENT_TABS (Chapter Tabs Config)
nodes.rationale: Defines the four resource sub-tabs inside a chapter view: videos, pdfs, notes, tests/quizzes, each with an icon and empty-state text.

nodes.label: LEVEL_EMOJI (Level Icon Map)
nodes.rationale: Maps each curriculum level ID to a unicode emoji glyph for visual decoration in cards and hierarchy view.

nodes.label: ICON_NAME_TO_EMOJI (Lucide Icon Map)
nodes.rationale: Maps lucide-react icon names (kebab/snake case) to emoji fallbacks when no real image URL is provided for a subject/unit/chapter.

nodes.label: Curriculum Hierarchy (5-level data model)
nodes.rationale: Conceptual entity: Subject -> Unit -> Chapter -> Topic -> Subtopic. Chapters can also be 'direct chapters' (skipping the Unit level). IDs are matched across `id`, `_id`, and `public_id` to support both numeric DB ids and public-facing slugs.

nodes.label: naturalCompare (Sort Comparator)
nodes.rationale: Wrapper around `String.localeCompare` with `numeric: true` so embedded numbers are compared naturally ('Unit 2' < 'Unit 10').

nodes.label: sortByOrderAndId (Stable Sort)
nodes.rationale: Sorts curriculum items by `orderIndex` (or `order_index`) ascending, breaking ties via natural name sort and finally numeric entity id.

nodes.label: entityMatchesParentId (Parent Lookup Helper)
nodes.rationale: Returns true if an entity's id/_id/public_id equals the supplied parentId string after normalization; used throughout filtering logic.

nodes.label: ID Normalization (camelCase + snake_case)
nodes.rationale: Accessor helpers (`getUnitSubjectId`, `getChapterUnitId`, `getChapterSubjectId`, `getTopicChapterId`, `getSubtopicTopicId`, `getOrderIndex`) accept BOTH camelCase and snake_case keys from backend responses to support legacy data.

nodes.label: loadData (Async Data Fetcher)
nodes.rationale: Parallel-fetches subjects/units/chapters/topics/subtopics in a single Promise.all. Accepts a `silent` flag to avoid the full-page spinner on mutation-driven refreshes (preserves tree stability).

nodes.label: Hierarchical Filter Chain
nodes.rationale: useMemo-based cascade: filteredSubjects -> filteredUnits -> filteredChapters -> filteredTopics -> filteredSubtopics. Each stage only returns the rows whose parent ID set belongs to the previous stage, and the cascade also accepts chapters directly under a subject.

nodes.label: hierarchyTree (Nested Tree Builder)
nodes.rationale: useMemo that produces a nested `{ units: [...with chapters[...with topics[...with subtopics]]], directChapters: [...] }` tree from the filtered lists, using Map-based grouping keyed by normalized id.

nodes.label: openChapterView (Chapter Modal Loader)
nodes.rationale: Opens the chapter detail modal: builds a nested topics/subtopics list, derives notes from PDFs by type/keyword (CU-02 fix), and parallel-fetches videos/pdfs/topic-tests/quizzes.

nodes.label: handleReorder (Sibling Swap)
nodes.rationale: CB2 fix: reorders siblings inside a tab by swapping their orderIndex values via two parallel PUT requests. Disabled for 'subjects' and 'hierarchy' tabs.

nodes.label: handleReorderResource (Resource Swap)
nodes.rationale: Reorders videos/pdfs/notes/tests inside a chapter via PUT /reorder endpoint. Performs an optimistic swap in local state before the network call, and recomputes the derived notes list when PDFs move.

nodes.label: validateSlug (Slug Uniqueness)
nodes.rationale: CU-04 fix: useCallback that returns an error string if the entered slug collides with any existing item in the current tab (excluding the item currently being edited).

nodes.label: getDeleteDependencySummary
nodes.rationale: Computes a human-readable count of nested dependents (units/chapters/topics/subtopics) for a delete-confirmation prompt.

nodes.label: handleSave (CRUD Save Handler)
nodes.rationale: Dispatches POST or PUT to the correct /api/admin/{tab} endpoint depending on whether `modalConfig.item` is set. Resolves the right parent (subjectId/unitId/chapterId/topicId) for each tab.

nodes.label: handleDelete (CRUD Delete Handler)
nodes.rationale: Browser confirm() prompt with dependency summary, then DELETE to /api/admin/{tab}/{id}, then silent refresh.

nodes.label: LocalStorage Persistence (Collapsed Groups)
nodes.rationale: CURR-LOW fix: collapsedGroups state is hydrated from and synced to `curriculum-collapsed-groups` key in localStorage with try/catch guarding against storage errors.

nodes.label: Hierarchy Exporter (JSON + HTML)
nodes.rationale: Two export functions: exportJSON serializes the current subject + hierarchyTree to a downloadable JSON file; exportHTML produces a styled, nested HTML report of the hierarchy.

nodes.label: Notes Derivation from PDFs (CU-02)
nodes.rationale: Notes are filtered from the PDFs list using either an explicit `type/pdfType/fileType` field ('note'/'notes'/'handout') or a keyword fallback over title/description/slug.

nodes.label: Topic/Subtopic Context Filter
nodes.rationale: `resourceMatchesTopicContext` hides chapter resources that don't match the currently selected topic/subtopic. Falls back to chapter-level visibility when the resource has no topic binding.

nodes.label: Escape-to-Close Modal Handler
nodes.rationale: useEffect that adds a window keydown listener for Escape when the chapter modal is open; cleanup removes the listener on close/unmount.

nodes.label: apiClient (dataService.js)
nodes.rationale: Imported shared HTTP client; all GET/POST/PUT/DELETE calls flow through it.

nodes.label: Admin API: /api/admin/subjects
nodes.rationale: REST endpoint backing subject list/create/update/delete in the curriculum builder.

nodes.label: Admin API: /api/admin/subject-videos
nodes.rationale: REST endpoint fetching chapter-scoped videos (query: studyMaterialId, chapterId) and accepting a /reorder PUT for resource reordering.

nodes.label: Admin API: /api/admin/subject-pdfs
nodes.rationale: REST endpoint for PDFs (and derived notes). Also accepts /reorder PUT.

nodes.label: Admin API: /api/admin/topic-tests
nodes.rationale: REST endpoint fetching topic-tests inside a chapter, also reorderable.

nodes.label: Public API: /api/quizzes
nodes.rationale: Public quiz listing endpoint, filtered by subject name + active=true; not reorderable from this UI.

nodes.label: CurriculumBuilder State (useState bundle)
nodes.rationale: Composite state shape: data (5 lists), loading, activeTab, toast, slugError, reorderLoading Set, selectedSubjectId, collapsedGroups, modalConfig, formData, chapterView (open/chapter/subject/topics/resources).

nodes.label: StagesManager.jsx
nodes.rationale: React JSX source file for the admin panel's Test Stages management UI

nodes.label: StagesManager (React Component)
nodes.rationale: Default-exported React functional component orchestrating stage CRUD, exam linkage, and test-series relations across three view modes

nodes.label: useExamCategories Hook
nodes.rationale: Custom hook providing categories, examInfo, and exams data context to the component

nodes.label: adminAPI (dataService)
nodes.rationale: Centralized data access layer for admin REST endpoints; replaces direct fetch to ensure auth middleware

nodes.label: stageSchema (Zod validation)
nodes.rationale: Zod schema validating stage form input (name, slug, description, icon, order, examIds, isActive)

nodes.label: validateForm Utility
nodes.rationale: Generic form validator returning {success, errors} from a schema and payload

nodes.label: lucide-react Icon Library
nodes.rationale: Icon set used for UI affordances (Plus, Edit, Trash2, Link, Unlink, Layers, ListTree, CheckSquare, etc.)

nodes.label: react-hot-toast
nodes.rationale: Toast notification library used for success/error feedback on mutations

nodes.label: Stage Data Entity
nodes.rationale: Core domain entity representing a test stage (Tier-1, Tier-2, CBT-1); fields: name, slug, description, icon, order, examIds, categoryIds, isActive, testCount, categoryCount, seriesCount

nodes.label: TestSeries Data Entity
nodes.rationale: Bundle of stages; fields: _id/id, name/title, description, icon, stages (array of stageIds), testCount/totalTests

nodes.label: viewMode State Machine
nodes.rationale: Tri-state tab controller: 'stages' (All Stages), 'relations' (Exam Relations), 'series' (Test Series Relations, default). Sourced from ?tab= URL param

nodes.label: Bulk Operation Loading Overlay
nodes.rationale: UI overlay with spinner and contextual icon (Link/Unlink) shown during multi-stage bulk link/unlink operations (FIX BUG [S-LOW-2])

nodes.label: Multi-step Stage Form (formStep)
nodes.rationale: Two-step create/edit modal: Step 1 Basic Info, Step 2 Link Exams. Responsive (mobile stepper, desktop side-by-side)

nodes.label: Orphaned Stage Detector
nodes.rationale: useMemo selector identifying stages with no examIds; surfaces warning banner with quick-link actions (S-05 fix)

nodes.label: Stage Detail Popup
nodes.rationale: Modal popup displaying linked exams, categories, series, and per-category test counts fetched from /api/admin/stages/:id/details

nodes.label: Assign Tests Shortcut
nodes.rationale: After-stage-creation UX: temporarily remembers newlyCreatedStageId for 30s, then routes to /admin/tests?stageId=...&assignMode=true (S4 fix)

nodes.label: Bulk Stage Selection (Set)
nodes.rationale: Set-based selection of stageIds enabling bulk link/unlink to the active exam (S-04 fix)

nodes.label: stagesForExam Derived State
nodes.rationale: useMemo filtering allStages by idsMatch(s.examIds, activeExamId)

nodes.label: unlinkedStages Derived State
nodes.rationale: useMemo of allStages not linked to active exam; rendered as clickable 'available stages' chips for quick linking

nodes.label: examsInCategory Derived State
nodes.rationale: useMemo filtering examInfo by activeCategoryId, sorted by display_order/displayOrder

nodes.label: fetchStages Function
nodes.rationale: Loads all stages via adminAPI.getStages; populates both stages and allStages state (FIX B2: uses adminAPI for auth middleware)

nodes.label: fetchTestSeries Function
nodes.rationale: Lazy-loads test series on demand when the 'series' view tab is activated (S-03 fix)

nodes.label: handleSubmit Function
nodes.rationale: Validates form with Zod, dispatches create or update based on editingId, captures new stage ID for assign-tests shortcut

nodes.label: handleLinkStage / handleUnlinkStage
nodes.rationale: Single-stage link/unlink to active exam, with duplicate-check and numeric/string ID normalization

nodes.label: handleLinkStageToSeries / handleUnlinkStageFromSeries
nodes.rationale: Link/unlink a stage from a test series via PUT /api/admin/test-series/:id (S-01 fix)

nodes.label: handleBulkLinkStages / handleBulkUnlinkStages
nodes.rationale: Iterates selectedStages Set, dispatches sequential updateStage calls, tracks success/fail counts and bulkOperationType (S-04 fix)

nodes.label: handleQuickLinkOrphan Function
nodes.rationale: One-click stage-to-exam linking targeting orphaned stages (S-05 fix)

nodes.label: stageIcons Constant Array
nodes.rationale: Hardcoded emoji palette (📋📝💻⚡🖥️📄⭐🎯📑🏅📚) presented as picker in the form

nodes.label: Auto-select Defaults Effect
nodes.rationale: Effects that auto-pick first category and first exam; also re-validates activeExamId when category changes

nodes.label: selectAllStages Function
nodes.rationale: Toggle selection of all stages scoped to current viewMode ('stages' or 'relations')

nodes.label: getLinkedExamNames Function
nodes.rationale: Resolves stage.examIds to human-readable exam title/name badges

nodes.label: CategoriesManager.jsx
nodes.rationale: React component for managing hierarchical test categories in the admin panel

nodes.label: CategoriesManager (component)
nodes.rationale: Default-exported React functional component orchestrating category CRUD, bulk ops, import/export, merge, and tab-based views

nodes.label: TestSeriesMultiSelect (component)
nodes.rationale: Searchable multi-select dropdown for linking test series to categories, with chips, search filter, and clear-all

nodes.label: CategoryItem (component)
nodes.rationale: Recursive renderer for individual tree nodes showing badge counts, exam category, stages, and action buttons

nodes.label: TABS config
nodes.rationale: Static tab definitions: tree, series-category-relations, test-series-list, import-export, api-docs

nodes.label: PERMISSION_LEVELS
nodes.rationale: Local permission enum: ADMIN, EDITOR, CONTRIBUTOR, VIEWER with display labels

nodes.label: isSameEntityId helper
nodes.rationale: Compares two IDs robustly across string/number coercions for cross-shape entity matching

nodes.label: normalizeIdList helper
nodes.rationale: Normalizes ID input: arrays, Postgres-style {a,b} strings, JSON arrays, scalars — all to string[]

nodes.label: hasMatchingId helper
nodes.rationale: Checks if any value (possibly list) matches any target ID using isSameEntityId semantics

nodes.label: getDescendantIdSet function
nodes.rationale: BFS-based traversal returning node+descendant IDs to prevent circular parent references in tree moves/edits

nodes.label: handleBulkMove handler
nodes.rationale: Moves multiple selected categories under a new parent, guarding against moving into own descendants

nodes.label: exportTree handler
nodes.rationale: Serializes category tree to JSON blob and triggers browser download

nodes.label: handleImport handler
nodes.rationale: Recursively creates categories from previously exported JSON tree

nodes.label: handleMerge handler
nodes.rationale: Merges multiple selected categories into a target by re-parenting children then deleting sources

nodes.label: setPermission handler
nodes.rationale: Stores per-category permission level in component state and toasts confirmation

nodes.label: addActivityLog handler
nodes.rationale: Deduplicated, capped (100) activity logger with timestamp and error context for audit trail

nodes.label: fetchAllData handler
nodes.rationale: Loads categories, exam categories, test series and tests; restores expanded state from localStorage

nodes.label: getCategoryLinkedSeriesIds helper
nodes.rationale: Aggregates linked test series IDs across camelCase, snake_case single, and plural fields

nodes.label: getCategoryAndDescendantIds helper
nodes.rationale: Walks subtree collecting _id, id, and slug for recursive category inclusion in joins

nodes.label: getRelatedSeriesForCategories helper
nodes.rationale: Resolves related test series via multiple legacy field names (categoryId, category, category_path_ids, etc.)

nodes.label: getRelatedTestsForCategories helper
nodes.rationale: Resolves related tests using same field fallback strategy as series resolver

nodes.label: getTotalCountsRecursive helper
nodes.rationale: Returns aggregate testSeries + tests counts across the category subtree for badge display

nodes.label: handleEdit handler
nodes.rationale: Populates form from a category record, normalizing testSeriesId across multiple legacy field shapes

nodes.label: handleReorderCategory handler
nodes.rationale: Swaps displayOrder with adjacent sibling to reorder categories within the same parent

nodes.label: buildTree helper
nodes.rationale: Converts flat list to nested tree by parentId; normalizes ids to strings; sorts by displayOrder

nodes.label: parentSelectRows (memo)
nodes.rationale: Memoized flat rows of eligible parent choices, excluding self and descendants to prevent cycles

nodes.label: examRelationsData (memo)
nodes.rationale: Maps exam categories to categories via effective examCategoryId (inheritable through ancestry) with depth-guarded traversal

nodes.label: seriesCategoryRelationsData (memo)
nodes.rationale: Aggregates root-category → test series + tests relations for the relations tab

nodes.label: seriesSubcategoryRelationsData (memo)
nodes.rationale: Aggregates subcategory → test series + tests relations with parent reference for display

nodes.label: orphanStats (memo)
nodes.rationale: Detects categories whose stages are not linked to any test series for orphan reporting

nodes.label: categories_expanded (localStorage)
nodes.rationale: Persists user's expanded/collapsed tree state across reloads

nodes.label: SERIES_CATEGORY_FIELDS
nodes.rationale: Canonical + legacy field names for series→category relations, with categoryId as the preferred key (Issue C-01)

nodes.label: categorySchema (Zod)
nodes.rationale: Imported Zod schema used by validateForm for create/update payload validation

nodes.label: useStages hook
nodes.rationale: Shared hook providing stages with optional admin-counts preference

nodes.label: Tabbed navigation pattern
nodes.rationale: Single-page tab pattern (tree / relations / list / import-export / api-docs) sharing one fetch lifecycle

nodes.label: Circular reference guard pattern
nodes.rationale: Descendant-set guard plus max depth (20) prevents infinite recursion when cycles exist in stored data

nodes.label: Legacy field name fallback
nodes.rationale: Pattern: keep reading older snake_case / plural field variants to support legacy DB rows while standardizing on canonical names

nodes.label: Deduplicated activity logging
nodes.rationale: Ref-based dedup (1s window) + cap of 100 entries prevents log spam and re-render loops (BUG-022)

nodes.label: Refresh trigger state pattern
nodes.rationale: useState counter incremented to force useEffect-driven refetch after linking changes (BUG-023, Issue C-02)

nodes.label: TestsManager (React component, default export)
nodes.rationale: Top-level React functional component orchestrating test CRUD, filtering, publishing, bulk actions, and cascading subcategory navigation within admin-panel.

nodes.label: TEST_CATEGORY_TABS (4-tab taxonomy: mock-tests, pyp, practice, live-tests)
nodes.rationale: Constant defining four mutually exclusive test types rendered as a tab bar, each with lucide-react icon.

nodes.label: TEST_CATEGORY_ALIASES (slug normalization map)
nodes.rationale: Maps each category id to accepted aliases (snake/kebab/case/words) used by buildTestCategoryRefs to perform fuzzy matching.

nodes.label: DEFAULT_TEST_FORM (initial form state)
nodes.rationale: Default values for the test create/edit form: title, slug, 4 subcategory levels, type, duration, negativeMarking, difficulty, isPro, isComingSoon, isLive, tags, stageIds, sectionIds, scheduledAt, maxParticipants.

nodes.label: normalizeTest (data shape tolerance helper)
nodes.rationale: Defensive normalizer that handles both camelCase and snake_case backend field names and supplies defaults for missing fields.

nodes.label: coerceArray (string/array/JSON coercion)
nodes.rationale: Helper that accepts arrays, single objects, JSON strings, Postgres-style '{a,b}' strings, or CSV strings and returns an array.

nodes.label: flattenCategories (tree -> flat list with parentId)
nodes.rationale: Recursively flattens nested children into a single array tagged with parentId for downstream BFS/DFS use.

nodes.label: buildTestCategoryRefs (BFS expansion of category aliases + descendants)
nodes.rationale: Given an active category, expands aliases and walks the descendant tree to populate a Set of normalized id/name/slug refs used for membership tests.

nodes.label: buildCategorySelectionRefs (selected chip + descendants refs)
nodes.rationale: Like buildTestCategoryRefs but anchored on a specific selected subcategory; used by testMatchesSubCategory to include descendants in filtering.

nodes.label: getCategoryPath (root -> leaf path resolution)
nodes.rationale: Walks parent chain (with cycle protection) to reconstruct full hierarchy of a category for cascading dropdowns.

nodes.label: fetchData (parallel load via Promise.allSettled)
nodes.rationale: Loads tests, series, stages, test categories, and sections in parallel using allSettled so partial failures surface as warnings rather than aborts.

nodes.label: Cascading subcategory drill-down (4 levels: L1..L4)
nodes.rationale: Four useMemo selectors + four chip rows that progressively filter by hierarchy level (Year/Exam -> 2025/2024 -> ...); includes duplicate-parent guard to avoid self-nesting.

nodes.label: Deep-link via URL search params (tab/seriesId/stageId)
nodes.rationale: useEffect reads ?tab=, ?seriesId=, ?stageId= to restore active filters and select a series once data loads; guarded by deepLinkAppliedRef to apply only once.

nodes.label: openCreateForm (initialize new-test form state)
nodes.rationale: Resolves cascading subcategory path for the currently selected chip, sets type/isLive based on activeTestCategory, and clears editingId.

nodes.label: openEditForm (hydrate form from existing test)
nodes.rationale: Resolves linked series/stage/category for a test, prioritizes specific categoryId fields over test.type, and populates the four subcategory levels while building an editingRelationshipSummary for the modal.

nodes.label: handleSubmit (validate + create/update test)
nodes.rationale: Runs validateForm(testSchema), builds a payload with conditional fields (scheduledAt, maxParticipants, tags, examId, stageIds), strips undefined/empty id-ish keys, and routes to adminAPI.createTest or adminAPI.updateTest.

nodes.label: handleBulkUpload (FormData upload of CSV/file)
nodes.rationale: Packages file + testSeriesId/category/examId/stageId/testCategoryId/validateOnly into a FormData and calls adminAPI.bulkUploadTests, surfacing skipped counts in a toast.

nodes.label: validateBulkUpload (pre-flight duplicate + shape check)
nodes.rationale: Calls adminAPI.bulkUploadTests with validateOnly=true and augments server results with client-side duplicate-title and title-length checks.

nodes.label: handlePublish / handleUnpublish (lifecycle toggle)
nodes.rationale: Refuses to publish when questionCount is 0; on success, updates the local test with status/active flags and re-derived totals/marks returned by the backend.

nodes.label: handleExport (CSV download via blob URL)
nodes.rationale: Streams /api/admin/tests/export with responseType blob, wraps in a Blob and an anchor element to trigger CSV download; revokes the object URL after click.

nodes.label: Bulk publish / bulk delete floating action bar
nodes.rationale: Toggle per-test selection (Set), filter out unpublishable zero-question tests, call /api/admin/tests/bulk-publish and /api/admin/tests/bulk-delete, and surface per-row failure counts via toast.

nodes.label: TestFormModal (child create/edit modal)
nodes.rationale: Re-keyed on editingId/series/stage/subcategory so it remounts when context changes; receives relationshipSummary, available sections/stages, and full subcategory tree.

nodes.label: Tests UI subcomponents (Badge, StatCard, EmptyState, TestFormModal)
nodes.rationale: Local UI primitives imported as TestsBadge/StatCard/EmptyState/TestFormModal; mirror shared components/* counterparts with Tests* namespacing.

nodes.label: shared/lib/dataService (apiClient + adminAPI)
nodes.rationale: Centralized HTTP client and admin-specific API surface (getTests, createTest, updateTest, deleteTest, publishTest, unpublishTest, bulkUploadTests, etc.).

nodes.label: shared/lib/validationSchemas (testSchema + validateForm)
nodes.rationale: Zod-like schema-driven validation reused across admin forms; handleSubmit feeds the form fields through validateForm(testSchema, ...).

nodes.label: useKeyboardShortcuts hook (Save/Close bindings)
nodes.rationale: Wires Ctrl/Cmd+S to the active form submit and Escape to onClose; used for power-user ergonomics in test editing.

nodes.label: useUndoToast hook (optimistic delete with undo)
nodes.rationale: Provides withUndo wrapper used for soft-delete operations; exposes a transient toast that can roll back the action.

nodes.label: useExamCategories hook (categories/exams/examInfo loader)
nodes.rationale: Provides examCategories, examsFromHook, examInfo, getSubcategories, and a loading flag; the manager auto-selects the first category/exam/stage when none is active.

nodes.label: lucide-react icon set (CheckSquare, ChevronDown, ChevronRight, Clock, Edit, FileText, Filter, FolderOpen, Layers, Plus, Save, Search, Shield, Trash2, Upload, X, Loader2)
nodes.rationale: Iconography for the manager: CheckSquare (mock tests), FileText (PYPs), Layers (practice), Clock (live), Trash2/Edit (row actions), Upload (bulk), FolderOpen (series), Shield (published stat).

nodes.label: react-router-dom hooks (useSearchParams, useNavigate)
nodes.rationale: Drives deep linking, tab persistence in URL, and navigation to /admin/questions?testId=... from a test row.

nodes.label: Test entity data shape (title, slug, testSeriesId, stageId, testCategoryId, type, duration, negativeMarking, isPro, isLive, tags, sections)
nodes.rationale: Schema inferred from DEFAULT_TEST_FORM and normalizeTest: tests link to a TestSeries, an optional Stage, a TestCategory, may carry sections/stages arrays, and expose publishing flags (isLive, isPro, isComingSoon).

nodes.label: Tests filtering pipeline (examCategory > exam > stage > series > testCategory > subCategory)
nodes.rationale: Composite memoized pipeline: examsForActiveCategory -> filteredSeriesList -> seriesTests -> workspaceTests, where each stage narrows results using idsEqual/valueMatchesRefs against active*Refs.

nodes.label: ExamInfoNew.jsx
nodes.rationale: React page component for displaying detailed information about a single exam including overview, dates, eligibility, pattern, syllabus, vacancy, cut-off, post details, preparation, updates, previous year papers, and FAQ.

nodes.label: ExamInfoNew React Component
nodes.rationale: Default exported functional component that reads examId from URL params, orchestrates data fetching, manages tab/year/bookmark state, and renders the multi-tab exam information page.

nodes.label: STATIC_EXAM_CONTENT registry
nodes.rationale: Hardcoded object keyed by lowercase exam ID ('cgl', 'chsl') containing overview, eligibility, age limit, age relaxation, selection process, exam frequency, conducting body, exam level, posts, syllabus, and preparation resources. Acts as a content registry pattern.

nodes.label: DEFAULT_CONTENT fallback
nodes.rationale: Default placeholder content used when an examId is not present in STATIC_EXAM_CONTENT, providing generic 'As per official notification' values and empty arrays.

nodes.label: SAMPLE_UPDATES
nodes.rationale: Mock notification/vacancy/syllabus update items, each with id, type, title, description, date, and priority fields.

nodes.label: fetchExamData
nodes.rationale: Async function that fans out parallel requests via Promise.all to dataService for categories, exams, test series, exam updates, and yearly data, then merges them with static content and DB-sourced exam-info, falling back to defaults on failure.

nodes.label: toggleBookmark
nodes.rationale: useCallback that persists bookmarked examIds in localStorage under the 'bookmarkedExams' key, adding or removing the current examData.examId.

nodes.label: formatDate helper
nodes.rationale: Returns 'TBA' for null/empty strings and otherwise uses toLocaleDateString with en-IN locale to format dates as 'day Mon yyyy'.

nodes.label: Tab configuration
nodes.rationale: Array of 12 tab descriptors (id, label, icon) covering overview, dates, eligibility, pattern, syllabus, vacancy, cutoff, postdetails, preparation, updates, pyp, and faq.

nodes.label: SSC CGL (Combined Graduate Level) Exam
nodes.rationale: Domain entity: SSC CGL is a 4-tier national exam for Group B/C posts in Indian government, with eligibility of Bachelor's degree, age 18-32, and 11 specific posts including AAO, ASO, Inspector, Auditor, UDC, Tax Assistant.

nodes.label: SSC CHSL (Combined Higher Secondary Level) Exam
nodes.rationale: Domain entity: SSC CHSL is a 3-tier national exam for Group C posts (LDC, JSA, DEO, DEO Grade A) requiring 12th pass, age 18-27.

nodes.label: Staff Selection Commission (SSC)
nodes.rationale: Recurring domain entity representing the conducting body for both CGL and CHSL examinations.

nodes.label: AuthContext (useAuth)
nodes.rationale: Imported from shared/providers/AuthContext.jsx to retrieve the current user via useAuth; user is destructured at component mount but not visibly consumed in render.

nodes.label: dataService module
nodes.rationale: Aggregates getExamCategories, getExams, getTestSeries, getTests, api, getExamUpdates, and getExamYearlyData into the page's data layer.

nodes.label: lucide-react icon set
nodes.rationale: Bulk import of ~50 lucide-react icons used for tab indicators, hero stats, and section headers.

nodes.label: yearlyData state
nodes.rationale: Renamed setter setUpdatesData actually stores a year-keyed map; currentYearData is derived by indexing into it with selectedYear.

nodes.label: Data merge strategy (dynamic > static)
nodes.rationale: Architectural decision: dynamic exam info from DB (description, eligibility, ageLimit, syllabus) takes precedence over STATIC_EXAM_CONTENT values, with explicit field-by-field override inside a nested 'static' object on mergedExamData.

nodes.label: Tier-based exam pattern (CGL Tier I-IV, CHSL Tier I-III)
nodes.rationale: Domain concept: exams are structured as sequential tiers (CBT objective, CBT objective, descriptive pen-paper, skill/typing test) and the UI splits syllabus rendering into tier1/tier2 tables.

nodes.label: Year selector pill UI
nodes.rationale: UI design pattern: rounded pill buttons switch selectedYear, with a 'NEW' badge for 2026 and a pulsing dot beside the result status text.

nodes.label: Sticky horizontal tab navigation
nodes.rationale: Design pattern: tabs are sticky on top, scroll horizontally, and use an active gradient underline as the selected indicator.

nodes.label: Mobile floating quick-nav (React Portal)
nodes.rationale: Uses createPortal from react-dom to mount a fixed-position floating action button with a popup tab menu directly into document.body, escaping parent overflow/z-index containers.

nodes.label: localStorage bookmark persistence
nodes.rationale: Architectural decision: bookmarked exam IDs are stored in localStorage as a JSON array under 'bookmarkedExams'; the page reads them on mount and writes on toggle. No server sync.

nodes.label: Category-based related exam filtering
nodes.rationale: Pattern: related exams are filtered by matching categoryId and excluding the current examId, sliced to 4; related test series are filtered by category, sorted with isPinned first then by admin order, sliced to 6.

nodes.label: Vacancy category-breakup widget
nodes.rationale: Renders UR/OBC/SC/ST counts with per-category color palettes (blue/amber/emerald/purple), a percentage progress bar, and a year-on-year comparison bar chart.

nodes.label: Syllabus table with totals
nodes.rationale: Syllabus data is presented in tables with a tfoot that reduces questions/marks/time to totals; the pattern tab also shows four summary cards for tier-1 (questions, total marks, minutes, negative marking).

nodes.label: Previous Year Papers download list
nodes.rationale: Renders a hardcoded list of years 2020-2025 with download icons, indicating static UI for PYP even though the actual click handler is not implemented.

nodes.label: FAQ accordion
nodes.rationale: Native <details>/<summary> elements used to build an FAQ collapse/expand UI with rotating chevron, leveraging platform behavior instead of custom state.

nodes.label: React Router (useParams, useNavigate, Link)
nodes.rationale: react-router-dom v6 hooks drive examId extraction, programmatic back-navigation on 'Exam not found', and multiple Link targets to /test-series, /tests, /pyps, /study, /exams, /exam/:id, /exams/category/:id.

nodes.label: Loading and error state UI
nodes.rationale: Component guards: shows a spinner with 'Loading exam details...' while loading=true, and a '🔍 Exam Not Found' empty state with a 'Browse All Exams' CTA when error==='Exam not found'.

nodes.label: Update type/priority color coding
nodes.rationale: Visual pattern: update.type chooses red/green/blue background; update.priority chooses red for 'high' or gray otherwise, used to convey urgency at a glance.

nodes.label: TestInterface React Component
nodes.rationale: Main React functional component rendering the test-taking experience with question display, navigation, palette, and submission flows

nodes.label: AuthContext Provider
nodes.rationale: Provides useAuth hook exposing user, refreshUser, socket, emit, on for authentication and WebSocket access

nodes.label: Countdown Timer System
nodes.rationale: setInterval-based 1-second countdown that decrements timeLeft and triggers handleSubmit at zero, suspended when paused or in review mode

nodes.label: Auto-save Mechanism
nodes.rationale: 30-second periodic autosave using refs to avoid stale closures; PUT /api/tests/:id/autosave with answers, timeSpent, markedForReview, sectionTimers

nodes.label: Heartbeat Presence Ping
nodes.rationale: 30-second PATCH /api/attempt/:attemptId/heartbeat to maintain active session presence

nodes.label: WebSocket Active Session
nodes.rationale: Socket-based coordination: emit attempt:join/leave and listen for attempt:evicted to enforce single-window test sessions

nodes.label: Anti-Cheat Module
nodes.rationale: Tracks tab visibility, window blur/focus, pause events, and question changes; logs events via POST /api/attempt/:id/event

nodes.label: Question Status State Machine
nodes.rationale: Five derived statuses (p-answered, p-not-answered, p-review, p-ans-review, p-not-visited) computed from answers, markedForReview, visitedQuestions sets

nodes.label: Per-Question Time Tracking
nodes.rationale: Tracks seconds spent on each question using questionStartTimeRef; aggregates into questionTimers and sectionTimers

nodes.label: Section Timer Aggregator
nodes.rationale: computeSectionTimers callback sums per-question timers by section, excluding _visits keys

nodes.label: Pause/Resume Handlers
nodes.rationale: handlePause posts /api/attempt/pause; handleResume restores remainingTime and questionTimers from server

nodes.label: Subject-to-Section Normalization
nodes.rationale: Maps raw subject names (General Knowledge, Mathematics, Reasoning, English, Science) to canonical section codes (GK, Math, Reasoning, English, Science)

nodes.label: Question Palette Sidebar
nodes.rationale: Sticky sidebar showing per-section question grid with color-coded status badges and submit button

nodes.label: Review Mode
nodes.rationale: Read-only post-submission mode driven by reviewMode location state, with togglable explanations and dual response comparison

nodes.label: Bilingual Language Switcher
nodes.rationale: Toggles between 'en' and 'hi' to render question text, options, and explanations from localized object fields

nodes.label: Test Attempt Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: POST /api/tests/:id/start creates attempt; PUT /api/tests/:id/submit finalizes; navigates to /test-result/:seriesId/:testId

nodes.label: Question Navigation
nodes.rationale: goToQuestion, nextQuestion, prevQuestion, changeSection handlers with timer snapshot and visitedQuestions tracking

nodes.label: Error Handling & Redirects
nodes.rationale: 401 redirects to /login with from-state; 403 with limitReached navigates to /pass; submit errors surface alerts

nodes.label: Mobile Bottom Navigation Bar
nodes.rationale: Fixed bottom bar with Prev/Clear/Palette/Review/Next buttons for mobile breakpoints

nodes.label: Ref-Based State Mirror Pattern
nodes.rationale: Mirrors answers, timeLeft, markedForReview into refs to avoid stale closures inside setInterval callbacks

nodes.label: StudyMaterialChapter.jsx
nodes.rationale: React page component for displaying a single study chapter within a subject, handling tabbed content, topics, videos, PDFs, tests, and discussion forum.

nodes.label: StudyMaterialChapter component
nodes.rationale: Default exported React functional component using hooks (useState, useEffect) and React Router params (subjectId, chapterId) to render chapter content.

nodes.label: formatDuration helper
nodes.rationale: Helper function that formats a duration value, returning 'X min' for numbers or the original value as a string; falls back to a provided default.

nodes.label: getPreferredTab helper
nodes.rationale: Helper that selects the initial active tab based on chapter content availability (overview, videos, notes, tests).

nodes.label: handleDiscussionSubmit
nodes.rationale: Async handler that posts a new question/doubt to /api/doubts with chapter and subject context, then prepends result to local discussions state.

nodes.label: handleDeleteDiscussion
nodes.rationale: Handler that confirms then deletes a discussion via DELETE /api/doubts/:id and removes it from local state.

nodes.label: handleUpdateDiscussion
nodes.rationale: Handler that PUTs an edited description to /api/doubts/:id and merges the response into local state.

nodes.label: handleBookmark
nodes.rationale: Optimistic toggle handler that posts bookmark state to /api/bookmarks/toggle and reverts on failure.

nodes.label: handleShare
nodes.rationale: Handler that uses navigator.share when available and falls back to copying the chapter URL to clipboard.

nodes.label: handleVideoClick
nodes.rationale: Opens the VideoPlayer modal with normalized video data (title, description, url).

nodes.label: handlePDFClick
nodes.rationale: Opens the PDFViewer modal with normalized PDF data including fileName and totalPages.

nodes.label: Overview Tab
nodes.rationale: Tab section showing chapter topic sequence; lists all topics with current topic highlighted.

nodes.label: Video Lessons Tab
nodes.rationale: Tab section rendering video lessons grid with thumbnail and click handler invoking VideoPlayer modal.

nodes.label: Notes and PDFs Tab
nodes.rationale: Tab section listing PDF study resources; click opens PDFViewer modal.

nodes.label: Practice Tests Tab
nodes.rationale: Tab section linking to chapter practice tests via /test/:id route.

nodes.label: Chapter Forum (Discussion)
nodes.rationale: Discussion forum section with create/read/update/delete operations against /api/doubts and edit/delete gated by admin or ownership.

nodes.label: Topic Navigation
nodes.rationale: In-component previous/next topic navigation with active-index dots, updating activeTopicIndex state.

nodes.label: Chapter Pagination
nodes.rationale: Previous/next chapter links using getChapterPath utility to build subject-relative chapter routes.

nodes.label: Topics Covered Sidebar
nodes.rationale: Sticky sidebar listing chapter topics for quick navigation; sets active topic index and scrolls into view.

nodes.label: All Chapters Sidebar
nodes.rationale: Sidebar listing all chapters with completion indicator and expand-to-show-all control.

nodes.label: Your Metrics Card
nodes.rationale: Sidebar card displaying user analytics: time spent, completed chapters count, and average accuracy from /api/users/analytics.

nodes.label: Course Expert Card
nodes.rationale: Sidebar card displaying the subject instructor name and a contact-instructor action.

nodes.label: Chapter Progress Ring
nodes.rationale: SVG-based circular progress indicator in the gradient header; renders both mobile and desktop variants.

nodes.label: GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/doubts
nodes.rationale: Backend API surface used to list, create, update, and delete chapter-scoped discussion threads filtered by category.

nodes.label: POST /api/bookmarks/toggle
nodes.rationale: Toggle endpoint for bookmarking chapters by itemId/itemType.

nodes.label: GET /api/users/analytics
nodes.rationale: Endpoint that supplies per-user study stats and performance metrics for the Your Metrics card.

nodes.label: PDFViewer component
nodes.rationale: Common UI component for modal PDF viewing; controlled by pdfViewer state.

nodes.label: VideoPlayer component
nodes.rationale: Common UI component for modal video playback; controlled by videoPlayer state.

nodes.label: studyMaterialUtils (getChapterPath, matchesChapterIdentifier)
nodes.rationale: Sibling utility module providing chapter path resolution and identifier matching for navigation between chapters.

nodes.label: React Router: useParams, useNavigate, Link
nodes.rationale: React Router primitives used for subjectId/chapterId param extraction, programmatic navigation, and declarative Link components.

nodes.label: Realtime content:updated listener

nodes.label: categoryLabel and examLabel useMemos

nodes.rationale: Catch fetch errors, log to console, and set empty array state rather than propagating failures to the UI

nodes.label: Horizontal Drag Scroll Pattern
nodes.rationale: Use the shared useDraggableScroll hook with cursor-grab styling to allow pointer drag on touch-friendly horizontal carousels

nodes.label: Responsive 12-Column Grid
nodes.rationale: Two-column dashboard layout: 8/12 main + 4/12 sticky sidebar on lg, single column on smaller breakpoints

nodes.label: Progress Color Tier Pattern
nodes.rationale: Map progress percentage to green/yellow/blue to communicate completion stage at a glance

nodes.label: Loading Coalescing Flag
nodes.rationale: Compute isLoadingComplete as the conjunction of independent loading flags to gate the parent loader

nodes.label: TestSeriesManager.jsx
nodes.rationale: React component file (1269 lines) implementing admin test series management UI

nodes.label: TestSeriesManager
nodes.rationale: Default-exported React component for managing test series: list, create, edit, delete, reorder, pin/toggle, inline stage linking, orphan resolution

nodes.label: coerceStageExamIds
nodes.rationale: Utility that defensively coerces stage.examIds from string-encoded array (Postgres '{a,b,c}' or JSON) into a normalized array

nodes.label: buildExamRefSet
nodes.rationale: Builds a Set of equivalent exam ID representations (string/number, id/examId) for tolerant matching between form values and stage examIds

nodes.label: stageExamIdsMatch
nodes.rationale: Returns true if any element of stage.examIds matches any reference in the refSet using string/number equivalence

nodes.label: api

nodes.label: testSeriesSchema
nodes.rationale: Zod/validation schema (with validateForm) applied to form data before submit

nodes.label: formData
nodes.rationale: useState object capturing title, slug, category, subcategory, stages, description, isPro, price, difficulty, tags, isActive, isPinned — totalTests intentionally omitted (BUG-003 fix: backend computes)

nodes.label: fetchSeries
nodes.rationale: Loads test series, normalizes legacy subcategory column (BUG-001 fix), sorts pinned-first then by order

nodes.label: fetchOrphanedTests
nodes.rationale: Loads orphaned tests from /api/admin/tests/orphaned for the reassignment workflow

nodes.label: handleMove

nodes.label: Inline Stage Editing
nodes.rationale: Feature: dropdown of stage checkboxes filtered by selected exam's examIds; saveInlineStages persists partial linkage without reopening the main form

nodes.label: Orphan Tests Resolution Modal
