nodes.label: BUG-001 Legacy subcategory Normalization
nodes.rationale: Normalize legacy subcategory/subCategory/sub_category field names to enable consistent filtering

nodes.label: BUG-003 totalTests Removal
nodes.rationale: totalTests removed from client form/payload; backend calculates count from SQL to avoid drift

nodes.label: Category Tabs
nodes.rationale: useMemo builds tabs from categories with per-category series counts; reset sub-filter on tab change

nodes.label: Exam Sub-Tabs
nodes.rationale: Sub-filter bar within a category tab: lists exams (subcategories) with counts; auto-selects when only one exam has series

nodes.label: GET /api/stages
nodes.rationale: Backend endpoint returning ordered stages used to populate the stage selection UI

nodes.label: GET /api/admin/tests/orphaned
nodes.rationale: Backend endpoint returning tests whose parent test series is missing

nodes.label: PUT /api/admin/tests/:id/reassign
nodes.rationale: Backend endpoint attaching an orphan test to a new series

nodes.label: StudyMaterialDetail (React Page Component)
nodes.rationale: Default-exported React functional component rendering the study material subject detail page; uses react-router useParams to read subjectId and orchestrates data fetch + view state.

nodes.label: formatVideoDuration helper
nodes.rationale: Local helper that normalizes video duration fields (duration, videoDuration) to a human-readable string with ' min' suffix, returning null on empty/zero.

nodes.label: formatPdfPages helper
nodes.rationale: Local helper that normalizes PDF page-count fields (pages, pageCount) into 'N page(s)' label, returns null for zero/invalid.

nodes.label: formatTestMeta helper
nodes.rationale: Local helper that normalizes test duration/time-limit fields (duration, durationMinutes, timeLimit) into 'N min' or string.

nodes.label: Component State (subject, loading, expandedChapter, activeTab, viewMode, collapsedUnits, isViewModeMenuOpen, videoPlayer, pdfViewer, contentReader)
nodes.rationale: useState hooks holding subject payload, loading flag, expansion keys, tab filter, layout mode, collapsed unit set, viewer menu flag, and three modal viewer payloads.

nodes.label: Subject fetch useEffect
nodes.rationale: useEffect with subjectId dependency that calls getStudyMaterialById, sets subject state, logs errors, and clears loading flag in finally block.

nodes.label: Collapsed units reset useEffect
nodes.rationale: useEffect on subject change that resets collapsedUnits to an empty Set whenever units change.

nodes.label: Chapter list aggregation logic
nodes.rationale: Combines chapters nested under subject.units with top-level subject.chapters (deduped by id) and computes total videos/notes/tests/topics via reduce over fallback field names.

nodes.label: Tab definitions (all/videos/notes/tests)
nodes.rationale: Static tabs array driving content filter UI; counts prefer top-level subject.videos/pdf/tests with per-chapter computed totals as fallback.

nodes.label: renderChapterItems function
nodes.rationale: Renders a 3-column grid of video/pdf/test items inside an expanded chapter; uses activeTab to filter sections, falls back across chapter.videosList|videos, chapter.pdfsList|pdfs, chapter.testsList|tests.

nodes.label: handleVideoClick handler
nodes.rationale: Opens VideoPlayer modal by building a normalized {title, description, url} payload from videoData.

nodes.label: handlePDFClick handler
nodes.rationale: Opens PDFViewer modal with normalized {title, description, url, fileName, totalPages} from pdfData.

nodes.label: handleContentClick handler
nodes.rationale: Opens ContentReader modal with article-style payload including title, category, author, date, readTime, htmlContent, tags, featuredImage and a graceful default HTML when content is empty.

nodes.label: toggleUnit handler
nodes.rationale: Toggles presence of a unit key in collapsedUnits Set, used to expand/collapse hierarchy sections.

nodes.label: Hierarchy View (Units -> Chapters)
nodes.rationale: Primary view rendering collapsible units containing chapters; shows per-chapter videos/notes/test counts, progress bar, and an expansion panel listing items and topics.

nodes.label: Flat List View
nodes.rationale: Alternative view flattening chaptersList; each chapter row expands into a grid of video/pdf/test items.

nodes.label: View Mode Dropdown (hierarchy/flat)
nodes.rationale: Dropdown menu attached to the tabs bar allowing the user to switch layout between 🏗️ Structure and 📋 List All; uses a transparent backdrop click to close.

nodes.label: Hero header with subject icon + progress
nodes.rationale: Gradient hero section with dynamic icon selection (bar-chart-2/brain/book-open/globe), title, description, and overall progress bar derived from completed chapters.

nodes.label: Hero Stat Badges (videos/notes/tests)
nodes.rationale: Three pill-shaped stat buttons that also act as quick tab filters by calling setActiveTab on click.

nodes.label: Modal viewers composition (VideoPlayer/PDFViewer/ContentReader)
nodes.rationale: Three shared modal viewers composed at the bottom of the page; controlled by isOpen/data pairs from local state.

nodes.label: No-units fallback renderer
nodes.rationale: When subject.units is empty but chaptersList has items, renders a simpler card list using renderChapterItems; preserves deep links and progress display.

nodes.label: getStudyMaterialById (dataService)
nodes.rationale: Imported async data service call used to load the subject by id from the data layer.

nodes.label: getChapterPath (studyMaterialUtils)
nodes.rationale: Utility that builds the deep-link path for a given chapter inside the study flow.

nodes.label: getChapterIdentifier (studyMaterialUtils)
nodes.rationale: Utility that derives a stable key (for React keys and expansion ids) for a chapter given its index and siblings.

nodes.label: Breadcrumb shared component
nodes.rationale: Imported shared component rendering the breadcrumb trail (Home -> Study Materials -> subjectGroup -> subject).

nodes.label: VideoPlayer modal component
nodes.rationale: Imported shared modal used to play educational videos; controlled via isOpen and videoData props.

nodes.label: PDFViewer modal component
nodes.rationale: Imported shared modal used to view study notes PDFs; controlled via isOpen and pdfData props.

nodes.label: ContentReader modal component
nodes.rationale: Imported shared modal used to read article-style study content; controlled via isOpen and contentData props.

nodes.label: lucide-react icons (Play, FileText, ChevronDown, ChevronRight, Lock, CheckCircle, Clock, BookOpen, Video, Download, BarChartBig, Brain, Globe, Package)
nodes.rationale: Iconography imported from lucide-react; only a subset is actually used (Play, FileText, ChevronDown, BookOpen, Video, BarChartBig, Brain, Globe, Package), the others (Lock, CheckCircle, Clock, ChevronRight, Download) are imported but not referenced.

nodes.label: react-router-dom (useParams, Link)
nodes.rationale: Routing primitives: useParams extracts subjectId; Link is used for navigation to study root and to /test/:id for practice tests.

nodes.label: Tailwind animation utilities (animate-fade-in, animate-slide-in-up, animate-in fade-in zoom-in)
nodes.rationale: Class-based animation hooks for loading state, page enter, unit staggering, chapter expansion, and dropdown reveal.

nodes.label: viewMode state value 'hierarchy'
nodes.rationale: Default view mode displaying units -> chapters hierarchy.

nodes.label: viewMode state value 'flat'
nodes.rationale: Alternative view mode flattening the chapter list into a single list.

nodes.label: activeTab filter (all/videos/notes/tests)
nodes.rationale: Cross-cutting UI filter selecting which item category to display; non-'all' values also force chapter expansion.

nodes.label: Subject data shape (units/chapters/videos/pdfs/tests/topics)
nodes.rationale: Implied domain model: Subject { id, title, name, description, icon, subjectGroup, units[], videos, pdf, tests, chapters[] }; Unit { id, name, chapters[] }; Chapter { id/_id, title, name, videoCount, pdfCount, testCount/testsCount, videosList/videos, pdfsList/pdfs, testsList/tests, topics[], progress, isCompleted }.

nodes.label: Test deep-link route /test/:testId
nodes.rationale: Test items navigate to /test/{test.testId || test.id}, indicating a separate test-taking page keyed by test id.

nodes.label: dataService.js
nodes.rationale: Consolidated data service module combining API client and data fetching functionality for admin-panel

nodes.label: DataError class
nodes.rationale: Base error class extending native Error with code and details fields, forming a custom error hierarchy

nodes.label: NetworkError class
nodes.rationale: Subclass of DataError with code NETWORK_ERROR, raised for network and request setup failures

nodes.label: ValidationError class
nodes.rationale: Subclass of DataError with code VALIDATION_ERROR, raised on 400 responses and invalid input

nodes.label: AuthenticationError class
nodes.rationale: Subclass of DataError with code AUTHENTICATION_ERROR, raised on 401/403 responses and dispatches 'unauthorized' window event

nodes.label: NotFoundError class
nodes.rationale: Subclass of DataError with code NOT_FOUND_ERROR, raised on 404 responses

nodes.label: CacheService class
nodes.rationale: In-memory TTL cache using Map with defaultTTL=30s and longTTL=5min, supports generateKey/set/get/has/delete/clear/getStats with auto-expiration via setTimeout

nodes.label: DataService class
nodes.rationale: Main service class encapsulating CacheService, loading state deduplication, retry logic with exponential backoff (max 3), and high-level cached fetchers (getTestSeries, getTests, getQuestions, etc.)

nodes.label: dataService singleton
nodes.rationale: Module-level singleton instance of DataService, exported alongside apiClient; uses Singleton pattern

nodes.label: fetchFromAPI function
nodes.rationale: Generic axios wrapper providing fetch-like interface for backward compatibility, converts body to axios data

nodes.label: mapTestSeriesToFrontend
nodes.rationale: Mapping function normalizing backend series (_id/id/public_id) to frontend id field, inlined to avoid circular dependency

nodes.label: mapTestToFrontend
nodes.rationale: Mapping function normalizing backend test entities (_id/id/public_id) to frontend id field

nodes.label: mapQuestionToFrontend
nodes.rationale: Mapping function normalizing backend question entities (_id/id/public_id) to frontend id field

nodes.label: authAPI namespace
nodes.rationale: Authentication API namespace exposing login, register, logout, getMe, refreshToken with input validation (email regex, password length 6/8)

nodes.label: seriesAPI namespace
nodes.rationale: Test series API namespace: getAll, getById, create, update, delete, getByCategory, getTests

nodes.label: testsAPI namespace
nodes.rationale: Tests API namespace with getAll, getById, getByTag, getBySeriesId, getQuestions, startAttempt, submitAttempt, getResult, attempt management (start/pause/resume/saveProgress/getState/logEvent/getAnalytics), create/update/delete

nodes.label: userAPI namespace
nodes.rationale: User API namespace: profile, updateProfile, enrollSeries, unenrollFromSeries, getEnrolledSeries, getAttempts, getAnalytics, deleteAccount

nodes.label: notificationPrefAPI namespace
nodes.rationale: Notification preferences API namespace with subscribe method

nodes.label: studyAPI namespace
nodes.rationale: Study API namespace using SLUG-based public routing with backward-compatible getById/getChapters aliases; includes getAll, getBySlug, getChaptersBySlug, getResource

nodes.label: questionsAPI namespace
nodes.rationale: Questions API namespace with server-side paginated getAll (limit 2000), getByTestId, create/update/delete, bulkUpload with input validation (>=2 options, valid correct index)

nodes.label: examAPI namespace
nodes.rationale: Public exam data API: categories, exams, exam info, updates, yearly-data, public stats, testimonials, promotions

nodes.label: Request interceptor
nodes.rationale: Axios request interceptor adding X-Admin-API-Key and CSRF token; Issue #42, Audit Fix #CRIT-03: no localStorage token fallback, httpOnly cookies only

nodes.label: Response interceptor
nodes.rationale: Axios response interceptor mapping HTTP statuses to typed errors (400->ValidationError, 401->AuthenticationError with sessionStorage cleanup, 403->AuthenticationError, 404->NotFoundError, 500->DataError)

nodes.label: fetchWithCache method
nodes.rationale: Generic cached fetch with options for forceRefresh, ttl, useCache, retries, retryDelay; prevents duplicate requests via loadingStates map; exponential backoff retry; skips retry on ValidationError/AuthenticationError

nodes.label: handleMutation method
nodes.rationale: Wraps mutation function and clears affected endpoint caches plus /admin/ and /study prefixes after successful operation

nodes.label: Exponential backoff retry
nodes.rationale: Retry delay computed as retryDelay * 2^(attempt-1), implemented in DataService.fetchWithCache

nodes.label: Intelligence leaderboard API
nodes.rationale: Exports getIntelligenceLeaderboard, getUserStreak, getTopPerformersLeaderboard, getTopPerformers backed by /api/intelligence/* endpoints

nodes.label: Admin API Key
nodes.rationale: Optional admin authentication key from VITE_ADMIN_API_KEY env var, sent via X-Admin-API-Key header

nodes.label: AdminSettings.jsx
nodes.rationale: Admin panel feature module that lets administrators configure global site settings via a tabbed UI (general, appearance, security, email, payment, notifications).

nodes.label: SiteSettingsManager Component
nodes.rationale: Default-exported React component that owns the settings state machine, fetch/save flow, tab routing, and all form rendering.

nodes.label: handleSave
nodes.rationale: PUTs the full settings object to /api/admin/settings, shows toast notifications and a transient saveStatus banner.

nodes.label: fetchSettings
nodes.rationale: GETs /api/admin/settings on mount and deep-merges server response with local defaults so partial responses do not break nested tabs.

nodes.label: handleTestEmail
nodes.rationale: POSTs the current SMTP configuration to /api/admin/settings/test-email and renders the success/error result banner.

nodes.label: handleInputChange
nodes.rationale: Dotted-path setter that mutates the nested settings state (e.g. appearance.primaryColor) without losing sibling fields.

nodes.label: Settings State Shape
nodes.rationale: Canonical default settings covering site info, social links, feature flags, appearance (colors/theme/font), security (password policy, 2FA, session timeout), SMTP, payment gateways, and notifications.

nodes.label: Settings Tabs Config
nodes.rationale: Static tab list (general, appearance, security, email, payment, notifications) paired with lucide-react icons; drives conditional form rendering.

nodes.label: General Settings Section
nodes.rationale: Basic info, SEO meta (title/description/keywords), social links, and feature toggles (registration, email verification, payment, maintenance, demo mode).

nodes.label: Appearance Settings Section
nodes.rationale: Theme colors (primary/secondary), theme mode (light/dark/auto), font family, and logo position controls.

nodes.label: Security Settings Section
nodes.rationale: Password policy (min length, complexity), max login attempts, session timeout, and 2FA enable/disable.

nodes.label: Email Settings Section
nodes.rationale: SMTP host/port/credentials, TLS/SSL encryption selector, default from-email/name, plus a Send Test Email action that calls the test endpoint.

nodes.label: Payment Settings Section
nodes.rationale: Credentials for Stripe, Razorpay, and PayPal; currency selector (INR/USD/EUR/GBP/JPY); tax enable/rate inputs.

nodes.label: Notifications Settings Section
nodes.rationale: Per-channel notification toggles (email on registration, email on payment, SMS on order, push) and frequency (instant/daily/weekly/monthly).

nodes.label: Password Visibility Toggle
nodes.rationale: Reusable show/hide eye-icon control for sensitive secrets (SMTP password, Stripe/Razorpay/PayPal secrets); backed by per-field showPassword state.

nodes.label: GET/PUT /api/admin/settings
nodes.rationale: Backend admin API used by fetchSettings (GET) and handleSave (PUT) to read and persist the global settings document.

nodes.label: POST /api/admin/settings/test-email
nodes.rationale: Backend admin API invoked by handleTestEmail to dispatch a verification SMTP message with the current settings.

nodes.label: apiClient (dataService.js)
nodes.rationale: Shared HTTP client wrapper from src/shared/lib/dataService.js used for all backend calls in this module.

nodes.label: Stripe Credentials Config
nodes.rationale: Stripe public/secret key inputs feeding the payment settings document; secrets stored as password-masked fields.

nodes.label: Razorpay Credentials Config
nodes.rationale: Razorpay key id/secret inputs configured for the Indian payment rail; common for SSC/Railway test series audiences.

nodes.label: PayPal Credentials Config
nodes.rationale: PayPal client id/secret inputs providing an international payment option alongside Stripe and Razorpay.

nodes.label: SMTP Email Provider
nodes.rationale: Outbound mail configuration (host, port, TLS/SSL, from identity) used by transactional notifications and the Test Email action.

nodes.label: Deep-merge fetched settings with defaults
nodes.rationale: Defensive pattern ensuring every nested object (socialLinks, features, appearance, security, email, payment, notifications) exists even if the backend returns a partial document.

nodes.label: SectionsManager.jsx
nodes.rationale: Admin panel React component that manages test sections (CRUD, presets, reordering, stats) for the assessments/quizzes feature.

nodes.label: SectionsManager Component
nodes.rationale: Default-exported React component (function SectionsManager) that holds section list state, form modal, search, stats grid, and exam-scheme preset UI; accepts optional testId prop to scope data.

nodes.label: DEFAULT_SECTION_FORM
nodes.rationale: Initial form values for create/edit including time_limit (seconds), passing_marks, marks_per_question, negative_marks, exam_stage, paper, session, section_code, is_qualifying; legacy duration field kept but time_limit preferred.

nodes.label: SSC_CGL_2025_PRESETS
nodes.rationale: Hard-coded exam-scheme presets for SSC CGL 2025 (Tier-I, Tier-II Paper-I, Tier-II Paper-II statistics) used by applyPreset to bulk-create sections with predefined time/marks/negative marking per official pattern.

nodes.label: fetchData
nodes.rationale: Parallel-loads categories, tests, and (optionally testId-filtered) sections via Promise.allSettled, gracefully handling partial failures and surfacing sections error to user.

nodes.label: normalizeSection
nodes.rationale: Coerces API rows that may use snake_case or camelCase keys into a uniform shape; applied to every section before render and used to populate the edit form.

nodes.label: validateSection
nodes.rationale: useCallback-wrapped client-side validator: enforces required unique name within a test, time_limit >= 60s, positive marks_per_question (unless the section is non-question activity), and negative_marks <= marks_per_question.

nodes.label: applyPreset
nodes.rationale: Bulk-creates sections for the currently selected test from a chosen SSC_CGL_2025_PRESETS entry, skipping any preset rows whose section name already exists; converts seconds to minutes for the legacy duration field.

nodes.label: handleSubmit
nodes.rationale: Form submit handler that runs validateSection then validateForm(sectionSchema) (Zod), POSTs new sections or PUTs updates to /api/admin/sections, and refreshes the list on success.

nodes.label: handleDelete
nodes.rationale: Confirm-then-DELETE handler that removes a section via /api/admin/sections/:id and reloads the list.

nodes.label: handleReorder
nodes.rationale: Updates a single section display_order via PUT and refetches; controls drag-reorder persistence.

nodes.label: Stats Memo
nodes.rationale: useMemo computing total/active/with-questions counts plus planned question and marks sums, scoped to the active testId when present; backs the 5-card stats grid.

nodes.label: Section Form Modal
nodes.rationale: Modal create/edit form (fixed overlay) covering name, category, linked test, exam stage/paper/session/code, timing and scoring, difficulty and flags (locked/shuffle/qualifying), instructions, and display order.

nodes.label: apiClient (shared/lib/dataService)
nodes.rationale: Shared HTTP client imported via ../../../shared/lib/dataService; provides get/put/post/delete used for /api/admin/sections CRUD.

nodes.label: adminAPI (shared/lib/dataService)
nodes.rationale: Named helper set from dataService exposing getTestCategories() and getTests() used to populate the category and test dropdowns.

nodes.label: sectionSchema / validateForm
nodes.rationale: Zod schema and helper from shared/lib/validationSchemas applied before submit to enforce name/description/testId/duration/order shape at the form boundary.

nodes.label: Backend: /api/admin/sections
nodes.rationale: REST endpoints hit for list (optionally ?testId=), create POST, update PUT /:id, and delete DELETE /:id; persists sections to the backend.

nodes.label: Exam Scheme Presets
nodes.rationale: Design decision: instead of admins manually entering each SSC CGL 2025 section, presets let them scaffold Tier-I/II structure in one click; encoded as SSC_CGL_2025_PRESETS with rows of [name, stage, paper, session, code, expectedQs, totalMarks, marksPerQ, negMarks, timeLimit, isQualifying].

nodes.label: snake_case / camelCase Key Normalization
nodes.rationale: Decision to accept both snake_case and camelCase fields from the API (e.g. time_limit vs timeLimit) via normalizeSection; protects the UI from breaking when the backend renames columns.

nodes.label: Time Limit in Seconds
nodes.rationale: Time is stored and validated in seconds (time_limit, default 900s/15min, min 60s) with minutes shown derived; the legacy duration field (minutes) is kept only for backward compatibility per the inline comment.

nodes.label: Section Validation Rules
nodes.rationale: Documented rules: unique name within a test, time_limit >= 60s, marks_per_question > 0 (except for non-question activities like DEST), negative_marks must be 0..marks_per_question.

nodes.label: Sections Table View
nodes.rationale: Admin tabular view with columns: Order, Name, Scheme (stage + paper/session/code), Test (when not propTestId), Qs (linked count with warning), Plan (expected/total + qualifying), Time, Marks, Neg, Locked, Status, Actions.

nodes.label: test.routes.js
nodes.rationale: Express router module that exposes all test-related HTTP endpoints (list, detail, questions, start, autosave, submit, result) under /api/tests for the testprep backend.

nodes.label: GET /api/tests
nodes.rationale: Public endpoint returning all active tests whose status is publishable per testStateMachine, enriched with banner asset URLs.

nodes.label: GET /api/tests/series/:seriesId
nodes.rationale: Public endpoint returning all published tests belonging to a given test series, banner-enriched.

nodes.label: GET /api/tests/tag/:tag
nodes.rationale: Public endpoint filtering tests by tag (live-tests, pyps, quizzes, practice) and re-mapping seriesId to public response IDs.

nodes.label: GET /api/tests/:testId
nodes.rationale: Optional-auth public endpoint returning full test details, computing hasAccess flag for Pro-restricted content.

nodes.label: GET /api/tests/:testId/questions
nodes.rationale: Private endpoint serving sanitized test questions (correct answers stripped) for the attempt flow; gates Pro-restricted tests.

nodes.label: POST /api/tests/:testId/start
nodes.rationale: Private endpoint that creates or resumes an attempt, enforces attempt limits for non-pro users, snapshots each question with its version, and emits test_started domain event.

nodes.label: PUT /api/tests/:testId/autosave
nodes.rationale: Private endpoint persisting in-progress answers, timers, marked-for-review and section state; rejects updates on completed attempts.

nodes.label: PUT /api/tests/:testId/submit
nodes.rationale: Private transactional endpoint that scores the submission, enforces server-authoritative timer tamper protection, writes an outbox_events row, and fans out post-submit work to analytics/leaderboard/recommendation/notification services.

nodes.label: GET /api/tests/:testId/result/:attemptId
nodes.rationale: Private endpoint returning the full result payload (questions, answers, rank, percentile) for a specific attempt.

nodes.label: GET /api/tests/:testId/result
nodes.rationale: Private endpoint returning the user latest completed attempt result for a given test, merging results + attempts collections.

nodes.label: getRankAndPercentile()
nodes.rationale: Computes user rank, totalParticipants, and percentile for an attempt via raw SQL with a best-score / least-time aggregation; falls back to in-memory sort if SQL fails.

nodes.label: buildResultPayload()
nodes.rationale: Assembles the final test-result response object: maps public IDs, merges question+attempt+rank data, computes accuracy/correct/wrong/unattempted counts.

nodes.label: normalizeSubmittedAnswers()
nodes.rationale: Resolves public/slug questionIds in submitted answers to internal numeric IDs using a per-request cache; non-questionIds pass through unchanged.

nodes.label: enrichTestsWithBannerAssets()
nodes.rationale: Joins each test to its banner asset, resolving signed/public access URLs via storageProvider; also normalizes testSeriesId and bannerAssetId shapes.

nodes.label: enrichQuestionsWithImageAssets()
nodes.rationale: Joins each question to its image asset through buildAssetMap, mirroring the test-banner enrichment for question images.

nodes.label: sanitizeQuestionForAttempt()
nodes.rationale: Strips correctAnswer/isCorrect and sanitizes all option variants (en/hi) before sending questions to the client, preventing answer leakage.

nodes.label: publishEvent()
nodes.rationale: Thin wrapper around emitDomainEvent that logs and swallows errors so background domain events never break the HTTP response path.

nodes.label: analyticsService
nodes.rationale: Invoked on submit to process per-test-submission analytics; part of the synchronous post-submit fan-out.

nodes.label: leaderboardService
nodes.rationale: Recomputes leaderboard rankings when a test is submitted, triggered in parallel with analytics/recommendations/notifications.

nodes.label: recommendationService
nodes.rationale: Refreshes personalized recommendations based on the new submission event, so the queue-less fallback path still updates recommendations.

nodes.label: notificationService
nodes.rationale: Dispatches a result-available push/in-app notification to the user on successful submission.

nodes.label: testStateMachine
nodes.rationale: Decides which test statuses are visible to end users (isAvailableToUsers), applied in list/series/question endpoints.

nodes.label: auth.middleware (protect/optionalAuth)
nodes.rationale: JWT-based auth middleware used to gate private routes (start, autosave, submit, result) and to optionally enrich public routes with req.user.

nodes.label: eventBus (emitDomainEvent)
nodes.rationale: Domain-event bus that publishes test_started events from this module and consumes the corresponding test_submitted outbox row written transactionally.

nodes.label: storageProvider (resolveAssetAccessUrl)
nodes.rationale: Abstracts asset access URLs (signed/public) for banner and question-image assets.

nodes.label: QuestionModel.ensureVersion()
nodes.rationale: Dynamic import used per question at start time to capture a versioned snapshot of each question, enabling tamper-proof results if questions change after the attempt.

nodes.label: Pro-Pass Access Control
nodes.rationale: isProRestrictedTest / isProUser pair enforces that Pro-tagged tests return 403 for free users across detail, questions, start, and submit endpoints; the design decision is to keep gating centralized in shared user-utils.

nodes.label: Attempt Limits
nodes.rationale: checkAttemptLimit blocks creation of new attempts for users who have exhausted their free quota on a given test, returning 403 with limitReached: true.

nodes.label: Question Snapshots
nodes.rationale: On start, every question is copied into attemptQuestionSnapshots with its version ID, so scoring and result endpoints can use the immutable snapshot rather than the live question row - critical for fairness when questions are edited after attempts.

nodes.label: Server-Authoritative Timer
nodes.rationale: Submit compares now vs expiresAt; submissions after a 5-minute grace window are capped to test duration and marked expired_submission to prevent users extending their own time client-side.

nodes.label: Transactional Outbox
nodes.rationale: Submit inserts a row into outbox_events inside the same SQL transaction as the attempt update, guaranteeing at-least-once delivery of test_submitted events to downstream consumers even on crash.

nodes.label: Public ID Mapping
nodes.rationale: All outgoing responses use getPublicResponseId to translate internal numeric IDs to slugs/public IDs, decoupling clients from the underlying numeric/ObjectID scheme.

nodes.label: attempts table
nodes.rationale: Stores both in-progress and completed attempts; locked FOR UPDATE during submit to enforce idempotency on concurrent submissions.

nodes.label: attemptQuestionSnapshots table
nodes.rationale: Versioned copy of each question at attempt-start time, used as the source of truth for scoring and result rendering.

nodes.label: outbox_events table
nodes.rationale: Transactional outbox populated with the validated test_submitted event payload for at-least-once delivery to async consumers.

nodes.label: assets collection
nodes.rationale: Stores banner and question-image assets queried by id $in to resolve access URLs in bulk via buildAssetMap.

nodes.label: TestReview.jsx
nodes.rationale: React page component rendering the post-test review/solutions view with question navigation, palette, and practice mode.

nodes.label: TestReview component
nodes.rationale: Default-exported React component that orchestrates the entire review screen; consumes route params, auth context, and test result data.

nodes.label: fetchTestData effect
nodes.rationale: useEffect that hydrates test data from location state or calls the API endpoint /api/tests/:testId/result[/:attemptId].

nodes.label: normalizedQuestions
nodes.rationale: useMemo that adapts backend question shape (questionText/question/text, options, correctOption) into a uniform structure with bilingual text objects.

nodes.label: userAnswers
nodes.rationale: useMemo deriving per-question attempt result; in solutions mode returns null placeholders to suppress user-attempt highlights.

nodes.label: sectionStats
nodes.rationale: useMemo aggregating correct/incorrect/unattempted counts per current section, with special handling for practice mode and solutions mode.

nodes.label: getQuestionStatusClass
nodes.rationale: Helper returning Tailwind class string for palette buttons based on attempt state, correctness, and reattempt mode.

nodes.label: changeSection
nodes.rationale: Switches currentSection state and jumps the question index to the first question of that section.

nodes.label: Practice Mode toggle
nodes.rationale: UI control flipping reattemptMode state so users can re-answer questions interactively; auto-enables explanations.

nodes.label: Explanations toggle
nodes.rationale: UI control toggling showExplanation; gates rendering of detailed explanation block and option highlight states.

nodes.label: Language switcher (EN/HI)
nodes.rationale: Button that flips the display language between English and Hindi; used to select localized text from bilingual question/explanation objects.

nodes.label: Question Palette sidebar
nodes.rationale: Right-side grid of question buttons scoped to current section; supports mobile slide-over and shows per-question status colors.

nodes.label: Test Review route
nodes.rationale: React route param contract: /test-review/:testId with optional seriesId and ?mode=solutions or ?attemptId query.

nodes.label: Review API endpoints
nodes.rationale: Backend endpoints consumed for fetching test result data: GET /api/tests/:testId/result and /api/tests/:testId/result/:attemptId.

nodes.label: sanitizeHtml utility
nodes.rationale: Local shared lib used to sanitize question text, option text, and explanations before dangerouslySetInnerHTML rendering.

nodes.label: AuthContext useAuth
nodes.rationale: React context that supplies the current user object for the profile card (name, avatar, studentId, initials).

nodes.label: Solutions mode flag
nodes.rationale: Derived from ?mode=solutions or location.state.mode; suppresses attempt highlights and forces unattempted stats so the screen acts as a pure solution key.

nodes.label: Reattempt / Practice mode state
nodes.rationale: Boolean state that enables interactive re-answering, drives palette color states, gating of explanation reveal, and reset-attempt actions.

nodes.label: formatTimeSpent
nodes.rationale: Formats seconds into human-readable strings like 45s, 2m, 2m 15s; used in the Time Taken badge in the question header.

nodes.label: Navigation handlers (Prev/Next/Back)
nodes.rationale: handlePrevious, handleNext, and the multi-location back-to-results / close-window logic shared by header, footer, and sidebar buttons.

nodes.label: Loading and error states
nodes.rationale: Early-return UI for the spinner during fetch and the error/empty-state panel that links back to the dashboard.

nodes.label: Option render cell
nodes.rationale: Per-option button with complex class logic distinguishing correct, same-as-attempt, different-from-attempt, and selected options; emits Attempt/Same/New/Correct badges.

nodes.label: Reattempt vs Review design rationale
nodes.rationale: Design decision: reattemptMode layers interactive answers on top of stored userAnswers so users can compare new attempt with original (Same/New/Correct badges) and reveal correct answers only after they have attempted.

nodes.label: dataService.js (Consolidated Data Service)
nodes.rationale: Frontend data layer that consolidates axios client, API namespaces, caching, and retry/loading logic. Used app-wide to talk to the backend.

nodes.label: Error Hierarchy (DataError / NetworkError / ValidationError / AuthenticationError / NotFoundError)
nodes.rationale: Typed error classes (lines 8-43) emitted by interceptors; lets callers distinguish 400/401/403/404/500 vs network failures.

nodes.label: fetchFromAPI (generic fetch wrapper)
nodes.rationale: Backwards-compat shim accepting fetch-style options (body/headers/method) and routing through apiClient; returns response.data or throws.

nodes.label: authAPI (login/register/logout/getMe/refreshToken)
nodes.rationale: Auth endpoints with input validation (email regex, password length 6/8) before POSTing to /api/auth/*.

nodes.label: seriesAPI (test series CRUD + listing)
nodes.rationale: Public + admin endpoints for test series (uses /api/series and /api/admin/test-series); includes getByCategory and getTests child lookup.

nodes.label: studyAPI (public slug-based study materials)
nodes.rationale: Public study endpoints using SLUG-based routing (not ID) for /api/study/:slug and /api/study/:slug/chapters; getById/getChapters are aliases kept for back-compat.

nodes.label: questionsAPI (admin questions CRUD + bulk upload)
nodes.rationale: Admin-only question endpoints with payload validation (text/options/correct/testId required, options >= 2, correct index in range).

nodes.label: examAPI (categories, exams, public stats, testimonials, promotions)
nodes.rationale: Public exam/category lookups plus testimonials and promotions consumed by marketing/dashboard pages.

nodes.label: adminAPI (admin-only namespaces)
nodes.rationale: Large admin surface (users, stages, test-series, tests, study-materials, chapters, subject-videos, subject-pdfs, topic-tests, trash, questions, exam-categories, live-tests, leaderboards, banners, faqs, promotions, quizzes, enrollments, results, bookmarks, notifications, achievements).

nodes.label: CacheService (TTL Map cache)
nodes.rationale: In-memory cache with default 30s and long 5min TTLs, auto-expiry via setTimeout, and stats helper.

nodes.label: DataService (intelligent fetch layer)
nodes.rationale: Wraps CacheService with fetchWithCache (dedupes concurrent requests, exponential-backoff retries up to 3, no retry on validation/auth errors) and typed domain methods (getTestSeries, getTests, getQuestions, getStudyMaterials, getExamCategories, getExams, getTestCategories, search, plus by-id lookups accepting multiple ID formats).

nodes.label: dataService singleton + convenience exports
nodes.rationale: Single shared DataService instance; convenience top-level exports (getTestSeries, getTests, refreshData, forceRefreshAll, handleMutation, searchAll, getIntelligenceLeaderboard, getUserStreak, getTopPerformers, etc.) plus an pi alias for legacy imports.

nodes.label: CSRF + httpOnly cookie auth flow
nodes.rationale: Decision: withCredentials=true on apiClient (httpOnly token storage, Issue #21) and X-CSRF-Token header injected on POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH via getCsrfToken(). On 401 the client dispatches an unauthorized window event so auth state can clear.

nodes.label: Caching + retry strategy
nodes.rationale: Decision: short TTL for volatile data, long TTL (5 min) for slow-changing lists (series/exams/categories); fetchWithCache dedupes in-flight requests and retries with exponential backoff but skips retry on validation/auth errors. handleMutation invalidates affected endpoints + /admin/ + /study caches after successful writes.

nodes.label: Multi-format ID lookup (id/_id/slug/public_id)
nodes.rationale: Decision: getTestSeriesById / getTestById / getQuestionsByTestId accept numeric id, string id, _id, slug, or public_id because the backend exposes several identifier shapes and URL params are always strings.

nodes.label: @trstprep/shared-config (getCsrfToken)
nodes.rationale: Monorepo shared package that provides getCsrfToken for CSRF protection on state-changing requests.

nodes.label: apiBase.js (API_BASE_URL)
nodes.rationale: Local module exporting the backend base URL used as baseURL for apiClient.

nodes.label: ../types/index.js (frontend mappers)
nodes.rationale: Imports mapUserToFrontend / mapTestSeriesToFrontend / mapTestToFrontend / mapQuestionToFrontend used by DataService to normalize backend payloads to frontend shape.

nodes.label: ExamsNew.jsx
nodes.rationale: Main React page component for the Government Exams Portal listing exam categories, test series, and individual exams with filtering and search.

nodes.label: ExamsNew Component
nodes.rationale: Top-level default-exported React component orchestrating data fetch, filter state, URL sync, and rendering of categories/grid/list views.

nodes.label: getCategoryConfig
nodes.rationale: Named exported utility that maps a category object (or null) to UI config (label, icon, gradient color, description) using MODERN_GRADIENTS/MODERN_ICONS fallbacks.

nodes.label: ExamCard Component
nodes.rationale: Reusable card used in both grid and list views, renders exam summary, test/user counts, bookmark toggle, and links to /exam-info/:examId.

nodes.label: fetchData
nodes.rationale: Async loader that calls dataService endpoints in parallel (categories, exams, test series, public stats) and hydrates bookmarks from localStorage.

nodes.label: toggleBookmark
nodes.rationale: useCallback that flips an examId in bookmarkedExams state and persists the result to localStorage under key bookmarkedExams.

nodes.label: processedExams
nodes.rationale: useMemo that decorates every exam with its category label/icon/color and the count of test series belonging to that category, used as the base dataset for filters and stats.

nodes.label: filteredExams
nodes.rationale: useMemo that applies category, search (title/fullName/description), level/frequency/status, and sort (popular/name/upcoming/tests) over processedExams.

nodes.label: categoryStats
nodes.rationale: useMemo that aggregates totalExams/totalTests/totalUsers per categoryId, plus an other bucket for orphaned exams, used by the sidebar and category cards.

nodes.label: MODERN_GRADIENTS / MODERN_ICONS
nodes.rationale: Module-level color/emoji fallbacks assigned to categories via modulo index, enabling the gradient category-card aesthetic when DB fields are missing.

nodes.label: filterOptions
nodes.rationale: Static config for the level/frequency/status select filters in the expanded filter panel.

nodes.label: dataService
nodes.rationale: Backend abstraction providing getExamCategories, getExams, getTestSeries, getPublicStats called in fetchData via Promise.all.

nodes.label: Breadcrumb
nodes.rationale: Shared common component rendering Home > Exam Categories trail at the top of the page.

nodes.label: AnimatedHero
nodes.rationale: Reusable hero section wrapper with pageType=exams and compact mode used for the page intro and animated headline.

nodes.label: SearchBox
nodes.rationale: Imported but unused in current source (likely a leftover/refactor candidate) from shared/components/common.

nodes.label: react-router-dom
nodes.rationale: Provides Link, useNavigate, and useSearchParams used for navigation to /exam-info/:id and syncing q/category URL params.

nodes.label: bookmarkedExams (localStorage)
nodes.rationale: Client-side persistence key bookmarkedExams storing the user bookmarked exam IDs as JSON; read on mount, rewritten on toggle.

nodes.label: Browse by Category view
nodes.rationale: Documented UI concept: the all categories landing layout showing category cards followed by up-to-4 exam cards per category, only rendered when selectedCategory==all.

nodes.label: /exam-info/:examId route
nodes.rationale: Outgoing navigation target from every ExamCard (grid + list variants) opening the exam detail page.

nodes.label: Quick Links sidebar
nodes.rationale: Static sidebar card with shortcuts to /test-series, /live-tests, /pyps, /study for cross-feature navigation.

nodes.label: Sort modes (popular/name/upcoming/tests)
nodes.rationale: Design decision: four sort strategies implemented in the filteredExams switch; upcoming sorts by nextExamDate ascending with a far-future sentinel for nulls.

nodes.label: admin-tests.js (Backend Route)
nodes.rationale: Express router for admin test CRUD, bulk operations, publish/unpublish, restore, reassign, export, cascade delete; central API for test lifecycle.

nodes.label: Analysis.jsx (Dashboard Page)
nodes.rationale: React dashboard page rendering user performance analytics: stats, subject performance, strengths/weaknesses, AI recommendations, and tabbed views.

nodes.label: GET /api/admin/tests (List)
nodes.rationale: Lists active tests with pagination (limit/offset), supports filtering by seriesId, stageId, testCategoryId, _orphaned.

nodes.label: GET /api/admin/tests/orphaned
nodes.rationale: Returns tests flagged _orphaned=true (no longer associated with a series) so admins can reassign them.

nodes.label: GET /api/admin/tests/export
nodes.rationale: Streams all tests as a CSV with UTF-8 BOM in batches of 1000; joins test_series for export context.

nodes.label: POST /api/admin/tests (Create)
nodes.rationale: Creates a test with slug uniqueness, test-series/category existence checks, stage resolution from tier (deprecated), status<->isActive sync, section linking.

nodes.label: PUT /api/admin/tests/:id (Update)
nodes.rationale: Updates a test, applies stage resolution, syncs status<->isActive, unlinks and re-links sections in test_sections junction.

nodes.label: POST /api/admin/tests/:id/duplicate
nodes.rationale: Clones a test appending (Copy) to title and -copy-{timestamp} to slug; new record is inactive.

nodes.label: POST /api/admin/tests/:id/publish
nodes.rationale: Validates test has linked questions with correct answers and >=2 options each, then sets status=published, isActive=true, stamps publishedAt, recomputes totals.

nodes.label: POST /api/admin/tests/:id/unpublish
nodes.rationale: Reverts published test back to draft, clears publishedAt, sets isActive=false.

nodes.label: DELETE /api/admin/tests/:id
nodes.rationale: Soft-deletes a test and cascades by flagging linked questions as _orphaned, deleting test_questions junction, and nulling in-progress attempts.series_id.

nodes.label: PUT /api/admin/tests/:id/restore
nodes.rationale: Restores a soft-deleted test from trash via dbHelpers.restoreFromTrash.

nodes.label: PUT /api/admin/tests/:id/reassign
nodes.rationale: Reassigns an orphaned test to a new testSeriesId and/or testCategoryId, clearing _orphaned flag.

nodes.label: POST /api/admin/tests/bulk-publish
nodes.rationale: Publishes multiple tests in a single request; collects per-test failures and returns successes/failures arrays.

nodes.label: POST /api/admin/tests/bulk-delete
nodes.rationale: Soft-deletes multiple tests with the same cascade behavior as single delete (orphan questions, cleanup junction).

nodes.label: POST /api/admin/tests/bulk
nodes.rationale: Accepts CSV/JSON/XLSX file or JSON body, parses rows, maps to test payload, validates testCategoryId, inserts in chunks of 500 via insertMany.

nodes.label: testSchema (Validation)
nodes.rationale: Defines allowed test fields with snake/camel aliasing (e.g. testSeriesId <-> test_series_id) used by validateBody middleware.

nodes.label: parseAssetId()
nodes.rationale: Normalizes incoming banner asset IDs, treating empty/null/undefined strings as null to avoid Postgres type errors.

nodes.label: normalizeTestPayloadForDb()
nodes.rationale: Strips testSeriesId/sectionIds aliases and standardizes snake+camel column writing so dbHelpers.insert* writes consistent data.

nodes.label: withTestSeriesAliases()
nodes.rationale: Reads tests from DB and adds testSeriesId/seriesId/stageId/testCategoryId camelCase aliases for frontend consumption.

nodes.label: mapBulkRowToTestPayload()
nodes.rationale: Converts a single row from CSV/JSON/XLSX into a full Test payload, applying config defaults and parsing comma-separated tags/languages/stageIds.

nodes.label: parseQuestionsCsv/Json/Spreadsheet()
nodes.rationale: Three parsers dispatching on file extension to convert uploads into row arrays; XLSX uses xlsx-js-style library.

nodes.label: Analysis (React component)
nodes.rationale: Default-exported React functional component gated by PRO access, fetching user analytics via react-query and rendering tabbed dashboard.

nodes.label: PRO Feature Gate
nodes.rationale: Uses checkFeatureAccess(performance_analytics) to render a locked Elite Access Required paywall for non-PRO users; admins always pass.

nodes.label: Stats Row (Accuracy/Rank/Percentile/Time)
nodes.rationale: 4-column grid of KPI cards derived from analytics (avgAccuracy, rank, percentile, totalHours).

nodes.label: Subject Performance Bars
nodes.rationale: Renders accuracy progress bars per subject using SUBJECT_COLORS mapping; fallback to indigo when subject unknown.

nodes.label: Strengths & Weaknesses Cards
nodes.rationale: Two side-by-side cards listing analytics.strongSubjects and analytics.weakSubjects with study/test-series deep links.

nodes.label: AI Smart Recommendations
nodes.rationale: Static gradient panel showing three hardcoded recommendations (time lag, concept review, daily goal) with CTAs to /test-series.

nodes.label: Overview Tab
nodes.rationale: Tab content: Answer Distribution (correct/wrong/skipped) and Recent Tests list linking to /tests/:id/result.

nodes.label: Subject Wise Tab
nodes.rationale: Tab content: Strongest/Weakest chapters side-by-side and full subject card list with accuracy color coding (>=80 green, >=60 amber, else red).

nodes.label: Progress Tab
nodes.rationale: Tab content: percentile banner with formatPercentile() and Areas for Improvement / Strengths lists with study links.

nodes.label: SUBJECT_COLORS Map
nodes.rationale: Static mapping from subject name to Tailwind color tokens (bg/text/light/border) used by getSubjectColor().

nodes.label: Cascade Orphan Questions
nodes.rationale: On test deletion, every linked question is flagged with _orphaned=true, _deletedTestId, orphanedAt; preserves questions for reassignment rather than hard delete.

nodes.label: stageIds[] vs tier (deprecation)
nodes.rationale: Tests previously linked to a stage via a tier string match (find stages by name); now prefer explicit stageIds[] array. WARN logged on use.

nodes.label: status <-> isActive Sync
nodes.rationale: status=published forces isActive=true; status=draft forces isActive=false; isActive=false forces status=draft. Avoids inconsistent state.

nodes.label: content:updated Broadcast
nodes.rationale: Every mutating route emits a content:updated event via eventBus with type/action/testId so connected frontends refresh caches.

nodes.label: express.Router
nodes.rationale: Node.js web framework used to define route handlers; backend admin-tests.js mounts all /api/admin/tests routes on a single router.

nodes.label: xlsx-js-style
nodes.rationale: Library for parsing XLSX/XLS files with style support; used by parseQuestionsSpreadsheet to read bulk test uploads.

nodes.label: multer (upload middleware)
nodes.rationale: Node multipart/form-data parsing middleware; exposed via bulkQuestionUpload.single(file) for the /tests/bulk endpoint.

nodes.label: @tanstack/react-query
nodes.rationale: Data-fetching library used by Analysis.jsx to cache getUserAnalytics and getTestSeries with staleTime and enabled gating.

nodes.label: postgres-helpers (dbHelpers/pool)
nodes.rationale: Infrastructure module providing find/findOne/findById/insertOne/insertMany/updateById/softDelete/restoreFromTrash and a shared pg Pool; used pervasively by admin-tests.js.

nodes.label: Test (data model)
nodes.rationale: ORM/model class from data/models exposing Test.findByIdentifier(id) used by every per-id route to resolve id, _id, or slug.

nodes.label: inputValidation (validateBody/createSchema)
nodes.rationale: Validation middleware factory; createSchema().field(...) builds schemas and validateBody enforces them on POST/PUT.

nodes.label: eventBus (emitBroadcastEvent)
nodes.rationale: Infrastructure module broadcasting real-time events; used for content:updated fan-out on every test mutation.

nodes.label: sendResponse utils (sendError/sendNotFound/sendSuccessMessage)
nodes.rationale: Shared response helpers that standardize error/success JSON shape; used in every catch block.

nodes.label: dataService (getUserAnalytics/getTestSeries)
nodes.rationale: Frontend API abstraction that wraps fetch calls to backend analytics endpoints; consumed via react-query in Analysis.jsx.

nodes.label: pass-helpers (checkFeatureAccess)
nodes.rationale: Shared util checking user passType against a feature allowlist; Analysis.jsx uses it for the performance_analytics PRO gate.

nodes.label: Settings.jsx (Frontend)
nodes.rationale: User-facing Settings page with profile, security, notifications, privacy, billing, and appearance tabs

nodes.label: Settings (Default Export)
nodes.rationale: Main React component for /settings route; manages 6 tabs (profile, security, notifications, privacy, billing, appearance) and orchestrates all user preference updates

nodes.label: DangerZoneSection
nodes.rationale: Sub-component handling account deactivation (sets isActive=false) and permanent deletion with confirmation modals; logs user out and redirects to /login after

nodes.label: BillingSectionContent
nodes.rationale: Renders plan type, payment method, billing history, and Help & Support links (Help Center, Privacy Policy, Terms of Service) for the Pro Pass tab

nodes.label: handleProfileSave
nodes.rationale: Saves name, mobile, dateOfBirth, education, bio, location via userAPI.updateProfile; refreshes user and shows success status

nodes.label: handlePasswordSave
nodes.rationale: Validates password form (min 8 chars, match) and calls authAPI.changePassword; forces re-login after password change

nodes.label: handleNotificationChange
nodes.rationale: Optimistically updates notification toggles and persists via userAPI.updateProfile; rolls back on failure

nodes.label: handlePrivacyChange
nodes.rationale: Persists profile visibility, showProgress, showOnLeaderboard, allowMessages via userAPI.updateProfile

nodes.label: handleExportData
nodes.rationale: Fetches profile, attempts, and analytics in parallel and downloads a JSON file with timestamped filename

nodes.label: handlePhotoChange
nodes.rationale: Reads avatar file as data URL (with 5MB limit), updates profile avatar, and refreshes user context

nodes.label: Profile Tab (Read-Only)
nodes.rationale: Read-only view of avatar and personal info; defers editing to /profile page

nodes.label: Security Tab
nodes.rationale: Password update form with show/hide toggle; includes Connected Devices placeholder (Coming Soon) and Danger Zone

nodes.label: Notifications Tab
nodes.rationale: Channel toggles (email, push, SMS) and learning reminder toggles (testReminders, weeklyReport, promotional)

nodes.label: Privacy Tab
nodes.rationale: Profile visibility dropdown (public/friends/private), progress/leaderboard/message toggles, and Export All Data button

nodes.label: Billing/Pro Pass Tab
nodes.rationale: Gradient Pro Pass card with active status and renewal date, plus Subscription Details and Upgrade Now link to /pass

nodes.label: Appearance Tab
nodes.rationale: Dark mode toggle and language selector (English/Hindi) stored in localStorage as trstprep_language

nodes.label: AuthContext (useAuth)
nodes.rationale: Provides user, refreshUser, logout; consumed by Settings for auth-gated redirect and post-action logout

nodes.label: ThemeContext (useTheme)
nodes.rationale: Provides isDarkMode and toggleDarkMode; powers the Appearance tab dark mode switch

nodes.label: useProPass Hook
nodes.rationale: Exposes proPass.isActive, formattedStartDate, formattedExpiry; populates the Billing/Pro Pass card

nodes.label: dataService (authAPI + userAPI)
nodes.rationale: Centralized API client; authAPI.changePassword, userAPI.updateProfile/deleteAccount/getProfile/getAttempts/getAnalytics all flow through it

nodes.label: UsersManager.jsx (Admin)
nodes.rationale: Admin-panel page for managing user accounts, roles, Pro Pass, enrollments, and active sessions

nodes.label: UsersManagerEnhanced
nodes.rationale: Default-exported React component for the admin users list with stats cards, filters, table, pagination, bulk actions, and detail modal

nodes.label: fetchUsers
nodes.rationale: Parallel-fetches /api/admin/users and /api/admin/roles via Promise.allSettled; populates users and systemRoles state

nodes.label: doAction
nodes.rationale: Generic optimistic-update helper: PUTs /api/admin/users/:id/:endpoint and patches local state on success

nodes.label: updateUserStatus
nodes.rationale: Toggles user.isActive via /api/admin/users/:id/status; used by individual row action and bulk Activate/Deactivate All

nodes.label: toggleProPass
nodes.rationale: Grants or revokes Pro Pass with passType prompt; hits /api/admin/users/:id/pro-pass

nodes.label: viewEnrollments
nodes.rationale: Opens detail modal in enrollments tab; fetches /api/admin/enrollments/user/:userId and synthesizes a Pro Pass entry if user isProUser

nodes.label: viewSessions
nodes.rationale: Opens detail modal in sessions tab; fetches /api/admin/users/:userId/sessions and renders device/OS/IP/last-active

nodes.label: revokeSession
nodes.rationale: Forces logout of a specific session via DELETE /api/admin/sessions/:sessionId and removes it from local state

nodes.label: updateSessionLimit
nodes.rationale: Overrides the per-user session cap via PUT /api/admin/users/:userId/session-limit (default tiers: 1 free, 3 pro, 5 admin/super_admin)

nodes.label: Bulk Actions Bar
nodes.rationale: Apply Activate All, Deactivate All, Make Admin, Remove Admin across selectedUsers selection

nodes.label: Client-side Pagination (20/page)
nodes.rationale: Slides filteredUsers into paginatedUsers of pageSize 20; renders numeric page buttons (max 7 shown)

nodes.label: Search + Status/Role Filters
nodes.rationale: useMemo over name/email search and status (active/inactive), role (admin/user/pro) filters; resets page on change

nodes.label: Stats Cards
nodes.rationale: Top-of-page KPI cards: Total Users, Active, Pro Users, Admins computed from users array

nodes.label: admin api client
nodes.rationale: Shared axios-style client from apps/admin-panel/src/shared/lib/api; all admin endpoints call into it

nodes.label: GET /api/admin/users
nodes.rationale: Returns the full admin user list (id/_id, name, email, isActive, role, isProUser, passType, proPassExpiry, createdAt, sessionLimit)

nodes.label: GET /api/admin/roles
nodes.rationale: Returns system-defined custom roles (name, displayName) rendered in the role select alongside built-in user/admin/super_admin

nodes.label: GET /api/admin/enrollments/user/:userId
nodes.rationale: Returns enrollments + totalEnrollments for a specific user (test series, study materials, pass purchases)

nodes.label: GET /api/admin/users/:userId/sessions
nodes.rationale: Returns active sessions (id, type, browser, os, ip, city, country, lastActive) for the user detail modal

nodes.label: DELETE /api/admin/sessions/:sessionId
nodes.rationale: Force-revokes an individual session from the admin Sessions tab

nodes.label: PUT /api/admin/users/:userId/session-limit
nodes.rationale: Override per-user session cap (1/2/3/5/10/100) without changing their role

nodes.label: PUT /api/admin/users/:userId/status
nodes.rationale: Toggle user.isActive (used by individual Ban/Activate action and bulk Activate/Deactivate All)

nodes.label: PUT /api/admin/users/:userId/role
nodes.rationale: Change user role (user/admin/super_admin/system role); invoked by inline role select and bulk Make/Remove Admin

nodes.label: PUT /api/admin/users/:userId/pro-pass
nodes.rationale: Grant or revoke Pro Pass with passType (e.g. pro_yearly, pro_monthly)

nodes.label: Trstprep Pro Pass (Subscription)
nodes.rationale: Subscription concept spanning both files: user can manage in Settings > Billing, admin can grant/revoke in UsersManager with passType and expiry

nodes.label: user.routes.js
nodes.rationale: Express router aggregating all /api/users endpoints (profile, enrollment, analytics, attempts, sessions, leaderboard)

nodes.label: profileUpdateSchema
nodes.rationale: Validation schema (Issue #33) defining editable profile fields with length constraints, including 10MB base64 avatar/banner

nodes.label: saveProfileAsset()
nodes.rationale: Decodes base64 data URL, writes avatar/banner file to uploads/avatars, returns public /assets/avatar/ path

nodes.label: deleteOldProfileAsset()
nodes.rationale: Security-checked unlink of old avatar/banner files scoped strictly to /assets/avatar/ prefix

nodes.label: GET /api/users/profile
nodes.rationale: Returns sanitized user, enrolled series, and attemptedTests map (built via buildPublicIdLookup)

nodes.label: PUT /api/users/profile
nodes.rationale: Updates profile with sanitization, avatar/banner upload, notification/privacy normalization, soft-deactivation
