nodes.rationale: End-to-end revenue funnel: public Pass page sells Pro Pass via Razorpay; admin panel creates promotional codes that discount/extend that same product

nodes.label: Three-Step Razorpay Pattern
nodes.rationale: Industry-standard pattern: (1) backend create-order, (2) frontend open Razorpay modal with order_id, (3) backend verify signature - protects against client-side tampering

nodes.label: Urgency-Driven Renewal UI
nodes.rationale: Pass status section escalates visual urgency (border/badge/text colors) via getUrgencyColors + isExpiringWithin(30) to drive renewal conversion before expiry

nodes.label: Three Promotion Types
nodes.rationale: Promo system supports 3 mutually-exclusive types: percentage discount (with max cap), trial extension (extra days), credits bonus - each with type-specific form fields

nodes.label: Demo Fallback Pattern
nodes.rationale: Admin handlers catch API errors and optimistically update local state with success toast - allows demoing UI when backend endpoints are unimplemented

nodes.label: 5s Background Plan Polling
nodes.rationale: Pass page polls /api/subscription-plans every 5 seconds in the background so admin price/feature changes propagate to viewers without manual refresh

nodes.label: Leaderboard Page
nodes.rationale: React page rendering all-India ranking leaderboard with PRO pass gating, category tabs, podium, search and rank stats.

nodes.label: CATEGORIES (Overall/Daily/Weekly/Test/Series/Performance)
nodes.rationale: Static tab definitions driving the leaderboard view mode and backend query type.

nodes.label: PRO Pass Access Gate
nodes.rationale: checkFeatureAccess('leaderboard') + admin-role check; renders Upsell card with 'Unlock Arena' CTA when not entitled.

nodes.label: React Query hooks (leaderboard/streak/tests/series)
nodes.rationale: useQuery fetches with staleTime caching: lbData, streakData, testsData, seriesData keyed on cat/testId/seriesId/perfView.

nodes.label: renderPodium (Top-3 visualization)
nodes.rationale: Gold/silver/bronze stacked podium with gradient backgrounds, medals, scores, accuracy; highlights current user with brand ring.

nodes.label: renderRow / renderTable (rankings list)
nodes.rationale: Desktop table and mobile row renderers with percentile/accuracy bars, YOU badge, time formatting, and current-user highlight.

nodes.label: User Rank Stats (Your Position card)
nodes.rationale: Computes percentile and points-to-next-rank from entries index; shown in gradient brand card above the rankings.

nodes.label: Performance View (fastest vs accuracy sort)
nodes.rationale: perfView toggle sorts leaderboard entries by timeSpentSeconds or accuracy; surfaces avg/top/best-acc stat tiles.

nodes.label: dataService (leaderboard/test/streak APIs)
nodes.rationale: Imported API wrappers: getIntelligenceLeaderboard, getUserStreak, getTests, getTestSeries; central backend client.

nodes.label: AdminLayout Shell
nodes.rationale: Top-level layout for admin panel: responsive sidebar, top bar, search palette, profile menu, theme toggle, mobile bottom nav and Outlet for child routes.

nodes.label: adminNavConfig (categories/items/breadcrumbs)
nodes.rationale: Imported nav registry: adminNavConfig, getFlatNavItems, getBreadcrumbs drive sidebar rendering, search filtering and breadcrumbs.

nodes.label: Sidebar (desktop collapse + mobile drawer)
nodes.rationale: Two sidebars: collapsible 72/20px desktop aside and fixed z-50 mobile drawer with overlay; both render categories via renderCategory.

nodes.label: renderNavItem / renderCategory
nodes.rationale: Recursive nav rendering: top-level single items vs expandable category groups with active state, badges, color borders and animated chevron.

nodes.label: Command-palette Search
nodes.rationale: Search input with debounced dropdown showing top 8 results from getFlatNavItems filtered by name/description; closes on outside click and route change.

nodes.label: Profile Dropdown (avatar/initials/logout)
nodes.rationale: User menu with avatar (data: / http / / paths) and initials fallback; exposes Main Site, My Profile, My Analytics and Logout actions.

nodes.label: handleLogout (cookie + sessionStorage)
nodes.rationale: POSTs to /auth/logout with credentials to clear httpOnly cookies, then clears trstprep_session/trstprep_user from sessionStorage and dispatches 'unauthorized' event.

nodes.label: Theme Toggle (dark/light)
nodes.rationale: useTheme hook drives isDarkMode state; button swaps Sun/Moon icon and updates global theme classes on the layout root.

nodes.label: Breadcrumbs (from path)
nodes.rationale: Auto-generated breadcrumbs via getBreadcrumbs(location.pathname); displayed in top bar and used to auto-expand active category.

nodes.label: Mobile Bottom Navigation
nodes.rationale: Fixed bottom tab bar on small screens: Home, Tests, Questions, Users, Menu; active state highlighted in indigo.

nodes.label: View Site (cross-app link)
nodes.rationale: Opens MAIN_SITE_URL (= API_URLS.frontend from @trstprep/shared-config) in new tab; lets admins jump from admin panel to main app.

nodes.label: hasValidAvatar / getAvatarUrl
nodes.rationale: Detects whether avatar is a data URI / http(s) URL or relative /assets path (Vite-proxied); falls back to gradient initials.

nodes.label: ThemeContext (useTheme)
nodes.rationale: Provides isDarkMode + toggleDarkMode used to drive layout color classes and the Sun/Moon button.

nodes.label: Skeleton (loading placeholder)
nodes.rationale: Reusable animate-pulse div used while leaderboard queries resolve.

nodes.label: initials / formatTime / isMe helpers
nodes.rationale: Pure helpers used across podium, table and row renderers to format names, time and detect current-user rows.

nodes.label: StudyMaterial.jsx
nodes.rationale: React page component rendering the Study Materials hub with subject cards, history, popular lists, and study tips.

nodes.label: Migration 019: Fix All Remaining Schema Issues
nodes.rationale: SQL migration addressing 53 schema issues: FK mismatches, missing tables, UUID/INTEGER conflicts, missing columns, dead tables, and indexes.

nodes.label: StudyMaterial component
nodes.rationale: Top-level React component managing state for subjects, loading, error, expandedGroups, searchTerm, studyHistory, and popularMaterials.

nodes.label: SubjectCard inner component
nodes.rationale: Inner component rendering a single subject card with icon, title, chapter/topic counts, progress bar, and stats (videos, PDFs, tests).

nodes.label: handleRefresh
nodes.rationale: Manual refresh handler that calls forceRefreshAll() then reloads materials; resets error state and lastUpdated timestamp.

nodes.label: fetchData useEffect
nodes.rationale: Fetches materials and analytics in parallel via Promise.all; auto-expands parent groups, builds study history from subjectWise attempted>0, and sorts popularMaterials by content depth.

nodes.label: toggleGroup
nodes.rationale: Toggles expansion state for a parent subject group when the user clicks a category header.

nodes.label: Continue Where You Left Off section
nodes.rationale: Horizontal scrollable list of last-5 attempted subjects derived from analytics; falls back to onboarding card when empty.

nodes.label: Featured Subjects section
nodes.rationale: Renders standaloneSubjects (no parentId and not referenced as parent) in a 2-col grid using SubjectCard.

nodes.label: Browse by Category section
nodes.rationale: Renders groupedSubjects by parentId with collapsible headers showing total chapters and videos across children.

nodes.label: Popular Today sidebar
nodes.rationale: Sidebar widget showing top-4 materials ranked by total content (videos+pdfs+tests) with a synthetic view count and Study Goal CTA.

nodes.label: Expert Study Tips section
nodes.rationale: Static 4-tip study advice block (weak subjects, visual learning, test frequency, daily review).

nodes.label: dataService.getStudyMaterials
nodes.rationale: External data service method that returns the user's study materials list; called with forceRefresh=true on manual refresh.

nodes.label: dataService.getUserAnalytics
nodes.rationale: Returns subjectWise accuracy/attempted counts used to build studyHistory; silently nulls out on failure so the page still renders.

nodes.label: dataService.forceRefreshAll
nodes.rationale: Forces a cache invalidation/refresh of all data sources before re-fetching materials on user-triggered refresh.

nodes.label: study_materials table (created)
nodes.rationale: New table for video/PDF study assets with subject_id, chapter_id, topic_id FKs and slug, type, is_pro, is_active, metadata JSONB.

nodes.label: test_category_series junction table
nodes.rationale: Many-to-many junction between test_categories and test_series with CASCADE deletes and composite PK.

nodes.label: quizzes table
nodes.rationale: Standalone quiz definitions with title, slug, category, difficulty, duration, total_questions, status, is_pro, metadata.

nodes.label: ca_quizzes table
nodes.rationale: Current-affairs quizzes with quiz_date, JSONB questions array, and is_active flag.

nodes.label: navigation_config table (consolidated)
nodes.rationale: Adds parent_id, display_order, is_active, metadata columns; full table created as fallback if absent.

nodes.label: audit_logs table (recreated INTEGER)
nodes.rationale: Drops legacy UUID-PK version and recreates with SERIAL INTEGER id matching relation definitions; user_id, admin_id, action, old_data/new_data JSONB.

nodes.label: exam_yearly_data table
nodes.rationale: Per-year exam data with JSONB payload keyed by (exam_id, year).

nodes.label: exam_updates table
nodes.rationale: Exam news/updates feed with title, content, update_type, is_active and exam_id link.

nodes.label: study_groups.user_id column
nodes.rationale: Adds missing user_id FK to users(id) and backfills from created_by to satisfy RELATIONSHIP_DEFINITIONS.

nodes.label: exam_info.category_id FK
nodes.rationale: Adds fk_exam_info_category linking exam_info.category_id to exam_categories.category_id with ON DELETE SET NULL.

nodes.label: notifications: drop redundant 'read'
nodes.rationale: Backfills is_read from read, drops the redundant 'read' column, ensures is_read column exists with default false.

nodes.label: daily_quizzes missing columns
nodes.rationale: Adds total_questions INTEGER and metadata JSONB to daily_quizzes.

nodes.label: study_streaks public_id columns
nodes.rationale: Adds public_id VARCHAR(50) UNIQUE and public_id_uuid UUID UNIQUE for public API access.

nodes.label: wrong_questions public_id + FKs
nodes.rationale: Adds public_id/public_id_uuid and FKs to questions(id) and attempts(id) with CASCADE delete.

nodes.label: revision_queue public_id + question FK
nodes.rationale: Adds public_id/public_id_uuid columns and FK constraint on question_id referencing questions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE.

nodes.label: banners.asset_id FK
nodes.rationale: Adds asset_id INTEGER FK to assets(id) ON DELETE SET NULL for banner image references.

nodes.label: promotions.banner_asset_id FK
nodes.rationale: Adds banner_asset_id INTEGER FK to assets(id) ON DELETE SET NULL for promotion banners.

nodes.label: backups.created_by FK
nodes.rationale: Adds fk_backups_created_by linking backups.created_by to users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL.

nodes.label: user_topic_stats.topic_id FK
nodes.rationale: Adds fk_user_topic_stats_topic linking topic_id to topics(id) ON DELETE CASCADE.

nodes.label: leaderboard_entries test/series FKs + rankings
nodes.rationale: Adds fk_leaderboard_entries_test (tests.id CASCADE) and fk_leaderboard_entries_series (test_series.id CASCADE); also adds rankings JSONB column.

nodes.label: enrollments.series_id FK
nodes.rationale: Adds fk_enrollments_series linking enrollments.series_id to test_series(id) ON DELETE CASCADE.

nodes.label: subject_videos / subject_pdfs / topic_tests subject FKs
nodes.rationale: Adds fk_subject_videos_subject, fk_subject_pdfs_subject, fk_topic_tests_subject linking subject_id to subjects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE.

nodes.label: blogs.author_id FK
nodes.rationale: Adds fk_blogs_author linking blogs.author_id to users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL.

nodes.label: messages.receiver_id FK
nodes.rationale: Adds fk_messages_receiver linking messages.receiver_id to users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE.

nodes.label: questions.quiz_id FK
nodes.rationale: Adds fk_questions_quiz linking questions.quiz_id to quizzes(id) ON DELETE SET NULL.

nodes.label: live_tests JSONB and array columns
nodes.rationale: Adds questions/answers/question_results/solutions JSONB and category_path_ids/category_path_names TEXT[] to live_tests.

nodes.label: attempts missing JSONB columns
nodes.rationale: Adds question_results, solutions JSONB arrays and section_timers JSONB to attempts.

nodes.label: questions.image_asset_id FK
nodes.rationale: Adds image_asset_id INTEGER FK to assets(id) ON DELETE SET NULL for question images.

nodes.label: tests.subject_id column
nodes.rationale: Adds subject_id INTEGER FK to subjects(id) ON DELETE SET NULL on tests table.

nodes.label: Dropped dead tables
nodes.rationale: Removes unused tables: email_templates, coming_soon_features, ai_api_usage, and navigation_menu (replaced by navigation_config).

nodes.label: updated_at triggers for new tables
nodes.rationale: Attaches the update_updated_at_column() trigger to study_materials, quizzes, ca_quizzes, exam_yearly_data, exam_updates, and navigation_config.

nodes.label: Performance and composite indexes
nodes.rationale: Adds indexes on new tables (is_active, is_pro, status) and composite indexes for common query patterns (wrong_questions user+question, revision_queue user+next_review, leaderboard_entries test+score, enrollments user+series).

nodes.label: Migration 019 verification block
nodes.rationale: End-of-migration DO block that asserts all 8 expected tables exist, dead tables are gone, audit_logs is INTEGER-based, study_groups.user_id exists, and notifications has is_read and no 'read'.

nodes.label: Study hub design rationale
nodes.rationale: Combines real analytics-driven 'Continue Where You Left Off', popularity-by-content-depth, and parent/child subject grouping to give learners a personalized hub without hard-coded metrics.

nodes.label: Study Groups Route
nodes.rationale: Express router module that handles all study group, message, and post endpoints; central to collaborative study features

nodes.label: GET /api/study-groups
nodes.rationale: Public endpoint that lists active study groups with category, search filters, member counts and pagination

nodes.label: POST /api/study-groups
nodes.rationale: Auth-protected creation of a new study group; creator is auto-inserted as admin member of studyGroupMembers

nodes.label: PUT /api/study-groups/:id
nodes.rationale: Owner-or-global-admin gated update of group metadata (name, description, category, privacy, capacity)

nodes.label: DELETE /api/study-groups/:id
nodes.rationale: Owner-or-global-admin soft delete of a study group via dbHelpers.softDelete

nodes.label: POST /api/study-groups/:id/join
nodes.rationale: Auth-protected join that enforces uniqueness, capacity limits (maxMembers) and increments memberCount

nodes.label: POST /api/study-groups/:id/leave
nodes.rationale: Removes membership and decrements count; refuses to let the last admin leave (must delete group instead)

nodes.label: GET /api/study-groups/my
nodes.rationale: Returns groups the authenticated user belongs to, joined with their role in each group

nodes.label: GET /api/study-groups/categories
nodes.rationale: Static list of exam categories (SSC, Railway, Banking, State PSC, Defence, Teaching, General) with icons

nodes.label: Group Messages API
nodes.rationale: CRUD endpoints for groupMessages with member-only access, pagination via before-cursor, soft delete and event emission

nodes.label: Group Posts API
nodes.rationale: CRUD for groupPosts plus like/pin/lock/comment sub-endpoints; enforces membership and admin role for moderation

nodes.label: isGroupMember Helper
nodes.rationale: Internal guard helper that resolves whether a user has an active studyGroupMembers row for a group

nodes.label: isGroupAdmin Helper
nodes.rationale: Admin variant of isGroupMember; required gate for pin/lock/role-change endpoints

nodes.label: enrichMessages Helper
nodes.rationale: Batches user lookups to attach userName/userAvatar to message-shaped records (used for messages and comments)

nodes.label: enrichPosts Helper
nodes.rationale: Joins users + groupPostLikes to attach author info, likeCount, and viewer-specific isLiked flag to each post

nodes.label: AttemptedTests Page
nodes.rationale: React dashboard page listing a user's historical test attempts with stats, filters, and per-test Review / Re-Attempt actions

nodes.label: ScoreRing Component
nodes.rationale: SVG circular progress indicator that colors the ring by accuracy band (green/amber/red)

nodes.label: StatCard Component
nodes.rationale: Reusable tile rendering an icon + value + label, used for the 4-up stats grid (Tests Taken, Avg Accuracy, Avg Score, Best Rank)

nodes.label: Aggregate Stats Computation
nodes.rationale: useMemo-derived totals: total attempts, mean accuracy, mean score%, and best rank with NaN/inf guards

nodes.label: Filter & Search Logic
nodes.rationale: useMemo that combines search query, series filter, date range (7/30/90d), and score band (high/medium/low) to slice attempted tests

nodes.label: GET /api/users/attempts
nodes.rationale: External API contract consumed by AttemptedTests page to load the user's attempt history

nodes.label: global.dbHelpers
nodes.rationale: Project-wide database helper exposing find/findById/findOne/insertOne/updateById/softDelete used by every handler in this route

nodes.label: ExamDetails.jsx
nodes.rationale: Frontend React page component rendering exam details, syllabus, pattern, updates, archive, and enrollment controls.

nodes.label: ExamDetails Component
nodes.rationale: Default-exported React component that reads examId from route params, fetches exam intelligence, and renders hero/tabs/sidebar.

nodes.label: Exam Intelligence Query
nodes.rationale: TanStack useQuery that aggregates exam-info, content, updates, yearly-data and category in one cached fetch with 10min staleTime.

nodes.label: Enroll/Unenroll Mutations
nodes.rationale: useMutation pair for POST /api/users/enroll-exam/:id and DELETE /api/users/unenroll-exam/:id with query invalidation.

nodes.label: Tab Content Renderer
nodes.rationale: Renders Overview/Updates/Syllabus/Pattern/Archive tabs with conditional components, including ComingSoon fallback when content is empty.

nodes.label: GET /api/exam-info
nodes.rationale: Backend endpoint queried by ExamDetails to discover exam metadata; indexed to find examId/categoryId.

nodes.label: GET /api/exams/:id
nodes.rationale: Backend endpoint providing syllabus/pattern/eligibility content (used with .catch fallback when absent).

nodes.label: GET /api/exam-info/:id/updates
nodes.rationale: Backend endpoint feeding the Updates tab notifications array.

nodes.label: GET /api/exam-info/:id/yearly-data
nodes.rationale: Backend endpoint providing per-year vacancies, dates, status, importantDates for selectedYear.

nodes.label: GET /api/exam-categories
nodes.rationale: Backend endpoint for category label/lookup by id used in breadcrumb and hero badge.

nodes.label: GET /api/users/enrolled-exams
nodes.rationale: Backend endpoint checked to determine initial isEnrolled state for the current user.

nodes.label: stages.js
nodes.rationale: Express router for /api/stages defining CRUD plus bidirectional exam-stage sync and reordering endpoints.

nodes.label: parseExamIds Helper
nodes.rationale: Normalizes examIds input from JSON array OR PostgreSQL array string format ({1,2,3}) to Number[] (BUG-018 fix).

nodes.label: Public Stages Routes
nodes.rationale: GET endpoints: list, with-categories, with-test-counts, by-id, by-slug, categories, categories tree, tests, details - no auth required.

nodes.label: Admin Stages Routes
nodes.rationale: Admin-only CRUD plus initialize, reorder, and bidirectional exam/stage sync endpoints, gated by protect+admin middleware.

nodes.label: POST /api/stages/initialize
nodes.rationale: Seeds the seven default stages (Tier1/2, CBT1/2, Prelims, Mains, Interview) tied to SSC and Railway exam id ranges.

nodes.label: PUT /api/stages/:id Auto-Sync
nodes.rationale: When examIds changes, iterates all active exams and adds/removes the stageId to maintain inverse exam.stageIds integrity.

nodes.label: DELETE /api/stages/:id Safety Checks
nodes.rationale: Before softDelete, scans tests, testCategories, exams, testSeries, subjects, studyMaterials, pypPapers for references and blocks deletion if any are linked.

nodes.label: POST /api/stages/sync-all
nodes.rationale: Compound admin operation: syncs exam stageIds from stages, then remaps exam ids to canonical numeric (SSC 1-8, RRB 21-25) and re-syncs stages.

nodes.label: Stage Model
nodes.rationale: Data layer providing findActive, findById, findBySlug, getStagesWithCategories, getStagesWithTestCounts, getAggregatesForStage, create, updateById, softDelete, categoryLinkedToStage, idEquals, coerceIdArray.

nodes.label: Exam Enrollment Workflow
nodes.rationale: Cross-system concept spanning the Enroll/Unenroll buttons in ExamDetails and the user-enrollment backend endpoints.

nodes.label: Bidirectional Stage<->Exam Linkage
nodes.rationale: Stages hold examIds and Exams hold stageIds; stages.js keeps both sides in sync via auto-sync on PUT, sync-exam-ids, update-exam-ids and sync-all.

nodes.label: TestInstructions.jsx
nodes.rationale: Frontend page shown to candidates before starting a test; renders rules, system check, agreement and triggers test navigation.

nodes.label: TestInstructions Component
nodes.rationale: React component that loads test/series metadata, validates feature access, performs system readiness checks and gates test start behind user agreement.

nodes.label: fetchData useEffect
nodes.rationale: Loads test, series and question count from dataService; falls back to test.totalQuestions and sets noQuestions flag when empty.

nodes.label: Feature Access Check
nodes.rationale: Determines featureKey (live_tests/chapter_tests/pyq_papers/mock_tests) and redirects unpaid users to /pass route.

nodes.label: System Readiness Check
nodes.rationale: Detects legacy IE browser, online/offline status and JS enabled state; listens to online/offline window events.

nodes.label: handleStartTest
nodes.rationale: Navigates to /test/:seriesId/:testId after agreement; toasts success or error depending on agreement and question availability.

nodes.label: EnrollmentsManager.jsx
nodes.rationale: Admin feature listing every user enrollment with their pass, test series, exam and study material acquisitions plus detail drawer.

nodes.label: EnrollmentsManager Component
nodes.rationale: Renders stats grid, multi-filter table, CSV export and detail modal for user-level purchase data sourced from /api/admin/enrollments.

nodes.label: load enrollments
nodes.rationale: GET /api/admin/enrollments via shared api client; tracks loading and refreshing states for manual Refresh action.

nodes.label: Filtering Pipeline
nodes.rationale: useMemo filter chain applies search, pass type, user status, series and material filters using derived unique values.

nodes.label: exportCSV
nodes.rationale: Generates an enrollments.csv blob from filtered rows; user/email/pass/series/exams/material/enrolledAt columns, ISO date format en-IN.

nodes.label: Detail Drawer
nodes.rationale: Modal showing per-user account status, pass type/expiry, enrolled series/exams/study materials with progress and status.

nodes.label: PASS_COLORS map
nodes.rationale: Tailwind class lookup for pass badges: Pro Pass / Pro Monthly / Pro Yearly / Free / Basic plus default indigo fallback.

nodes.label: CouponsManager.jsx
nodes.rationale: Admin CRUD screen for discount coupons used by the subscription/monetization module; supports percentage/fixed discounts, plan and category targeting.

nodes.label: CouponsManager Component
nodes.rationale: Renders coupon cards grid, search, create/edit modal, copy-to-clipboard and live validity/usage status badges.

nodes.label: fetchCoupons
nodes.rationale: GET /api/admin/coupons via shared apiClient; handles success payload, errors and loading flag.

nodes.label: handleSubmit
nodes.rationale: POST or PUT /api/admin/coupons depending on editingCoupon; new coupons start with usageCount 0; refreshes list and resets form.

nodes.label: handleDelete
nodes.rationale: Confirm-then-DELETE /api/admin/coupons/:id with toast feedback and list refresh.

nodes.label: Coupon Form State
nodes.rationale: Default 30-day validity, percentage discount 10%, max discount 500, per-user limit 1, applicable plans [all] and categories [All].

nodes.label: DISCOUNT_TYPES
nodes.rationale: Enum: percentage (%) and fixed amount (INR); used to render the discount select in the form and to format the card display.

nodes.label: APPLICABLE_PLANS
nodes.rationale: Enum of plans coupons can target: pro-monthly, pro-yearly, test-series, all; drives checkbox group and pill labels.

nodes.label: Coupon Utilities
nodes.rationale: Helper functions: copyToClipboard, generateRandomCode (8 char A-Z0-9), isExpired (date compare) and isExhausted (usageCount>=usageLimit).

nodes.label: Frontend dataService
nodes.rationale: Shared data layer exporting getTests, getTestSeries, getQuestionsByTestId (frontend) and apiClient (admin).

nodes.label: Shared API Client
nodes.rationale: Axios-style client used by admin panel; base URL + auth headers for /api/admin/* endpoints.

nodes.label: AuthContext
nodes.rationale: Provides current user (role, passType, attemptedTestIds) to React tree via useAuth hook.

nodes.label: pass-helpers
nodes.rationale: Exports checkFeatureAccess(featureKey, passType) used to gate pro features by pass tier.

nodes.label: useTestCategories Hook
nodes.rationale: Custom hook returning getRootCategoryNames() used to render the category checkboxes in the coupon form.

nodes.label: GET /api/admin/enrollments
nodes.rationale: Backend admin endpoint returning per-user aggregated enrollments (pass, series, exams, study materials).

nodes.label: Coupons REST Endpoints
nodes.rationale: CRUD endpoints under /api/admin/coupons (GET list, POST create, PUT /:id update, DELETE /:id) backing the manager.

nodes.label: Feature-Gating Decision
nodes.rationale: Test start is gated by agreement + system check + active questions; non-admins without matching pass are redirected to /pass for upgrade.

nodes.rationale: When no questions are associated the Start button is replaced with a Coming Soon banner to avoid broken test launches.

nodes.rationale: Progress bar color thresholds: green <=50%, yellow <=80%, red >80% to surface near-exhausted coupons visually.

nodes.label: Migration 011 Domain Hierarchy Fix
nodes.rationale: Critical migration adding ~20 tables (exams, content_items, learning_paths, search_index) and FK constraints to fix domain hierarchy issues across Exams, Assessments, and Study Materials

nodes.label: NotificationsManager
nodes.rationale: Admin React component for sending/listing/deleting user notifications with single + bulk modes, multi-channel (in_app/email/push/sms), and scheduling

nodes.label: Study Public API Router
nodes.rationale: Express router exposing public /api/study endpoints with slug-first routing, dual-table (subjects vs studyMaterials) resolution, and full chapter/topic/media hierarchy

nodes.label: exam_categories
nodes.rationale: Top-level taxonomy table (ssc/railway/banking/upsc/defence/teaching) with slug + icon + color, referenced by exams and test_categories

nodes.label: exams
nodes.rationale: Master exam catalog with stage_ids[] array, FK to exam_categories, feeds seasons/yearly_data/updates/learning_paths

nodes.label: content_items
nodes.rationale: Polymorphic study-material hub (video/pdf/text/quiz/link/audio) linking to topics/chapters/subjects with metadata + isPro gating

nodes.label: content_connections
nodes.rationale: Cross-domain graph linking content_items/questions/topics/tests/stages with relation type (prerequisite/related/supplementary/practice/reference)

nodes.label: content_workflow
nodes.rationale: Approval workflow table enforcing draft/review/approved/rejected/archived states for content_items and questions

nodes.label: learning_paths / learning_path_steps
nodes.rationale: Sequenced study curriculum linking content items/topics/tests per stage or exam, with estimated minutes per step

nodes.label: search_index
nodes.rationale: Unified full-text search index across 9 entity types using tsvector with weighted title/description/tags

nodes.label: question_versions
nodes.rationale: Audit trail for question edits storing text/options/correct_answer snapshot per version with change_reason

nodes.label: subject_relations
nodes.rationale: Implements previously unused subject-to-subject relations (prerequisite/related/alternative/advanced/similar) with strength score

nodes.label: content_analytics
nodes.rationale: Cross-link analytics tracking view/complete/attempt/bookmark/share/download events on content/questions/topics/tests per user

nodes.label: test_category_series junction
nodes.rationale: Proper many-to-many junction replacing deprecated test_series_id array column on test_categories (fix C3)

nodes.label: Tests stage_id -> stage_ids[] Unification
nodes.rationale: Syncs legacy single stage_id to stage_ids[] GIN-indexed array and deprecates tier/category/subCategory string columns (fix C1)

nodes.label: calculateStudyMaterialCounts
nodes.rationale: Aggregates topics/chapters/videos/pdfs/tests counts per subject by parallel-fetching subjectVideos, subjectPdfs, topicTests

nodes.label: findSubjectBySlugOrId
nodes.rationale: Slug-first lookup that falls back from legacy subjects table to studyMaterials (admin-created) and normalizes id/_id shapes

nodes.label: loadSubjectMediaBundle
nodes.rationale: Bridges subjects and studyMaterials tables by slug/name match, then fans out parallel fetches of videos/pdfs/tests and dedupes

nodes.label: resolveSubjectContent
nodes.rationale: Core resolver that prefers unit-based hierarchy, inherits from parent group, and falls back to legacy topic->chapter shape

nodes.label: buildHierarchyFromUnits
nodes.rationale: Walks units -> chapters -> topics -> media (videos/pdfs/tests), enriching each chapter with its asset lists

nodes.label: GET /api/study
nodes.rationale: Public list endpoint returning active subjects with counts and resolved content, sorted by order

nodes.label: GET /api/study/:slugOrId
nodes.rationale: Public detail endpoint returning full material with chapters, units, and synthetic General bucket for unmatched media

nodes.label: GET /api/study/:slugOrId/chapters
nodes.rationale: Public chapter summary endpoint using mapChapterSummary to expose slim chapter shape

nodes.label: GET /api/study/videos/hierarchical
nodes.rationale: Public hierarchical video tree grouped by subject -> chapter -> topic with unassigned fallback

nodes.label: NotificationsManager Component
nodes.rationale: Top-level React component managing notifications list, form modal, pagination, and bulk-user selection

nodes.label: fetchNotifications / fetchUsers
nodes.rationale: Initial data-load hooks called on mount that GET /api/admin/notifications and /api/admin/users

nodes.label: handleSubmit (single + bulk)
nodes.rationale: Form submit that branches on sendMode: POST /api/admin/notifications (single) or /api/admin/notifications/bulk (multi-user)

nodes.label: NOTIFICATION_TYPES / PRIORITY_LEVELS
nodes.rationale: Static UI config defining 10 notification kinds (test_reminder, result_declared, rank_achieved, etc.) and 3 priority tiers with color tokens

nodes.label: express
nodes.rationale: Node.js web framework used to mount the study router

nodes.label: findEntityByIdentifier
nodes.rationale: Shared helper for slug-or-id entity lookups (from shared/utils/identifier-utils.js)

nodes.label: /api/admin/notifications[/:id|/bulk]
nodes.rationale: Backend REST endpoints consumed by the manager for list/send/bulk/delete (referenced, not in this chunk)

nodes.label: Slug-First Identifier Routing
nodes.rationale: Design decision: prefer human-readable slugs in URLs (/study/reasoning) and fall back to _id for legacy compatibility

nodes.label: Polymorphic content_items
nodes.rationale: Design decision: single content_items table with type discriminator (video/pdf/text/quiz/link/audio) instead of separate tables per media kind

nodes.label: Cross-Domain content_connections
nodes.rationale: Design decision: typed edges between content/questions/topics/tests/stages replace ad-hoc joins and enable graph queries (fix X4)

nodes.label: GroupDetail.jsx
nodes.rationale: Frontend page for a single study group with three tabs (chat, discussions, members), join/leave/delete actions, and real-time socket messaging.

nodes.label: GroupDetail component
nodes.rationale: Default-exported container that loads the group via API, manages activeTab, and orchestrates ChatTab/DiscussionsTab/MembersTab rendering.

nodes.label: ChatTab component
nodes.rationale: Real-time chat UI: fetches the last 50 messages, subscribes to socket 'group:message:new', and posts new messages via /messages endpoint.

nodes.label: DiscussionsTab component
nodes.rationale: Forum-style posts with create, like, pin, and threaded comments; toggles between list and selected-post detail view.

nodes.label: MembersTab component
nodes.rationale: Read-only list of group members with admins sorted to the top and a Crown badge; pure renderer of group.members.

nodes.label: formatTime helper
nodes.rationale: Returns 'Just now', 'Xm ago', 'Xh ago', or a localized en-IN date for message/post/comment timestamps.

nodes.label: Group Real-time Chat
nodes.rationale: Design decision: member-only chat with socket.io room join/leave tied to the groupId and HTTP fallback for sending.

nodes.label: Group Discussions
nodes.rationale: Design decision: posts/comments are scoped to a group; likes and pins are togglable per-post by group members.

nodes.label: Group Membership
nodes.rationale: Design decision: chat and discussions are gated by isMember; only the owner sees Delete while non-owners see Leave.

nodes.label: Socket.io Client
nodes.rationale: External real-time transport used for group:message:new broadcasts and study-groups:join/leave room events.

nodes.label: Study Groups API
nodes.rationale: Backend REST surface at /api/study-groups/{id} for group CRUD, membership, messages, posts, comments, likes, and pins.

nodes.label: MediaLibrary.jsx
nodes.rationale: Admin panel media library: upload, list, search/filter, preview, bulk delete, and per-asset category editing for the platform.

nodes.label: MediaLibrary component
nodes.rationale: Default export; orchestrates files state, view mode (grid/list), search/filter, and modal preview.

nodes.label: File Upload
nodes.rationale: Single-file multipart upload to /api/admin/assets/upload accepting images, videos, PDFs, Office docs.

nodes.label: File Preview Modal
nodes.rationale: In-app modal previews images and videos; documents fall back to opening file.url in a new tab.

nodes.label: Bulk Delete
nodes.rationale: Design decision: parallelize per-file DELETE calls via Promise.all after explicit confirm; clears selection on success.

nodes.label: Asset Category Management
nodes.rationale: Per-asset category enum (image, video, pdf, document, icon, emoji, question-diagram, test-banner, promotion-banner) editable via PATCH.

nodes.label: Media Search and Filter
nodes.rationale: Client-side search by filename/originalName and type filter (all/image/video/document) over the fetched asset list.

nodes.label: Grid/List View Toggle
nodes.rationale: UX decision: same data rendered either as responsive cards or as a compact 12-column table; controlled by viewMode state.

nodes.label: File Stats Dashboard
nodes.rationale: Aggregates total count, total size, and per-type counts (images, videos, documents) for the header and four stat cards.

nodes.label: Admin Assets API
nodes.rationale: Backend REST surface at /api/admin/assets for list, upload (multipart), per-id DELETE, and PATCH for category updates.

nodes.label: avatar_1_1774230400429.jpeg

nodes.label: User 1 Avatar
nodes.rationale: Represents the profile photo for the seeded user id=1; filename pattern avatar_1_<epoch_ms>.jpeg indicates it was uploaded/replaced at Unix epoch 1774230400429 (~Mar 21 2026).

nodes.label: Frontend Avatar Assets
nodes.rationale: Directory apps/frontend/src/assets/avatar/ holds three bundled seed avatars (avatar_1_1774230400429.jpeg, avatar_1_1774230597112.jpeg, avatar_1_1774234894872.jpeg) used as defaults/dev fixtures.

nodes.label: Backend Uploads Avatars Mirror
nodes.rationale: apps/backend/uploads/avatars/ is the server-side store for user-uploaded profile/banner images; the same hash (561905ab...) appears for avatar_1_1774230400429.jpeg, confirming this frontend asset was originally seeded from or duplicated to backend storage.

nodes.label: Profile Page (Profile.jsx)
nodes.rationale: apps/frontend/src/pages/dashboard/Profile.jsx is the primary consumer of user.avatar URLs (lines 525, 635, 673, 685, 707, 916, 995, 1933, 2052-2054) — handles upload, crop (round shape, 1:1), removal, and rendering of avatar images.

nodes.label: BottomNav (BottomNav.jsx)
nodes.rationale: apps/frontend/src/shared/components/layout/BottomNav.jsx line 81-89 shows the avatar in mobile bottom navigation when on the /profile route.

nodes.label: TestInterface (TestInterface.jsx)
nodes.rationale: apps/frontend/src/pages/tests/TestInterface.jsx line 1331-1332 displays the avatar of the test-taker in the live test UI.

nodes.label: Settings Page (Settings.jsx)
nodes.rationale: apps/frontend/src/pages/dashboard/Settings.jsx line 399-506 lets users upload a new avatar via userAPI.updateProfile({ avatar: reader.result }) and renders it in the profile preview.

nodes.label: assets-config.js
nodes.rationale: apps/frontend/src/shared/config/assets-config.js line 86 defines defaultAvatar path and line 224-236 exposes getPicsumUrl()/getAvatarUrl() helpers for fallback/random avatar generation.

nodes.label: shared/types/index.js (user mapper)
nodes.rationale: apps/frontend/src/shared/types/index.js line 140 maps backendUser.avatar into the frontend User shape so the avatar URL flows through the auth/user store.

nodes.label: Profile avatar CSS (index.css)
nodes.rationale: apps/frontend/src/styles/index.css lines 2408, 2414, 3996, 4014, 4031 define .profile-avatar and .profile-avatar-edit-btn styles (including dark-mode overrides) that visually frame the avatar image.

nodes.label: avatar_1_1774230597112.jpeg
nodes.rationale: User-uploaded avatar image stored in frontend assets (33KB JPEG). One of three timestamped uploads in the avatar directory.

nodes.label: avatar_1_1774234894872.jpeg
nodes.rationale: Sibling user-uploaded avatar image in the same directory, distinguished by upload timestamp.

nodes.label: Avatar Assets Directory
nodes.rationale: Frontend directory apps/frontend/src/assets/avatar/ that holds timestamped user-uploaded profile pictures. Each file is named avatar_1_<unix-ms>.jpeg.

nodes.label: Profile Page (avatar cropper + banner)
nodes.rationale: apps/frontend/src/pages/dashboard/Profile.jsx: hosts the avatar upload flow with a circular cropper (aspect=1, cropShape=round) and stores the cropped data URL on user.avatar.

nodes.label: Settings Page (avatar update API)
nodes.rationale: apps/frontend/src/pages/dashboard/Settings.jsx: calls userAPI.updateProfile({avatar: reader.result}) with a base64 data URL; also handles removal.

nodes.label: TestInterface (performer avatar)
nodes.rationale: apps/frontend/src/pages/tests/TestInterface.jsx: shows user.avatar (or user.avatarUrl) next to the test taker in the test-taking UI.

nodes.label: TestReview (performer avatar)
nodes.rationale: apps/frontend/src/pages/tests/TestReview.jsx: mirrors TestInterface and displays user.avatar/avatarUrl in the post-test review screen.

nodes.label: TestDetails (rank avatars)
nodes.rationale: apps/frontend/src/pages/tests/TestDetails.jsx: uses rank.avatar on the leaderboard row, falling back to the first letter of the rank name.

nodes.label: Dashboard (performer avatar)
nodes.rationale: apps/frontend/src/pages/dashboard/Dashboard.jsx: renders performer.avatar for the top performers card; falls back to the first letter of the name.

nodes.label: StudyMaterialChapter (external avatars)
nodes.rationale: apps/frontend/src/pages/study/StudyMaterialChapter.jsx: pulls comment/instructor avatars from ui-avatars.com with deterministic name-based URLs (color/background).

nodes.label: User Type (avatar field)
nodes.rationale: apps/frontend/src/shared/types/index.js: backendUser.avatar is mapped onto the frontend User object, making user.avatar the canonical field name across the app.

nodes.label: Avatar Asset Strategy
nodes.rationale: Design decision: uploaded avatars are stored as files under apps/frontend/src/assets/avatar/ with a timestamped filename (avatar_1_<ms>.jpeg) rather than keyed by user id, indicating they are seeded test fixtures. The runtime user flow instead persists avatars as base64 data URLs on the user.avatar field via userAPI.updateProfile, while external services (ui-avatars.com, picsum.photos) provide deterministic fallback avatars for tests, comments, and instructors.

nodes.label: Frontend Avatar Assets Folder
nodes.rationale: Static assets folder at apps/frontend/src/assets/avatar/ holds bundled user avatar JPEGs (3 files) served to the SPA alongside the dynamic profile image upload pipeline.

nodes.label: Frontend Emoji & Avatar Helpers (emoji.js)
nodes.rationale: Centralized helpers re-exporting getAvatarUrl, getInitials, isValidImageUrl, LOCAL_ASSETS, THUMBNAIL_SIZES, CATEGORY_SEEDS that the avatar image URL flows through when rendered in components.

nodes.label: Frontend Assets Barrel (index.js)
nodes.rationale: Single entry point re-exporting getAvatarUrl, getBannerUrl, getInitials, isValidImageUrl and the LOCAL_ASSETS map; components import this to resolve avatar image paths like the bundled jpeg.

nodes.label: Shared Assets Config (assets-config.js)
nodes.rationale: Defines defaultAvatar fallback path and avatar placeholder generator (getPicsumUrl with avatar-{seed} dim) used when a user has no uploaded image like this jpeg.

nodes.label: Profile Page (Profile.jsx)
nodes.rationale: Reads user.avatar, opens photo options modal, drives the avatar cropper and updateProfile({avatar: ''}) flow; primary render site for the bundled avatar jpeg.

nodes.label: BottomNav Component (BottomNav.jsx)
nodes.rationale: Renders the user avatar in the mobile bottom nav profile tab; handles data: URIs as well as bundled paths.

nodes.label: Test Interface (TestInterface.jsx)
nodes.rationale: Shows user avatar alongside the candidate name during an active test attempt.

nodes.label: Backend Stored Avatar (mirror copy)
nodes.rationale: Mirror copy of the same avatar bytes persisted under apps/backend/uploads/avatars/ by the upload handler; the canonical storage path the backend serves from /uploads/avatars/.
